spinamp-4d8a21fe94dfe790ffa5.description:
A phantom walks the blockchain, unseen yet omnipresent—the architect of a revolution, leaving behind only lines of immutable code. Nakamoto’s Ghost is an ode to the enigma of Satoshi Nakamoto, the faceless creator whose disappearance cemented the very essence of decentralization. This song captures the spectral presence that lingers in every transaction, every block mined, and every ledger entry that defies control. It’s not just a tribute, but a ritual—a chant for the nameless, a hymn for the idea that refuses to die.

The composition merges eerie whispers, layered chants, and digital hums to evoke the feeling of a presence lurking just beyond reach. Pulsing rhythms mirror the steady march of the blockchain, while cryptic verses tell the story of a myth made manifest in mathematics. With no crown to claim and no empire to rule, Nakamoto’s ghost endures—not in flesh, but in every line of code that binds a trustless world together.

He fell for her the moment he saw her, gliding effortlessly through the crowd, shimmering in the dim light. She was everything he wasn’t—graceful, elusive, untouchable. He chased her, always just behind, drawn to the way she moved, the way she seemed to dance with the world around her. When she finally noticed him, he poured his heart out, promising her the depths of his devotion.

But love was never meant to last in a place like this. She vanished one day, caught up in forces far beyond his control. He searched endlessly, but she was gone, leaving only empty echoes where she once was. So he sang about her, pouring sorrow into melody, hoping she’d hear him wherever she was. He never knew that she, too, had longed to stay—but in the end, she had no choice but to go.

spinamp-66ff980d5afb078c21c8.description:
It has begun! The first out of eight singles for “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is now complete, beginning our journey through the universe of BIONICLE. And what better place to start off this journey than the song Legends Never Die.

The song originally started off as an idea during the summer of 2021, and was meant to be released as a charity single, to coincide with the twentieth anniversary of BIONICLE. As it turns out, other things decided to get in the way and the song ended up being shelved, but I never gave up on it entirely. I knew that eventually, it was going to see the light of day.

Storywise, the song takes place at the very beginning of the BIONICLE-canon. Six canisters drift ashore on the island of Mata Nui, to reveal our heroes called the Toa. One of the Toa, Tahu, arrives to the village of Ta-Koro where he meets it’s elder, Turaga Vakama. The elder explains to him that the inhabitants of the island have been facing a dark and looming threat for many years and that they are essentially at the end of their rope. But with the arrival of Tahu and the other Toa, this threat can now be defeated once and for all. The verses are written from the perspective of the Turaga, while the chorus serves as the Toa’s grand declaration of defiance against the threats that await them.

Inspiration for the song is pretty obvious, if you’ve been following the media surrounding BIONICLE during it’s run. Acts like Cryoshell and All Insane Kids helped shape the mood of the franchise, and I wanted in my own way, pay tribute to their contributions.

Obviously, I couldn’t have done it without the fantastic contributions from all the musicians involved. From Chad Howell’s shredding power on both guitar and bass, to Jay Carros’ tribal yet forceful drumming, and last but not least, the excellent vocal abilities of Lee Lambeck. I’m thankful for all of their input, and very much look forward to working with each and everyone of them again in the future.

Love and peace!

spinamp-ec4c0721a26fe88c101e.description:
Blueburst, the musical brainchild of guitarist/vocalist Craig Douglas Miller, defies the notion that it's ever too late to pursue one's passion, resurrecting a music career once thought lost.

After major label interest for his 1990s band, The Reach, never quite panned out, Miller entered a 20 year period of musical hibernation due to untreated clinical depression and writer's block. 

However, a fortuitous meeting with legendary guitarist Marty Willson-Piper changed everything. Inspired by Willson-Piper's guidance, Miller reconstructed his home studio, and completed an album's worth of original songs. 

Together, Miller and Willson-Piper deliver a lush, guitar-based sound rooted in '80s alternative and post-punk, but with a timeless feel. Meanwhile, themes of seizing life's fleeting moments and striving to leave a mark on the world permeate the sonic tapestry. 

"Executioner's Song" is the second track on their debut album, Significance. It was written in the voice of Gary Gilmore after Miller read the book with the same name.

“NFT Love” is more than a track — it’s a futuristic love story written in code and emotion. A hypnotic fusion of romance and Web3 culture, this song imagines a world where digital art, blockchain, and the human heart collide in poetic harmony.

Inspired by the power of NFTs (non-fungible tokens) and the idea of uniqueness in both art and affection, this track takes the bold step of reimagining love in the digital age. She’s not just a muse — she’s a minted masterpiece, etched into the blockchain of memory, timeless and untouchable.

At the intersection of crypto and connection, “NFT Love” is a metaphor for rarity, commitment, and passion — an ode to a one-of-one relationship that’s truly irreplaceable. With sensual vocals, atmospheric production, and deeply symbolic lyrics, the track places emotional intimacy inside a digital frame, offering listeners a taste of tomorrow’s love songs.

💫 Key Themes:
1. Love as Digital Rarity
The phrase “You're my NFT, one of one, truly rare” becomes the heartbeat of the song. Just as each NFT holds a unique identity on the blockchain, the subject of this track represents a love that can’t be duplicated, copied, or exchanged. She’s the original — minted with care, cherished with reverence.

2. Immortality Through Blockchain
Lines like “On this blockchain of life, our bond is set in stone” reflect the immutability and permanence of love when it’s true. In the world of NFTs, once something is minted and validated, it’s eternal — just like the commitment expressed in the song.

3. Emotional Ownership & Connection
While NFT ownership in the tech world is often tied to assets and status, in this song, ownership is redefined. It’s not possession — it’s devotion. It’s not control — it’s trust. “Minted in my heart, a love beyond compare” encapsulates this idea, blending passion with protocol.

4. The Metaverse Romance
“NFT Love” explores how connection transcends the physical. Whether in VR spaces, metaverses, or digital communities, the song captures the feeling of finding the one — even in an ever-evolving, hyperconnected, virtual world.

🎧 Sample Lyrics (From the Heart of the Chain):
You're my NFT, one of one, truly rare
Minted in my heart, a love beyond compare.
On this blockchain of life, our bond is set in stone,
Immutable affection, in you I've found my home.

No need to trade, no gas can price this flame,
You’re proof-of-love in a trustless game.
I stake my soul, you're my digital bride,
Our data dances where the networks collide.

🎵 Sound & Production:
From the first beat, “NFT Love” seduces the listener into an alternate realm — smooth synths shimmer like smart contracts being signed, deep 808s pulse like mining rigs on fire, and subtle glitch effects weave in and out like digital signals carrying affection across time zones.

The production mirrors the concept — sleek and futuristic, yet human and vulnerable. It’s warm soul music wrapped in blockchain aesthetics, bringing together the cold precision of tech with the heat of a beating heart.

🎨 Cover Art & Visual Identity:
The cover art and aesthetic of “NFT Love” match the sonic story. Picture a glowing, stylized NFT character — part human, part digital goddess — surrounded by cryptographic keys, floating hearts, and holographic visuals. She’s a dream you can own but never control, a symbol of digital devotion in an era of infinite options.

🧬 Cultural Commentary:
“NFT Love” also opens the door to a broader conversation:
What does love look like in Web3?
Can connection survive in digital form — or even thrive?
What happens when our deepest emotions are captured, stored, and authenticated on-chain?

This song doesn't just ask — it answers, poetically. It imagines a future where art, love, and tech are not separate worlds, but intertwined realities. It invites us to believe that romance still lives, even inside the blockchain.

Lovers of crypto, NFTs, and future-forward music

Web3 romantics and digital dreamers

NFT art drops and metaverse DJ sets

Your next NFT gallery event

“NFT Love” is a modern-day serenade to the soul of the decentralized world. It’s heartfelt code. It’s emotion minted. It’s love that lasts forever — one block at a time.

"Urban Sounds" invites listeners on a sonic journey through the dynamic streets and bustling crowds of the city, where every sound is a symphony of urban life. My hope is that the track not only captures the essence of the urban experience but also inspires listeners to dance to the beat of their own city rhythm.

Inception

"Urban Sounds" emerges as a dynamic EDM track, echoing the pulsating rhythm of city life and the kaleidoscope of experiences found within its streets. It's a sonic journey through the bustling metropolis, where every sound tells a story of urban adventure.

Sensory Exploration

As the beats kick in, I dive deep into the tapestry of urban sounds, capturing the essence of city living in all its complexity. From the whispers of strangers to the echoes of footsteps on concrete ground, each element of the track reflects a different facet of urban life.

Energetic Resonance

With a chorus that reverberates with the energy of the city, "Urban Sounds" becomes an anthem for those who find solace and inspiration amidst the chaos of urban living. It's a celebration of the vibrant spirit of the city and the endless possibilities it holds for those willing to embrace its rhythm.

spinamp-8c71fe19034e53e6fcd5.description: I wrote Purify about someone I was deeply in love with.  He felt like a soul mate, but at the same time he was someone that triggered all my deepest fears and anxieties.  Somehow through this emotional roller coaster I found true healing.  He was a manifestation of the type of dynamic I had been attracting my whole life.  We attract what we are used to, and through this experience I did find true healing, true confidence, and purification of my soul.  I raised my standards for love and partnership after this relationship, whereas during the writing of this song I was deep in it, and willing to completely sacrifice myself for love.  It seems on some level by singing “Purify Me” my subconscious was wanting to be cleared of this dark energy, but in the verses you see my conscious self being willing to lose herself for love.

spinamp-c750d6d9b3078dcef0c3.description:
"Görünmez" is a short (90-second) indie-pop song with Turkish lyrics. Turkish is my mother tongue. 

Layers of the lyrics weave a tapestry of loneliness, reflecting the hollowness of a hyper-connected world. It paints a picture of people lost in their own digital landscapes, oblivious to the human connection fading around them. 

I was wrestling with my own invisibility, yearning to be seen and heard but feeling like a ghost in the streets of the modern world while writing this song. 

I acknowledge the digital age we live in, however I urge everyone to remember the importance of reaching out, of finding real connection in a world obsessed with filters.  

"Görünmez" is a call to break free from the self-absorption and rediscover the simple beauty of human interaction.

Anyone who doesn't have an idea what the lyrics means can easily contact me so I can translate them what I mean in each line. Of course you do not need to understand anything, just let yourself flow with the music.

At first listen, Sunshine Feels Too Loud may sound like a soft pop daydream — but beneath its catchy melody and shimmering tones lies a raw portrait of inner disquiet. Written during a holiday when joy felt distant, this song captures the disconnect between a world celebrating and a soul caught in silence.

ChriSONGS Nest crafts a soundscape where soft rhythms mask whispered fears, and choruses contrast haunting self-reflection. The song’s title becomes a metaphor: even sunshine — a symbol of happiness — can feel overwhelming when your inner world is out of sync.

Every verse unfolds like an internal monologue: sleepless nights, social anxiety, and the invisible weight of pretending to be okay. But there's also resilience — quiet and unglamorous — in the decision to stay home, breathe, and simply survive.

Sunshine Feels Too Loud isn’t just a song. It’s a confession dressed as a celebration. It’s a reminder that even in the noisiest world, it’s okay to sit in the quiet and feel things deeply.

spinamp-104082e1f0aa52c926b5.description:
5 years after I completed my first solo piano album, I embarked on a tour through The Netherlands, playing headline shows in the late autumn of 2024. My music brought me to places I could only have dreamt of. In particular Zwolle, where I had the pleasure to play a show in the Academiegebouw; a beautiful former church in the heart of the city that housed a Yamaha CFX Grand Piano and a 2 second natural reverb. Two ingredients that ignited flames on this live record.

I wrote this song as a hommage to a friend who faced personal difficulties in the imd of his life. Later on, I found out that a lot of millennial fellows struggled with the same problems as he did. Have I found the perfect job, did I pick the right partner for my relationship, what else is there to experience in life? Olivier had become a archetype for a whole generation facing these struggles. Therefore, I can no longer deny that this composition is a hommage to our whole generation. That said, enjoy this live recording of a composition I have been trying to polish over the last years.

spinamp-d86610445b4639f3e0f0.description: "Slow Down" dives into the paradox of having it all yet feeling hollow inside. spinamp-7d0d3727368a9e52518b.description:
Velvet Meadow is a psychedelic pop/rock project based in Jacksonville/St Augustine Fl. Founded by psych-head Kris Heironimus. Heironimus strives to create a palette of creative weird sound scapes interwoven within pop melodies. With huge inspiration from many classic psychedelia artists, Mr. Velvet captures an authentic take on psych/garage rock attitude with his dystopian view on money with his single "I Dont Like Money Anyways". 

"Writing this track provided me with so much relief honestly. I remember being super frustrated with life, and work. I felt as if I couldn't get anywhere no matter what all of my elders tell me about working hard and saving what little money I made. I was 24 years old with a broke down car, and living with my fiances parents. No matter how hard I worked at my day job I couldn't afford to buy or rent a house. I remember all I wanted was just to get to a point where I can make music full time more than anything, but I felt the chains of this man made reality pulling me back with constant taunting. If you listen to the lyrics closely you can pick up that frustration. I wanted to write something for my generation that says we are in this together kind of. I know its a little goofy but its how I feel. Us artists barely get paid as it is in the industry, and we always come last. So why care, screw the money. Just do what you love and it'll come." - Kris Heironimus

Upon releasing this track, it put the Velvet Meadow project quite ahead. garnering over 40K new passive fans across all platforms providing enough momentum for his self titled album to really push growth. 

To everyone on here thank you for listening and looking. I appreciate everything dearly. I hope you enjoy this track, and that it speaks to you. That is my ultimate goal with my music. I want to provide cool sounds for my friends who need it.

Welcome to the Meadow

spinamp-d30135b6a34293e3e25e.description:
Back in the days me and my buddies would travel France each summer with an old car carrying our instruments, one duffel of clothes, lots of cigarettes and cheap cans of beer. For some reason, the first time we hit the road we got a gig in Cabourg, Normandy. By the time we got there our breaks failed bad time and we were stuck in this little Parisian getaway on the shores of Normandy.

We filled our days with playing jazz in the Grand Hotel Cabourg, playing cards, drinking and smoking like their would be no other day. One week after the incident we got back on the road again and drove all the way down to southern France to play some gigs on surf camps, with a hippie band somewhere in a forest (a sitar and hallucinating items were involved at that moment). Furthermore, we almost got robbed and stayed on a surf camp for a while living the lives like gods.

Eventually we got older, more mature, we got more responsibilities and we got all the things adults have to do to make a decent living. Standing on a dune in Normandy we said to each other ''If you ever feel bad, think of this moment''. Our lives got different, but the memories will never vain.

This track reminds of those days back in Normandy. It is played as a solo piano piece. Tranquil but heavy, neo-classical maybe but also perfectly adaptable for trio playing. It carries both elements of nostalgy, melancholy and sheer happiness.

I hope that when you listen to this song, you will find yourself in the rear seat of our old car and drive down with us on a adventure.

However, one device caught their special attention.

It resembled a large steel container with records in the form of holograms. When the researchers activated it, a sound was heard - a mysterious song that immediately felt unearthly. spinamp-9b6734ce407e6c2707d3.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

This is from my album 'No Love Like This' — an experimental R&B album produced for my lover. This album only existed as 2 vinyl pressings, one for her, and one for me.  It's now immortalized on the blockchain.

AML' stands for 'All My Life'. The sample for this track was extracted from a demo record for a guitar pedal from the early 70s, where they showcased the pedal in action.  I incorporated this sample as a call and response to my lyrics, creating a unique interplay. It's all about the vibe, serving as a bridge to the next track.

This album was a labor of love, free from any external pressures.  We've had a great times with this as our soundtrack.  I hope the music, the process, and even the journey to how this reached your ears, inspires you. 

Without this technology, it would remain solely on vinyl, a relic of our shared moments.

But from the darkness, something stirred. Not rebirth. Not resurrection. Something far more violent, raw, and absolute. Metamorph.
This wasn’t just a transformation, it was death evolving into something beyond comprehension. It was the sound of the void roaring back at existence, a twisted symphony of destruction and rebirth. The old self had been annihilated, torn apart, and reassembled into something monstrous, something untamed.
Metamorph is not just music. It is the scream of death itself, the sound of evolution through chaos. 
 A Sound Born from Oblivion
Every distorted bass hit, every shattering snare, and every eerie synthline in Metamorph carries the weight of that transformation. This is deathstep at its rawest form, dark, relentless, and unmerciful. A track that embodies the rage of what was lost and the power of what emerged from the ashes. 
 More Than Just an NFT, A Fragment of My Metamorphosis
This NFT is not just a digital collectible. It’s a piece of my death and rebirth. Owning Metamorph means holding a relic of that transformation, an untamed force of chaos that refuses to be silenced.

spinamp-bcd0603098d7ddfdcfaf.description:
“Tensei Taal" "転生 タール" by Noriko Shakti is a rhythmic odyssey that pays homage to the art of tabla playing. Crafted during her transformative journey from Japan to the heart of Kolkata, India, this piece is both a personal reflection and a tribute to the pursuit of musical mastery. Under the tutelage of esteemed Indian gurus, Noriko has woven her journey of learning and expression into the fabric of this track. It’s a rich tapestry of traditional tabla rhythms infused with the essence of contemporary electronic music, showcasing a profound connection between discipline, creativity, and the universal language of rhythm. "Tensei Taal" is more than a song; it's an invitation to experience the soulful convergence of cultures and the beautiful complexity of rhythmic exploration.

"Tensei Taal" is a homage to the concept of life, death, and rebirth, encapsulated within the universal language of music. It's a bridge between the serene contemplation found in the idea of Tensei and the complex, cyclical nature of Taal, which mirrors life's own rhythms - starting and ending at the Sum (the first beat of a cycle), only to begin again, infinitely. This piece is a reflection of the eternal cycle of reincarnation, portrayed through the intricate beats of the tabla, which Noriko has composed, played, recorded, mixed, and mastered with meticulous care and profound personal insight.

This also marks Noriko's debut on sound.xyz

www.norikoshakti.com
©Noriko Shakti

spinamp-3cf407694b487cb67f94.description:
This is from my album 'No Love Like This' — an experimental R&B album produced for my lover. This album only existed as 2 vinyl pressings, one for her, and one for me.  It's now immortalized on the blockchain.

'See How Far You'll Go' acts as a bridge from 'Show U where you wanna go', where I assert, almost like a mantra, that I can guide you to your desired destination, to a more introspective stance of 'let's see how far you'll go'. Relationships often start off smoothly, but inevitably, you reach a point where you truly begin to understand each other and assess compatibility.

It's a phase where personal growth and adjustments become crucial for nurturing the relationship, rather than expecting the other person to change for you. 'See How Far You'll Go' poses a question to all parties involved, reflecting the journey of exploration and discovery within the relationship. Musically, it mirrors this dynamic with a plethora of changes, from exciting micro-buildups to deep introspective moments and intense transitions, capturing the myriad of emotions experienced during the early stages of a relationship.

This album was a labor of love, free from any external pressures.  We've had a great times with this as our soundtrack.  I hope the music, the process, and even the journey to how this reached your ears, inspires you. 

Without this technology, it would remain solely on vinyl, a relic of our shared moments.

spinamp-02797f74f4ba7edd96e5.description:
"Breaking the Barrier" completes the "Sound Cycle" – a series of interconnected sonic explorations that has unfolded since its beginning in October 2022. The release of this final piece coincides with the winding down of the sound.xyz platform itself, creating a beautiful contradiction: as one cycle appears to end, the fundamental principle behind this project – perpetual vibration – suggests that nothing truly concludes.

This final installment continues the established pattern where each release ends with a preview of what's to come. But "Breaking the Barrier" ends with a motif that was first heard in "From Beyond," creating a perpetual sonic ouroboros where endings and beginnings blur into one continuous experience.

As a composer, I've always been fascinated by the physics of sound – how vibrations create the foundation for everything we experience in the sonic world. Working on this series has deepened my appreciation for the philosophical implications: if vibrations are essentially perpetual, transformed rather than terminated, can any musical piece truly have a definitive beginning or end? 

As you listen to "Breaking the Barrier," I invite you to experience it not as a conclusion but as a transformation point in an ongoing sonic continuum that transcends the conventional boundaries of beginning and end.

This is from my album 'No Love Like This' — an experimental R&B album produced for my lover. This album only existed as 2 vinyl pressings, one for her, and one for me.  It's now immortalized on the blockchain.

'Satisfy (a)' is a remake of an obscure song from the 1970s discovered on a tape found in a studio that was up for sale. The original artist remains unknown. The original vocals were rough, and the lyrics incomplete, but the Fender Rhodes riff was salvageable.  The song and story captivated me, so I decided to re-recorded the song, added new lyrics, and crafted this rendition.  I then remixed this version to create 'Satisfy (b)', giving it a modern take.

This album was a labor of love, free from any external pressures.  We've had a great times with this as our soundtrack.  I hope the music, the process, and even the journey to how this reached your ears, inspires you. 

Without this technology, it would remain solely on vinyl, a relic of our shared moments.

spinamp-28309e0068920e686560.description:
“Mecha Inti" explores the parallels between ancient civilizations worshiping gods and contemporary society's relationship with AI and super-intelligent beings.

Drawing inspiration from the awe and reverence that ancient cultures had for their deities, "Mecha Inti" reflects on how humanity may soon find itself in a similar position, facing the incomprehensible power of AI. The project posits that just as our ancestors revered gods whose powers they could not fathom, we might one day view AI with the same mixture of fear, admiration, and dependency. This cyclical nature of human belief and the evolution of what we consider divine forms the core theme of "Mecha Inti."

spinamp-3a507ad3cdbd4ead1020.description:
"Stone Cold v Foolish Love" from Endless Refrains' new album "Fool" hits differently with its powerful lyrics and soul-stirring beats.  But let's talk about the real heart of this song - the message of love, forgiveness, and resilience.

Have you ever questioned if loving someone despite their flaws makes you a fool?  This track beautifully explores that inner conflict, echoing the timeless question: "Was I a fool?" Yet, it's not just about questioning love; it's about embracing it, even when it seems foolish to the world.

The imagery of following in our heavenly Father's footsteps, loving despite ridicule, and forgiving despite hate resonates deeply. It's a reminder of the boundless capacity of love, inspired by a higher example. 

So, here's to choosing love over bitterness, compassion over resentment, and truth over lies. Here's to loving, just like the One who loved us first. Let's keep spreading that love, even if others freeze their hearts stone cold.

spinamp-12d503b9d8f5cbb15576.description:
"Cold wallet" is a term used to refer to devices that store cryptocurrency private keys offline. Private keys are transferred from a device with an internet connection to a device that does not. This data security technique has been used by businesses, governments, and individuals for several decades to keep data inaccessible or save it for later use. In most cases, it is called cold storage, but cryptocurrency fans and users prefer to call a device that stores keys offline a cold wallet.
Cold storage methods are useful for individual investors and users, but some of the best cryptocurrency exchanges and companies involved in the crypto space also make use of this type of storage.

spinamp-91323c3c5d210592272b.description:
A pivotal moment in the history of blockchain technology occurred when
Canadian programmer and co-founder of Bitcoin Magazine Vitalik Buterin
published an introductory paper on Ethereum. 

Buterin proposed Ethereum — a global platform for a "world computer," 
a public computing infrastructure accessible to all. The goal was to go beyond 
financial applications and enable dApps in various
sectors, including healthcare, supply chain management, and government.
The paper also introduced the concept of smart contracts, and proposed a
proof-of-work consensus mechanism (later transitioned to proof-of-stake) to
maintain network security and governance.

spinamp-a4936540d08f0836e734.description:
He saw her dart through the trees, a flash of red against the dying light. She moved like a whisper, never lingering too long, always just out of reach. He followed, desperate to keep up, weaving through the shadows she left behind. When their paths finally crossed, she let him stay—for a while. Together, they ran beneath moonlit skies, stealing moments before the dawn.

But she was never his to keep. One morning, she was gone, her scent fading in the cold air. He searched, howled, waited, but she never returned. So he sang of her, his voice echoing through the hills, hoping she might still hear him. He never knew she had looked back, just once, before vanishing into the wild, where she was always meant to be.

spinamp-30e428b384565a16c68f.description:
Ever dreamt of floating in Zero-G, and then taking a casual stroll on the Moon's surface? "Journey to the Moon" is our musical odyssey, split into two parts. In the first, we'll whisk you through the cosmos, weightless and carefree, as we jet towards our lunar destination. Then, we'll touch down on the Moon, where the music shifts to capture the surreal experience of walking on its surface. Picture yourself in awe of the lunar landscape, with Earth hanging in the sky like a distant friend. How cool would that be?

spinamp-94f906ec36d2665b1f8e.description:
Sex trafficking is a form of modern-day slavery where individuals are forced or coerced into commercial sex acts. Here are some key points:

Definition:

It is a type of human trafficking, which involves the use of force, fraud, or coercion to exploit someone for labor or services, including commercial sex.
Any commercial sex involving a minor is considered sex trafficking, regardless of force, fraud, or coercion being used.

For adults, sex trafficking occurs when they are forced or coerced into commercial sex acts through:
Violence
Threats
Manipulation
False promises
Debt bondage
Important aspects:

It's a serious crime and a global problem affecting millions of people worldwide.
Victims can be of any age, race, gender, or nationality.
Traffickers use various methods to lure victims, including:
Offering false promises of jobs or better lives.
Exploiting vulnerabilities like poverty or lack of opportunity.
Using romantic relationships to manipulate.
Red flags of sex trafficking:

Individuals who:
Want to leave their situation but feel scared or unable to.
Disclose being forced or pressured into selling sex.
Live with their "employer" or have limited freedom.
Show signs of physical or emotional abuse.
Are minors involved in commercial sex.

ABUSE:
Abuse refers to the improper treatment of a person with violence, cruelty, or force. It can manifest in various forms, causing significant physical and emotional harm. Here's a breakdown:

General Definition:

Abuse involves any behavior that aims to control, intimidate, harm, or exploit another person.
It is never the victim's fault, regardless of the context or relationship.
There are various types of abuse, often categorized as:
Common Types of Abuse:

Physical Abuse: This involves the use of physical force to injure or harm someone, including:
Hitting, kicking, shoving, slapping, biting
Using weapons or objects to inflict harm
Restraining or confining someone against their will
Emotional Abuse: This involves using words or actions to manipulate, humiliate, or control someone, such as:
Verbal insults, threats, and put-downs
Blaming, shaming, and gaslighting
Isolating the victim from friends and family
Sexual Abuse: This refers to any unwanted sexual contact or activity, including:
Rape, forced sexual acts, or unwanted touching
Sexual harassment or exploitation
Financial Abuse: This involves controlling a person's financial resources, including:
Withholding money or necessities
Preventing the victim from working or controlling their income
Running up debt in the victim's name
Important Points:

Abuse can occur in any type of relationship, including romantic partnerships, families, friendships, or even workplaces.
It often follows a pattern of escalating behavior, with the abuser gaining power and control over the victim.
The effects of abuse can be devastating, leading to physical injuries, emotional trauma, and long-lasting psychological damage.

This song was born in a rain-soaked Mumbai apartment at 3 AM, when the hum of the city outside blurred with the static of old Bollywood tapes. I was chasing a melody that felt like nostalgia but sounded like the future—something that could bridge my grandmother’s love and my obsession with Weeknd-style synthscapes. The lyrics spilled out in one breath after a late-night call with a friend who said, ‘You only miss the light when it’s gone.’ That became the hook—a prayer for lost love, wrapped in Carnatic violins and 808s.

What started as a voice memo transformed into a two-month obsession. I collaborated with a Tamil lyricist in Chennai (via Instagram DMs) and a producer in Berlin who slept by day and sent beats by night. We argued over the mix until the tabla grooves aligned with the sub-bass just right. Now, it’s  a time capsule of chaos and clarity. Play it loud in traffic, or whisper it to someone who’s still your ‘what if.’ Either way, thank you for letting it live beyond my hard drive."

The third out of eight singles from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is out! This time, we make a short stop in the depths of the jungles, to hear The Singsongs of Le-Koro.

I was originally planning to release another song prior to this one, but that will have to stay in the oven just a little longer. Meanwhile, I was eager to try this one out as soon as possible, and the end result feels very much worth it.

The idea of this track is very easy. A short instrumental consisting of nothing but percussive instruments, with inspiration taken mostly from African tribal music. But why is this the case? Well…

Those who’ve followed the BIONICLE-storyline, particularly it’s arc ranging from 2001 to 2003, will know of the village of Le-Koro, and their drums that echo throughout the jungles of Le-Wahi. In a nutshell, this track takes the idea of Le-Koro’s drums, to it’s absolute extreme.

With the exception of myself, percussion work was also done by two very talented multi-instrumentalists in their own right, Nigel Robinson and Bill Burns. Their work proved vital to make this as layered and immersive as it could’ve been, and both of them deserve immense credit for that.

After writing this, I’ll go straight back into working on the album. I’ve truly started to slowly and progressively put all eggs in one basket, and get as much done, without dragging out the process. Will it work? We’ll let fate decide. Until then, I’ll catch you all later!

Love and peace!

spinamp-97b4f390226766cd92ad.description:
Compulsive buying disorder, also sometimes called compulsive shopping disorder, is a condition where people experience uncontrollable urges to shop, despite negative consequences. It's important to distinguish this from simply enjoying shopping, as compulsive buying becomes a significant problem in a person's life.

Here's a closer look at compulsive buying disorder:

Symptoms:

Frequent and excessive shopping, often beyond what can be afforded
Preoccupation with thoughts about shopping and buying things
Feeling a temporary high or relief from negative emotions (stress, anxiety, depression) while shopping, followed by guilt, regret, or shame afterward
Difficulty resisting the urge to shop, even when hiding purchases or facing financial problems

Relationship problems and work difficulties due to excessive spending
Mental health connection: Compulsive buying often co-occurs with other mental health conditions, such as:

Anxiety disorders
Depression
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
Low self-esteem
Bipolar disorder
It's believed that people with compulsive buying disorder may use shopping as a coping mechanism to deal with difficult emotions or underlying mental health issues.

Impact: 

This disorder can have a significant impact on a person's life, leading to:
Financial problems, including debt
Damaged relationships with friends and family
Job loss
Legal problems

Treatment: 

There is help available for compulsive buying disorder. Treatment approaches may include:

Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT): This therapy helps identify and change negative thoughts and behaviors related to shopping.
Medications: Antidepressants or anti-anxiety medications may be prescribed if there's a co-occurring mental health condition.
Support groups: Connecting with others who understand the challenges of compulsive buying can be helpful.

If you or someone you know struggles with compulsive buying, it's important to reach out to a mental health professional for diagnosis and treatment.

spinamp-97bc9fa6828dc6467f9a.description:
Improvisation on the bunde 'Todos Los Días Doy Gracias'. This is a song of gratitude originally performed in an instrumental format of chonta marimba music from the Pacific region in Colombia. The lyrics' structure is based on a responsorial chant where the singer mentions a reason to give thanks and the chorus responds with 'Gracias le doy a mi Dios' ('I give thanks to my God'). 

For this piece I recorded two guitars and the soundscape of a rainy night from my bedroom's window in Cali, Colombia. The artwork is part of a series of photos taken by León Felipe Jiménez. 

This piece is part of a series of improvisations that I recorded as a gift to a beloved person who was struggling to fall asleep and get proper rest after she suffered a brain contusion. This music flows, like floating down a river, with waves, curves and dips but always moving. 

To achieve these long pieces, I drew on the hours I've spent improvising with dancers, I believe this music is perfect for interacting with body movement and dancing as well as to relax and listen carefully.

LOVE BOMBING is a form of psychological manipulation where someone showers another person with excessive displays of affection and attention with the intent to control or exploit them. It often occurs in the early stages of romantic relationships, but can also be used in other contexts.

Here are some key aspects of love bombing:

Manipulation: It's not genuine affection, but a calculated strategy to gain power and control over the other person.
Excessive Attention: This includes things like:
* Constant compliments and flattery
* Overly frequent communication (texting, calling)
* Lavish gifts, even when not appropriate or desired
* Early declarations of love and commitment
* Intense focus on the other person's needs and desires
Emotional Dependence: The love bomber aims to create a sense of obligation and dependence in the other person, making them more susceptible to manipulation.
Red Flags:  While the initial attention can be flattering, there are often warning signs, such as:
* Moving too quickly in the relationship
* Disregarding the other person's boundaries
* Possessive or jealous behavior
* Attempts to isolate the other person from friends and family

Consequences: Love bombing can have serious consequences for the victim, including:
* Difficulty trusting their own judgment
* Feelings of confusion and anxiety
* Loss of self-esteem and confidence
* Vulnerability to further abuse


GASLIGHTING is a form of psychological manipulation where someone intentionally makes another person question their own reality, memories, and sanity. It's a severe form of emotional abuse with lasting consequences. Here's a breakdown:

Key Points:

Manipulation: The gaslighter aims to control the victim by twisting their perception of events, denying their experiences, and invalidating their feelings.
Self-doubt: This manipulation leads the victim to doubt their own judgment, memories, and even mental stability.
Power imbalance: Gaslighting thrives on an unequal power dynamic, where the abuser holds significant control over the victim.
Common Gaslighting Techniques:

Denial: The gaslighter flat-out denies events happened, even when there's clear evidence.
Contradicting: They constantly contradict the victim's memories and experiences, making them feel like they're misremembering or imagining things.
Minimizing: They downplay the victim's feelings and concerns, dismissing them as unimportant or overreactions.
Twisting reality: They may subtly twist the narrative of events, making the victim seem like the unreasonable one.
Isolation: They might try to isolate the victim from friends and family, further increasing their dependence on the abuser.
Effects of Gaslighting:

Gaslighting can have devastating effects on the victim's mental and emotional well-being, leading to:

Confusion and anxiety
Loss of self-confidence and self-esteem
Difficulty trusting their own judgment
Feelings of worthlessness and self-blame
Depression and even PTSD
Important Notes:

Gaslighting is a form of abuse, not just a casual disagreement.
If you suspect you're being gaslighted, it's crucial to seek support from trusted individuals or professional help.


NARCISSISM refers to a self-centered personality style characterized by an inflated sense of self-importance, a deep need for admiration, and a lack of empathy for others. It exists on a spectrum, ranging from normal personality traits to a diagnosable mental health condition called Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD).

Here's a breakdown of key points about narcissism:
Traits:

Grandiose sense of self-importance: Narcissists believe they are superior to others and often exaggerate their achievements or talents.
Need for admiration: They crave constant praise and recognition and may feel threatened by others' successes.
Lack of empathy: They struggle to understand or care about the feelings and needs of others.
Sense of entitlement: They expect special treatment and may exploit others to get what they want.
Arrogant and envious: They may look down on others and feel envious of their achievements.
Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD):

NPD is a more severe form of narcissism characterized by a pervasive pattern of these traits that significantly impair their daily life and relationships.
People with NPD often have difficulty maintaining healthy relationships and struggle with feelings of insecurity despite their outward displays of confidence.
Important Notes:

Not everyone who displays narcissistic traits has NPD.
Narcissistic behavior can be damaging to relationships, both personal and professional.
If you suspect someone you know has NPD, it's crucial to understand that it's a personality disorder requiring professional help.

spinamp-3b162c0e21acfc4af7d4.description: I made Fast Car after coming back from a slew of tours, hitting the covid “stay inside” era, and feeling a deep desire to reconnect to whatever source got me excited about life in the first place.  I felt everywhere I looked was not bringing me what I was looking for.  The only thing that did seemed to be nature and I remember during this time ( I think I made this around 2021?) going to Air Bnb’s alone in lake arrowhead and other woodsy locations, bringing some music things, and just doing whatever I wanted.  It was a time where people were telling you to not go outside.  It seems the world is always telling you not to do something or to keep you down in some way.  Obviously artists hate this but so do kids.  It’s quite childlike to want to do the opposite of what you’re told not to do. This song is sort of a peaceful ode to freedom.   To not wanting to be stuck in some sort of regimen whether it be touring or the confines of an artist, or the limitations we can feel are pressed on us as a society.

spinamp-29fcfb6ca488cfe9f242.description:
My friend and I interviewed the late great visionary artist Paul Laffoley on a local radio show we were producing. 

I forget if it was the anniversary of his father's death, or if it was his father's birthday, but he wanted to channel the spirit of his father through mediumship to ask him what was in the notes of Leonard T. Troland that had been lost due to having been written on non-acid free paper. 

His father worked at Harvard and had known Troland, had access to his work, and Paul believed it had something to do with what he called "mind physics." Paul, a lifelong Bostonian, and his family had a long history of involvement with the Spiritualist church; a new religious movement with a strong focus on mediumship and seances with a significant concentration in New England.

So that's where I pulled this sample from. It was truly one of the strangest experiences in my life.

RIP Paul Laffoley, you mischievous genius.

spinamp-e3524798b5f76dbfc082.description:
today marks one year sober. it honestly doesn't feel real. but it also feels so normal now. 

for the longest time i struggled with substance abuse, especially alcohol. it took me losing almost everything including friends, family and all that i hold dear to finally put the bottle down. 

i messed so many things up and still to this day deal with the repercussions of years of addiction. i still have anger, i still yell, i still run away, i still feel worthless, but i would rather feel and heal these things with a clear mind than one clouded in liquor. 

i wrote this song in the depths of my addiction and never intended to share it, but i find myself urgently needing the catharsis of sharing. 

i owe so many people an apology, but most of all my son and my partner. the strength and encouragement of my partner is something i am truly grateful for and without them in sight i surely would've been lost. i still am, but i am finding my way. slowly but surely. 

cheers

spinamp-d5c13c24ec9e5884efad.description:
This is from my album 'No Love Like This' — an experimental R&B album produced for my lover. This album only existed as 2 vinyl pressings, one for her, and one for me.  It's now immortalized on the blockchain.

'No Love Like This?' serves as the title track, representing the pinnacle of technical advancement and structure on this album. While it exudes a sense of tradition, every element from the chopped guitars to the dynamic pitch changes in vocals, intricate vocal runs, and harmonies, is meticulously crafted. The song delves into the profound experience of encountering a love unlike any before, and I aimed to mirror that intensity in the music.

With such a rich history of powerful R&B, particularly from the 70s, I wanted to keep a familiarity while introducing something unique and groundbreaking. As an artist, this was my vision, and I'm immensely proud to have translated this feeling into a song. 

This album was a labor of love, free from any external pressures.  We've had a great times with this as our soundtrack.  I hope the music, the process, and even the journey to how this reached your ears, inspires you. 

Without this technology, it would remain solely on vinyl, a relic of our shared moments.

spinamp-8b898eb408855c1b6a45.description:
"Trickster" is the fourth single from the debut Supersigil album Spectres.

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images submitted in response to the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project will be released digitally under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, dropping tracks on Sound, Zora, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

spinamp-4ee9c715f7f311d18291.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

spinamp-32bd8b4622878b170ade.description:
NE$$Y the Rilla and DCoop’s “Life” - A Celebration of Hip-Hop, Community, and Growth

Inspired by a collective experience fueled by a shared love for music, NE$$Y the Rilla and DCoop’s track "It’s Just Life" was born out of a weekend pool party aka The VEC Supa Lit Launch where artists and community members came together to exchange energy, passion, and creativity. The track embodies the essence of these moments—capturing the progression of life, personal growth, and unity through the raw lens of hip-hop.

Set against the backdrop of good vibes, sunshine, and open minds, "It’s Just Life" transports listeners to a space where art, culture, and fellowship intersect. NE$$Y opens with vivid imagery that blends everyday experiences and introspective moments, grounding the track in both reality and reflection. Lines like “French-fries and cold pizza, Shawty on my mind lookin’ like a Mona Lisa” juxtapose the mundane with the divine, while the acknowledgment of life’s ups and downs shine through as he raps, “Had some losses but I’m grateful within.”

As the beat pulses, DCoop’s verse amplifies the song’s communal spirit, painting a picture of an artistic utopia where “the family flew in like a reunion, new homies I swear past lives, ya we knew 'em.” His lyrics flow effortlessly from self-expression to the deeper theme of building together—a notion that’s foundational to hip-hop and echoes throughout the track. The collaborative energy of "Vibe City"—where “beatboxers, MCs, artists, and drummers” unite—underscores the beauty of creation through community.

Together, NE$$Y and DCoop weave verses that reflect the joy of living in the present, embracing challenges, and flowing through them. The song is not just a celebration of life’s highs but a recognition of its lows, teaching listeners that perseverance and gratitude are at the heart of the journey. The hook, “It’s Just Life, Can’t stress if you do your best,” is an anthem for staying grounded and resilient, a message that reverberates long after the track ends.

What makes "It’s Just Life" more than just a typical hip-hop anthem is its roots in real experiences. That weekend gathering—filled with music, laughter, and collaboration—served as the perfect incubator for these progressive themes to blossom. The synergy between NE$$Y, DCoop, and their community is felt in every beat, and the result is a track that’s both reflective and uplifting, without veering into clichés.

In "It’s Just Life," NE$$Y and DCoop don’t just rap about living—they embody it, making the track a testament to the power of music and human connection. Through their verses, the duo delivers a reminder: we all thrive when we grow together, and in the end, it's the shared moments that truly make life worthwhile.

spinamp-ccc7049111862c4b3dbf.description:
🌑✨ *"Shadow Dance"* was born from a feeling—a moment when the world feels distant, yet every emotion is amplified. It’s about loneliness, mystery, and the unspoken truths that linger in the dark. The song takes you into a world where shadows move, not just as figures on the wall, but as echoes of emotions that refuse to be forgotten.  

It all started on one of those nights when the silence was almost too loud. I found myself staring into the darkness, letting thoughts swirl like ghosts in my mind. *"Whispers echo tales untold, Lonely shadows start to creep"*—these words captured exactly what I was feeling. The kind of quiet where your own thoughts feel like voices, and the darkness feels alive.  

The second verse paints the picture even clearer: *"Silent eyes that watch and wait, Hearts now tangled with their fate."* There’s a sense of inevitability here, like being trapped in a loop of memories and emotions. The moonlight becomes the only witness to these moments, highlighting broken dreams that can’t be repaired. This song isn’t about resolution—it’s about surrendering to the moment and letting the shadows take the lead.  

💃🏻🖤 The chorus is the heartbeat of *Shadow Dance*. *"Dance the shadows dance alone, Where the sorrow calls them home."* It’s a haunting image—shadows moving freely, detached from the people they once belonged to. They dance in solitude, just like we do when we’re lost in our thoughts. The repetition of *"Silent cries that no one hears"* adds to the loneliness, that feeling of screaming inside while the world moves on, unaware.  

The third verse deepens the sensation of being lost. *"Waves of sorrow wash away, Colors fade to shades of gray."* It’s about drifting in and out of reality, feeling like the world is slipping through your fingers. Sometimes, pain has a way of numbing everything else, turning the brightest moments into dull echoes. *"In this trance we lose our way, In the night we find our play."* This line is powerful because it’s about surrender—sometimes, when you’re lost, you stop fighting and just exist in the darkness.  

🔮⏳ The bridge shifts the focus to time: *"Frozen moments lost to time, Through the silence hear the chime."* Time feels slow in sadness, and every second feels stretched out. But even in silence, there are echoes of memories—chimes that remind us of what was, or what could have been. The final line of the bridge, *"Feel the darkness take its bow,"* is like a curtain closing on this midnight performance. The shadows have danced, and now, they retreat.  

💡 This song was built with the help of AI, which added layers of unpredictability to the process. Sometimes, AI brings a sense of detachment, making it easier to explore emotions without overanalyzing them. Other times, it sharpens raw feelings and turns them into something even more haunting. *Shadow Dance* wasn’t just written—it was felt. It was lived. The words came from a place of deep reflection, and with AI as a creative partner, they transformed into something surreal.  

This track is for anyone who’s ever felt lost in the dark, for those moments when you let the silence consume you. Shadows dance when no one is watching—so let them. Let the emotions move through you. And when the night ends, step into the light, knowing the dance is over... until the next time. 🌑✨

The ship's chronometer flickered erratically between 2,142—her departure year—and centuries beyond. The stars were wrong; Earth’s signals were silent. She was lost not just in space, but in time.

Before her loomed a city unlike any she’d imagined—a sprawling metropolis suspended in a void, its towers of shimmering lights and liquid metal piercing a sky ablaze with sunset light. She wandered the streets, marveling at its wonders—holographic archives of lost eras and markets trading memories as currency. But beneath the awe, a hollow ache grew. This was no homecoming; it was a final exile. The accident had made her a legend, but it had also erased her from the life she’d known. As she gazed at the infinite horizon, Geo wondered if she’d ever find a way back—or if she’d become another thread in this timeless tapestry, lost forever to the city at the edge of eternity.

spinamp-ab5fe04b2e81bf76142d.description:
On the surface, this is a song about women who love women. Beneath that, the song is a rebellion against patriarchy and heterosexual hegemony. 

Alba was born because her father wanted a boy. After being born as a girl, she is then burdened with the maternal duty of marrying a male and having children. She does not understand why mainstream society recognizes only this one form of love and turns it into a female obligation.
She gamely brings home her fiancée and tells her father, let's say you've fulfilled your dream, you've given birth to a boy, and this boy is going to marry this girl.
But Papa, but everyone, please don't think of me as a boy. I don't love her from a boy's perspective. Love has nothing to do with gender.

The name “Alba” comes from Eduardo Kac's experiment with a fluorescent rabbit. He named the rabbit Alba, which was injected with a green fluorescent protein and whose body fluoresced green. How are we not like Alba, being regarded as an anomaly only because we're born different, even though we are glowing without harming anyone?

spinamp-2a31c33d6453850808ee.description:
In a lapse of absolute uncertainty, stillness, and fear sometimes all we got is each other, or maybe all we got is ourselves as individuals. That's what my 2020 covid lockdown was like. For some periods, it was solitude, and in others I was in good company, this company, these friends were what made the world still feel together. I was far away from home, and far away from my family in a foreign country. 
I found myself alone for the most part of the year in my flat, they had left to their home countries early in the pandemic, and I was left in out flat. During this time I appreciated my solitude. I even romanticize it now, and in a strange way miss it. All I could do was music, cook food, and paint. I didn't have the pressure of "having to go to work" or university, because nobody could.
In times of companionship, and times of friendship I felt normal, and relieved even though my family was far away in different parts of the world I felt whole.
Ana Bulnes helped bring this song to life, and I thank her and all my friends in those times for staying close and getting through it all together. 
It was memorable after all.

Andre Sebastian.

spinamp-675a7d6272c820d5c8c7.description:
Central banks' money creation has been a hot topic, especially post-2008 crisis. Quantitative easing, like the Fed's, pumps up the money supply, leading to inflation and diminished purchasing power.

With more money in circulation, prices shoot up, but real value doesn't. Bitcoin offers a way out. Born in 2009, it's got a fixed supply of 21 million coins, unlike fiat currencies. Controlled by its protocol, new bitcoin issuance halves every four years in a "halving" event.

This scarcity shields Bitcoin from inflationary threats. Proponents reckon it could be a global reserve currency if it sticks to its fixed supply. Historically, economies groove to a single money form, simplifying trade. Bitcoin's predictability could make it top dog if it's embraced globally.

"AMENITIES" is my take on heartbreak wrapped in the chaos of a rockstar lifestyle. It tells the story of someone caught in toxic relationships, using a girl as a fleeting escape while I wrestle with my inner demons. She becomes my muse, but deep down, I know I can't love her forever.

What makes this track really special to me is my grandfather, Hamlet Gonashvili, the "voice of Georgia." I sampled his vocals at the end, adding a powerful touch. I also took the best moments from two different songs I created on the same beat and merged them into one. "AMENITIES" captures the struggle between desire and detachment, and I hope it resonates with anyone who's felt that push and pull.

spinamp-10add4f3b240e729dbfd.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

spinamp-7b4e82e03ecd08a8efec.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

Title: "Drunk"

Artist: Hush702

"Drunk" by Hush702 is a high-energy party anthem that captures the dizzying euphoria of letting loose and surrendering to the night. With a pulsating beat and infectious rhythms, this track is an unapologetic ode to the carefree and sometimes reckless abandon that comes with being inebriated.

In true Hush702 style, the song combines slick production with relatable lyrics, perfectly encapsulating the intoxicating buzz of a wild night out. The artist’s raspy vocals lay over a dynamic soundscape of throbbing bass and shimmering electronic flourishes, evoking the sensory overload of a crowded dance floor under flashing lights.

"Drunk" is an immersive experience, an anthem that compels you to throw your hands up and embrace the now. It's for everyone who's ever felt the desire to escape the mundane, to feel alive in the blur of melodies and the taste of their favorite spirits. Hush702 delivers each line with a knowing smirk, a reminder that they, too, understand the irresistible pull of letting go.

The chorus is instantly catchy and unabashedly straightforward, "Bitch Im Drunk, Drunk,Drunk," pulling the listener into a singalong before they know it. It's the kind of song that becomes the highlight of the party playlist, a shared favorite that friends shout out the lyrics to each other as they revel in the glory of the moment.

"Drunk" doesn't just set the scene; it becomes the scene— the soundtrack to memories that will be talked about in the weeks to come. Despite its celebration of the haze of inebriation, the song retains a tight structure, with each verse building back into the euphonious refrain, mirroring the cyclical nature of a night out: the rise, the peak, and the unforgettable stories after.

Hush702's "Drunk" is a toast to the nights we seldom remember but always enjoy—a heady mix of rhythm and revelry that won't just get you on your feet but will keep you there, dancing until the break of dawn.

spinamp-9ac615ba08a82cfeb9a3.description:
What Is Bitcoin Halving?
The Bitcoin Halving is when Bitcoin's mining reward is split in half. It takes the blockchain network about four years to open 210,000 more blocks, a standard set by the blockchain's creators to continuously reduce the rate at which the cryptocurrency is introduced.

The first reward was 50 bitcoin. Previous halving dates were:
Nov. 28, 2012, to 25 bitcoins
July 9, 2016, to 12.5 bitcoins
May 11, 2020, to 6.25 bitcoins
April 19, 2024, to 3.125 bitcoins
The next halving is expected to occur in 2028, when the block reward will fall to 1.625 BTC.

As of April 2024, about 19.69 million bitcoins were in circulation, leaving just around 1.31 million to be released via mining rewards.

spinamp-0522ae51945c8b762256.description:
This song is a metacommentary on my life over the last 6~ or so years. 

Performance Anxiety is an instrumental I have been working on since 2019, with guitar and bass recordings from 2021, and combined with lyrics I wrote and performed in 2024. In the future I hope to be less ensnared within my actual performance anxiety, and I’m trying to be okay with posting music with less formal preparation beforehand. Build in public, as they say.

In 2018-19, I was about to release my debut album and take on the world with a tour in the Denver area. Then, as the release got closer and closer, and the pandemic worsened, two dams broke at once. At the same time as the pandemic made it practically impossible to make a career as a real life events performer, so too did my mental health fall apart as I lost my job.

I was so socially anxious that I could not even use social media at one point - the act itself felt like a performance, for an infinite mocking audience whose standards I could not meet. Really, I was placing unhealthy and unrealistic standards upon myself, as an independent artist, - trying to compete with bigger brand names, and book DJing gigs at festivals and travel for shows. I was just trading mental health for a chance at what I really wanted - an independent career.

I hope this artwork makes you feel something real.

But one night blurred the lines.

She stayed over, like she had before. But this time, something felt different. The way he looked at her lingered longer. The way she laughed felt softer. As they sat side by side in the quiet hum of the night, the question hung heavy between them: “Are we still pretending?”

He almost didn’t ask.
“Can I stay the night?”
She didn’t say no.
“I wanna be more than friends...”
She didn’t answer—just leaned a little closer.

That night wasn’t their first moment of connection.
But it might’ve been the first time they both stopped pretending it was just one time.

spinamp-d31a38bc6a54e520e7ca.description:
This is one of those records that Is so easy to misjudge yet Actually took a lot of skill and precision and I'm really proud of the outcome. Met an artist for the first time (halfway i didn't have my glasses). Listened and Talked over music to gain a view of how she wanted to approach the record. agreeing on a level of originality on the approach. Looking at how other artist appeared influenced by her sound vs others who came different and then identifying a gap where new creation can occur. 

Then a new challenge began. While XOXO got her right on the recording side i had to figure out my approach. How i could connect with her sound in a way that fit, made a cohesive song, created a product that neither of us would have created individually, and felt authentic to both sides. Knew it was gonna be tough just hearing how she came in since that lane is definitely not how I would approach a song.

That's when the ideas started firing off and I found the thread I wanted to weave. thought back to how Kendrick approached Mona Lisa w/ Wayne along with the frustrations that came with hands, requaests, critique and finesses that came almost instantly whenever I was spotted spending a dollar. I wanted to give a warning to other moves to be watchful of their surroundings but I didn't want to use my own name because I didn't want to give away too much personal detail that could set the wrong idea in motion and with how I am perceived I may be expected to see certain angles. I wanted to paint the scene realistically and without glorifying it and still leave a lesson for those who catch it

This one only Staying up for a few days. I wanna do her right and come and set some visuals in motion for a proper release.

"Visionary" serves as both a reflection on the struggles of an emerging artist and a testament to the power of perseverance and creative vision. spinamp-3c7c52c5b36099bdc62a.description:
Endless Roads – Behind the Scenes

"Endless Roads" is a story of searching, of paths that never seem to end. This song is about those who are on a journey in life, constantly moving forward but never quite reaching a destination. Each step they take leads them deeper into a complex and uncertain world. These roads are not only physical but also represent the internal pathways we navigate as we seek meaning and understanding in life.

Beginning the Journey (Verse 1)
The song begins with images of empty streets, a place where no one walks except the individual. In this space, the person is alone with their thoughts and emotions while rain falls softly in the background. This represents a feeling of being lost, both in the external world and within oneself. The "walking down the roads" is symbolic of the search for a destination, but nothing is clear yet.

The Glow of the City (Verse 2)
In the second verse, the image of the city lights in the night is painted. This part of the song reflects the modern world, one that can be both overwhelming and alluring. Amidst the brilliance of the lights, lonely hearts continue to move along these shadowy paths. The movement through the night suggests courage—the courage to face the world even when nothing is certain, and every moment might change the course of life.

Questions from the Unknown (Chorus)
Throughout the song, the question "Where do these endless roads go?" is repeated. This is a question that never truly gets answered, and it symbolizes confusion and the ongoing search. These roads never seem to end, and the person can never quite say where they are on their journey. But perhaps this question is part of the journey itself—a question that keeps the individual moving forward, always seeking.

Shifting and Doubting (Verse 3)
In the third verse, the wind whispers the individual's name, guiding them through a quiet flame. This symbolizes moments where the paths unexpectedly shift, and the person experiences both hope and fear. For the first time in the song, the journey transforms from mere confusion to something deeper. In this moment, the person starts to feel new emotions—both optimism and doubt—as they navigate the journey ahead.

Growth and Inner Changes (Bridge)
By the time the bridge comes, the individual reaches a point where all the struggles and uncertainties of the journey begin to lead to something deeper. The inner transformations that occur during this journey may allow the individual to see the unknown paths with a broader and clearer perspective. This part of the song reflects the growth and personal development that happen along the way.

An Uncertain End (Final Chorus)
In the final chorus, the question "Where do these endless roads go?" is asked once again. The question remains unanswered, signaling that the destination is not the point. The roads continue, but the person has found something more significant than simply being lost. Perhaps the journey itself is the destination, and the search for meaning is what truly matters.

"Endless Roads" is a tale of searching, questioning, and discovery. There is no definitive end, and that’s what makes it so captivating. This journey reminds us that the most important part of a path is not the destination, but the journey itself. In this song, the endless roads symbolize the life full of questions and small discoveries that, together, create a larger path of meaning. 🌌

spinamp-f918e32571332ae4153d.description:
The mental health field doesn't have a single standard book that diagnoses mental health conditions. However, the most widely used reference for diagnosing mental disorders in the United States is the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM), published by the American Psychiatric Association (APA).

The DSM is a continuously updated guide that provides mental health professionals with standardized criteria for the diagnosis of mental disorders. It outlines the signs and symptoms of different disorders, as well as the criteria that must be met in order to make a diagnosis.

Here are some other resources used by mental health professionals:

International Classification of Diseases (ICD): This is a diagnostic manual published by the World Health Organization (WHO) that is used to diagnose a wide range of health conditions, including mental disorders.

American Psychological Association (APA) handbooks: The APA publishes a number of handbooks on mental disorders, such as the Handbook of Abnormal Psychology and the Diagnostic and Treatment Manuals for the Psychiatric Disorders (better known as the DSM-TM).

There are two main types of exams that can help assess someone's mental health:

Mental status exam (MSE): This is a standardized evaluation that is used by mental health professionals to assess a person's current mental state. It typically includes observations of the person's appearance, behavior, speech, mood, and thought processes. The MSE can also include questions about the person's thoughts, feelings, and experiences.

Psychological testing: This is a more comprehensive assessment that can be used to diagnose specific mental health conditions. Psychological testing can include a variety of tests, such as personality tests, intelligence tests, and achievement tests.

The specific type of exam that a person will take will depend on their individual needs and situation. If you are concerned about your mental health, it is important to talk to a mental health professional. They can help you determine what type of exam is right for you.

Here are some resources that you may find helpful:

The National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI): https://www.nami.org/Home
The MentalHealth.gov website: https://www.samhsa.gov/
The American Psychological Association (APA): https://www.apa.org/
