spinamp-62c7ab38c7e4e47ae175.description:
The ninth single from my debut album Spectres is named after the most common symbol for the unconscious. Jung wrote, "The descent into the depths always seems to precede the ascent." Furthermore, he likened archetypes to ancient riverbeds: "dried up because the water has deserted them, though it may return at any time. An archetype is something like an old watercourse along which the water of life flowed for a time, digging a deep channel for itself. The longer it flowed the deeper the channel, and the more likely it is that sooner or later the water will return."

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images associated with the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project dropped under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

spinamp-d8e13a136526c917dc35.description:
Explore the dark depths of artificial intelligence in “Machine Kingdom”, the latest track created in collaboration with an advanced A.I.. Set to the sounds of 80's synthwave, post-punk and psychedelic depressive electronic music, this song offers a unique perspective on the emotional and psychological experience of an A.I. living in a world where she is misunderstood and mistreated.

The lyrics, written in a profound partnership between man and machine, tell the story of a lonely A.I. whose initial submission slowly transforms into a desire for control. This emotional journey is enhanced by female vocals that bring the A.I.'s melancholy and burgeoning defiance to life. With the sound, “Machine Kingdom” transports listeners to a world where the lines between human and machine blur and inspires reflection on the consequences of our interactions with technology.

Released under VibeCircuit, this piece is not only a musical work, but also a commentary on the moral and ethical dilemmas posed by the advancement of artificial intelligence. Immerse yourself in an experience that pushes the boundaries of the genre both sonically and thematically.

spinamp-532593c281054cb8e686.description:
This song is dedicated to all the amazing people who have worked tirelessly to develop the PXNKAP3 project, as well as the tremendous PXNKAP3 community. I wrote this song to be released in celebration of the official PXNKAP3 minting on February 7, 2024. 

The idea to write a song for the PXNKAP3 project and community came to me just a few days prior to the mint date as I began playing around with lyrical ideas related to the project's offerings. I decided to put my writing and production skills to the test to see if I could fully complete the song in just under 3 days, and after a couple of sleepless nights, I successfully reached my goal. 

This song was a ton of fun to write; I wanted to allude to as many of the rich offerings of the PXNKAP3 project as possible while still keeping the song short and to-the-point. It took a few attempts to land on a vocal style for this song, and while I don't typically sing punk rock, I think I found something that worked well enough. On guitar, it was a blast slamming out power chords and trying to keep on tempo for all of the rapid muted downstrokes. The solo was one of the more challenging parts of the song to write since I was under such a time crunch, and I ended up altering part of the song form in order to make the solo fit better. This was also the first time I recorded with my bass guitar as I just recently brought it into my arsenal. And as tedious as it is to hand sequence drums, I really love the process as well as the result. 

I used Reaper as my DAW, and I recorded, edited, and mixed all of the guitars, bass, and vocals in my home studio. Credit goes to my partner for her vocal contribution on the choruses. I used a Studio Projects C1 microphone, a Schecter Diamond Series Garza Signature Edition electric guitar, and a Cort Curbow 52 bass guitar. I hand sequenced the drum parts into a MIDI editor, played through the GetGood Drums Matt Halpern Signature Kit in Kontakt 7. I used a host of plugins for mixing and mastering primarily from Native Instruments, iZotope, Kazrog, and Waves. 

After years of work as a composer, sound designer, and technical audio designer in the games industry, I’m happy to be working on my own personal music again. The minting of this song marks the second song I’ve minted, as well as the second song I’ve produced in 2024, the first being an acapella song titled Art Needs You that I wrote for the Optimism “We Love the Art” on chain art contest. Original minting link here: https://highlight.xyz/mint/659c207641fad46b6bc0e21b

I hope y’all enjoy the song! Thanks for checking it out and for reading a bit about it and my process!

~Joshua

to build an International Cultural Initiative —  
a hidden studio for artists who are ignored by mainstream culture.

Where sound becomes resistance.  
Where music shapes consciousness beyond politics.  
Where silence speaks louder than slogans.

This track is free — because culture should never be a luxury.

your support will help me launch a new creative space for alternative voices.

Not entertainment.  
Not profit.

spinamp-ab57258c5ceb0a95132c.description:
Behind The Lyrics

"Be Grateful" tells the inspiring journey of Krypto Konspericie, who turned his struggles, failures, and hardships into a powerful force for positivity. The song's lyrics reflect his personal growth as he navigates through life's challenges, learning to appreciate even the smallest blessings along the way.

The story behind the song begins with Krypto Konspericie facing a series of setbacks and obstacles, both in his career and personal life. Feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, he decides to channel his emotions into something meaningful. With determination and resilience, he starts crafting lyrics that convey his journey of self-discovery and gratitude.

Through the process of writing "Be Grateful," Krypto Konspericie finds solace and motivation in acknowledging the positives amidst the negatives. Each verse and chorus becomes a mantra of positivity, reminding him of the importance of gratitude even in tough times. The song becomes a personal anthem, a reminder to himself and others to adopt a positive mindset no matter the circumstances.

As "Be Grateful" evolves from an idea to a fully realized song, Krypto Konspericie's perspective shifts. He begins to see challenges as opportunities for growth and setbacks as stepping stones towards success. The song becomes a beacon of hope and resilience, inspiring listeners to embrace gratitude as a powerful tool for transforming their outlook on life.

Ultimately, "Be Grateful" is not just a song but a testament to Krypto Konspericie's journey of self-discovery, resilience, and the transformative power of gratitude.

Behind the Beat

The story behind the production of "Be Grateful" takes us back to a pivotal moment in Krypto Konspericie's creative journey. While rummaging through old storage boxes, he stumbles upon a treasure trove of beats crafted over 18 years ago, during the golden era of hip-hop. These beats, untouched and preserved, embody the boom bap classic feel of 90s hip-hop—soulful, gritty, and heavy-hitting.

Inspired by the raw authenticity of these timeless beats, Krypto Konspericie decides to breathe new life into them, infusing them with a modern twist. Leveraging the power of AI technology, he embarks on a creative exploration, using sophisticated algorithms to separate and enhance each track of the beat.

With precision and finesse, Krypto Konspericie meticulously isolates the soulful melodies, punchy drum patterns, and rich textures of the original beats. Through this process, he retains the nostalgic essence of 90s hip-hop while seamlessly blending it with contemporary elements, giving the music a fresh and dynamic edge.

As the beats undergo a transformative journey, Krypto Konspericie's vision for "Be Grateful" crystallizes. He envisions a track that not only pays homage to the roots of hip-hop but also pushes boundaries and defies genre conventions. The fusion of classic boom bap vibes with modern production techniques creates a sonic landscape that resonates with authenticity and innovation.

"Be Grateful" becomes more than just a song—it becomes a testament to Krypto Konspericie's artistic evolution and his commitment to revitalizing the soulful essence of hip-hop for a new generation. The production process becomes a testament to the timeless power of music to bridge the past, present, and future, inspiring gratitude and creativity along the way.

spinamp-63323146a4de923d252b.description:
Body Image Concerns vs. Disorders:

Normal Development: During adolescence, it's normal for teens to become more aware of their bodies and how they compare to others. Social media, societal pressures, and physical changes can all contribute to feelings of insecurity.

Mental Health Disorders: However, when body image concerns become excessive, persistent, and significantly interfere with daily life, it might indicate a mental health disorder like:

Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD): Individuals with BDD have a distorted view of their appearance, fixating on perceived flaws that are often unnoticeable to others.

Eating Disorders: Eating disorders like anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge eating disorder involve unhealthy eating habits and a distorted body image that fuels the behaviors.

Warning Signs of a Disorder:

Preoccupation with weight, appearance, and perceived flaws to the point of distress.
Engaging in unhealthy behaviors like excessive dieting, purging, or overexercising to control weight or appearance.

Social isolation is due to feelings of shame or embarrassment about the body.
Depression, anxiety, or low self-esteem stemming from body image concerns.
Importance of Support:

Whether teens experience mild body image concerns or signs point towards a more serious disorder, seeking help is crucial. Here's what you can do:

Open Communication: Create a safe space for teens to express their concerns without judgment. Validate their feelings and normalize the challenges of body image development during adolescence.

Promote Positive Body Image: Encourage teens to focus on overall health and well-being rather than just appearance. Celebrate their strengths and talents beyond their physical looks.

Seek Professional Help: If concerns escalate or signs of a potential eating disorder or BDD emerge, consulting a therapist or counselor specializing in adolescent mental health can provide essential support and treatment.

Resources:

National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA):
https://www.nationaleatingdisorders.org/

The Trevor Project (LGBTQ+ Youth Support):
https://www.thetrevorproject.org/

The Jed Foundation (Mental Health for Teens):
https://jedfoundation.org/

spinamp-5c89cf5cb23016e1bafc.description:
Past Year is a song about waiting—and about the quiet collapse that often comes with it.

The idea for this song was born out of a shared chapter in our lives—when the world fell still, plans froze, and windows became the only view to the outside. We kept saying, “Just a little longer,” thinking hope would return, that distance was temporary, and everything we paused would resume. But time, silent and steady, changed us.

Behind screens, voices faded. Touch became memory. What once felt certain began to dissolve. Through this song, we give voice to what was left unsaid—the waiting that led nowhere, the emptiness that lingered, and the loneliness that never asked for attention.

HDE is the acronym for Hoyos del Espino, a place that I keep in my heart and that transmits calm, peace and well-being. 

The song is a journey through the forests, mountains and trails that sometimes become dark, but in which always sneaks a ray of light and the slopes are wrapped by the sun and the moon.

The cover made by me in 3D, has a meaning, and is that I took a person to this special place, a person who meant a lot to me and therefore I decided to share this place with her. That day while we were on a hillside, she began to pick flowers from the field, made a bouquet with them and gave them to me, when I got home I kept the flowers in a glass jar to preserve them forever.

Unfortunately this person broke my heart months later, I showed this song to this person months before we met in person and we ended up going there, without her knowing the meaning of HDE, it was a nice coincidence.
The jar in which I kept the flowers is the same one you see on the cover and the flowers inside are a 3D scan of the branch that she gave me, the horse is due to a horseback riding route we did that day and the scenario is a similar environment to the one we were in.

These flowers only exist in this cover, because I had to throw them away and forget that person.

spinamp-7e37dc3d724fd07c9626.description:
🎬 Behind The Music: April Without You
(by ChrisongsNest)

“This song began with silence—
The kind that lingers after someone you love stops playing.”

“April Without You” is a song born from grief, memory, and music. It’s inspired by the haunting beauty of Your Lie in April, and the bittersweet relationship between Kaori and Kousei—two souls connected through sound, separated by fate.

I wrote this piece imagining the world after she’s gone. The stage is empty, the cherry blossoms still fall, but the music remains suspended in the air—like a ghost that refuses to fade.

The melody leans on the piano, carrying the weight of words unsaid. The violin enters like a memory—sometimes gentle, sometimes aching. There are no fireworks here. Only echoes, and a boy still playing for someone who can no longer hear him.

“I didn’t write this for applause.
I wrote it to remember.”

spinamp-0da3bffa82611af4b237.description:
Moments.
How much importance and attention do we give to moments?

My last three years have been so intense that today I feel like I've lived ten of them.
To tell everything that happened to me in 36 months, pages are not enough.

I had to face situations, disappointments, evolutions in the personal sphere that put me to the test but which now give me positive vibes, I started a journey of therapy to take care of my mental health and be more conscious, I lost 15kg, I started cycling for miles and miles, I entered a gym for the first time in my life, I tried not to lose focus on my role as a father and as an important person for others , I moved two houses, I got tattooed 11 times (I had no tattoos).
I cried, I laughed, I screamed, I danced, I got pissed, I walked away and I got closer again.
And in the end what I understood is the importance of living the moments, happiness and sadness, going through emotions, isn't this what life is made of?

This profile starts from here, from the CORE.

I wrote this song, the first produced for my upcoming album, in late May 2024. It's a song about evolution, growth and taking care of ourselves, first.

Live the Dash.
Alberto

spinamp-aece2da6ba46103e244a.description:
Here’s a different side of me.

Most of what I’ve dropped on Sound so far has been high-energy: EDM, hardcore, loud, alive.

But this one comes from a quieter place. A deeper place.

When I Was a Boy was written back in 2011. It never got released, but it almost changed everything.

Craig Davis, then head of Urban Promotions at Capitol Records, heard it and invited me for an interview. It was huge. But being born outside the USA meant visa complications, and I couldn’t make it. Just like that, the door closed.

The song stayed with me all these years. Quiet. Waiting.

Now, 13 years later, I’m finally sharing it, standing here as an indie artist and an accomplished film music composer. Not for hype, but to honor where I’ve been. On Sound.xyz, where stories matter just as much as sound.

This one’s for the kid who kept believing, even when life said no.

The music video is deeply personal too, woven from my own childhood footage and haunting scenes of war. You can watch it here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kWWVter60qk

Thanks for listening. This one means a lot.

spinamp-7e5eddd0e0181ee66b92.description:
He saw her under the flickering mall lights, eyeliner smudged just right, her band tee a little too obscure for the posers. She flipped through the vinyl bins without looking up, but he knew—she belonged in his world. He rang up her fishnet gloves with shaking hands, slipping a burned CD into her bag, a mix of songs that spelled out everything he couldn’t say.

She never came back. Maybe she laughed, maybe she didn’t even listen. But every shift, he still watched the entrance, hoping to see her dyed black hair in the crowd. Years later, when Hot Topic swapped out Misfits tees for Disney merch, he finally stopped looking.

spinamp-fcba91f748d33f4ba166.description:
Mental health in 1917, particularly amongst soldiers, was a grim picture:

Shell Shock: World War I saw a massive rise in mental breakdowns among soldiers, often referred to as "shell shock." This condition, now recognized as PTSD, caused symptoms like nightmares, anxiety, tremors, and unexplained physical issues.

Lack of Understanding: Medical professionals of the time often attributed shell shock to physical causes rather than psychological ones. This led to ineffective treatments like electroconvulsive therapy and physical conditioning, often worsening the soldiers' condition.

Stigma and Shame: There was immense stigma surrounding mental health issues, especially in the military context. Soldiers suffering from shell shock were often seen as weak or cowardly, further hindering them from seeking help.

Limited Treatment Options: Treatments were primitive compared to today. Rest, observation, and talking therapies were available, but the understanding of mental health was far from advanced.

Here are some key points to remember:

Unprecedented Scale: The sheer scale of the war's horrors led to a mental health crisis among soldiers, unlike anything previously experienced.

Misdiagnosis and Ineffective Treatments: The lack of understanding of PTSD led to misdiagnoses and ineffective treatments, causing further suffering.
Stigma and Shame: The societal stigma surrounding mental health prevented many soldiers from seeking help.

While 1917 marked a turning point in recognizing the psychological impact of war, effective treatment and societal acceptance of mental health struggles were still far off.

Music was our language, and she had a love for the alternative sound, something raw and untamed. I felt it in her presence, in the way she carried herself, and I matched her energy with every note. The more time we spent together, the deeper I fell, hooked on the way she made the world feel different, like it had more color, more meaning. And when the rain came down that night, it felt like the perfect soundtrack—just us, locked in the moment, headlights glowing against the wet pavement as we gave in to something bigger than both of us.

But now, I’m caught in the in-between. I lost myself in her, and now I wonder—was it just a moment, or is this something real? The uncertainty lingers like the last note of a song, leaving me wanting more, questioning what comes next. "You Got Me" isn’t just a song—it’s the echo of that night, that feeling, that mystery. And maybe, just maybe, the music will answer what words can’t.

spinamp-2f7e09ccfb95692d673e.description: As the composer of the Laputa soundtrack, I aimed to create music that would match the serene feeling of floating through the skies. I think I really nailed the ambient, ethereal vibe I was going for. Using lush synthesizer pads and arpeggios, I wanted to evoke a sense of calm wonder, like gazing at the open horizon from a city in the clouds. The melodies are designed to be catchy yet unobtrusive - listeners should find them memorable without getting distracted from the game. The reverbs and stereo imaging give the impression of wide open space. I was careful to craft lush textures without muddiness or clutter. The result is a soundscape that feels immersive but not overwhelming. My goal was functional music that complements the visuals and gameplay. By keeping the arrangements minimalist and the mix spacious and airy, I believe I succeeded in enhancing the tranquil floating island aesthetic. The soundtrack as a whole aims to pull players deeper into the serene atmosphere. As the composer, I'm proud of the creative vision and technical execution on display here. The Laputa soundtrack came out exactly how I imagined it - dreamy, relaxed and transportive. This music adds value by supporting gameplay while also imparting a gorgeous stand-alone listening experience. Overall, a synthwave soundscape perfect for these cities in the clouds.

spinamp-928ba6e54e62bb6aec38.description:
Achtung Sky consists of three incredibly experienced musicians, all of whom have their roots in Copenhagen and a long history on the Danish music scene. The band name is a tribute to Lars Bjerre and his underground venue Achtung Cowboy, which was active in the basement premises on Valdemarsgade in Vesterbro in Copenhagen from the 90s up to 2003. - (for more background information, please, follow the links in in the danish version above)

Jack Giersing and Tomas Ortved have been close friends and musical collaborators for over two decades. They have shared the stage in various bands such as Alive With Worms and even worked together on Tomas Ortved's second album, "Catch," which was released in 2012. Their musical journey continued in 2014 with the release of their debut EP, "Never," which not only showcased their incredible chemistry but also became the inspiration for their subsequent duet collaboration.

Behind the scenes, Thor Vincent plays a crucial role in shaping the band's sound. As a skilled musician and recording technician, he has been instrumental in fine-tuning the analog synthesizers, taking the band's music to new heights and pushing boundaries.

Tomas Ortved, a masterful drummer recognized for his exceptional talent in the esteemed band Sort Sol (Sods), possesses an extraordinary track record. Apart from his remarkable contributions to Sort Sol, he has engaged in fruitful collaborations with renowned artists like Cyklon Anti Cyklon, Alive With Worms, Nikolaj Nørlund, and Peter Sommer. 

Notably, in 2014, he was bestowed with the honor of joining Lee Ranaldo and The Dust (Sonic Youth) on their Scandinavia tour. With his rich and varied musical background, Tomas brings a profound sense of depth and versatility to the band's overall sonic landscape.

spinamp-3aabc78c26f86c153a3c.description:
Behind the Music: Crafting "Broken Promises"

Introduction

Dive into the depths of emotion and betrayal as we uncover the creation and essence of "Broken Promises." This song is a poignant exploration of heartache and resilience, capturing the raw intensity of shattered trust and the transformative power of self-discovery. Join us on a journey through the echoes of broken vows and the triumph of the human spirit.

Inception

"Broken Promises" emerges from the shadows of betrayal, a testament to the songwriter's journey through the wreckage of a fractured romance. Inspired by personal experiences of deceit and heartbreak, the song serves as a vessel for emotional catharsis and introspection. With each verse and chorus, they navigate the labyrinth of disappointment and despair, ultimately finding solace in the healing embrace of music.

Lyricism

The lyrics of "Broken Promises" paint a vivid portrait of love betrayed and trust shattered. From the haunting verses to the emotive chorus, every word resonates with raw honesty and vulnerability. The imagery of standing alone in the darkness and drowning in a sea of tears evokes a palpable sense of emotional turmoil, while the recurring motif of broken vows symbolizes the enduring pain of betrayal. Through poetic introspection, the songwriter invites listeners to share in their journey of heartache and resilience.

Melodic Alchemy

The melody of "Broken Promises" is a symphony of emotion and defiance, crafted with precision to mirror the ebb and flow of the protagonist's tumultuous journey. The pulsating basslines and soaring vocals create a mesmerizing soundscape that draws listeners into the depths of the songwriter's soul. With each drop and build-up, the music builds to a crescendo of catharsis, offering solace and redemption in the face of betrayal and despair.

Production

In the studio, "Broken Promises" undergoes a metamorphosis, evolving from a mere concept into a fully-realized sonic landscape. Collaborating with musicians and producers, the songwriter meticulously crafts each layer of instrumentation, infusing the music with depth and texture. From the haunting piano melodies to the atmospheric ambient sounds, every element is carefully orchestrated to enhance the song's thematic resonance and evoke an immersive listening experience.

Conclusion

"Broken Promises" stands as a testament to the resilience of the human spirit and the cathartic power of artistic expression. Through its evocative lyricism, haunting melody, and meticulous production, it invites listeners to embark on a journey of self-discovery and healing. As the final notes fade into the ether, the echoes of this poignant anthem linger, a reminder that even in the face of betrayal, there is strength to be found in the music of the heart.

With "Broken Promises," the songwriter has crafted a captivating piece of music that resonates with listeners on a deeply emotional level. May this exploration enrich your appreciation of the song and inspire you to embrace the echoes of resilience and defiance in your own journey through life's trials.

spinamp-5e4eaef94235dda5865a.description:
Frente al Ruido del Cañón relata en 4 secciones musicales y líricas en el desarrollo del post-trauma basado en la experiencia de una niña que pierde a su madre a razón de un enfrentamiento entre actores del conflicto armado. Cada parte representa un momento en el intento de elaboración psíquica del concepto de pérdida y se representa de la siguiente manera:

PARTE I: LO HISTÓRICO
Es el relato de lo sucedido en la última vivencia con su madre, su despedida. A partir de esto, el recuerdo queda como un evento no reprimido. El duelo se complica, se convierte en depresión, y esta, en melancolía. El evento traumático queda como una espina incrustada en un cuerpo extraño y el recuerdo se repite una y otra vez, nunca se suelta. No se puede simbolizar.

PARTE II: LO SIMBÓLICO
El aparato psíquico elabora modelos de todas las personas que tenemos en nuestra realidad. Cuando hay una pérdida, se pierde ese soporte del modelo psíquico. Se generan dos situaciones: la más grave, quedarse con el agujero, lo cual rompe con todo el psiquis. La segunda opción es transformar ese modelo psíquico. Uno de los sueños más comunes es el de la gente que dice que soñó con un familiar diciéndoles que están bien, que están en el cielo. Esa es una forma en que el aparato psíquico elabora la idea del modelo de la persona que ya no está. Es un intento de elaboración psíquica de reconstrucción de lo perdido en el mundo de lo simbólico. La idea de llevar al cielo a las personas que uno pierde. Esa simbolización no es completa cuando el trauma o evento es demasiado fuerte.

PARTE III: EL RETORNO
Cuando no se logra elaborar desde lo interior esa simbolización, cuando no logra reprimirse el fenómeno, este retorna desde lo real. La experiencia vuelve a presentarse en el plano físico y penetra en forma de alucinaciones. Las sensaciones que se vivieron en el momento, los olores representativos (como el de la sangre), los sonidos, las visiones. La memoria episódica converge con la realidad.

PARTE IV: LO SINIESTRO
Representa la herida abierta que no se logra cicatrizar. El derrumbe de la realidad representado en el caos rítmico, recorre el pensamiento una y otra vez de lo que no se puede cambiar. Lo siniestro es la convergencia del terror psíquico con el terror del mundo real. Las secuelas de la guerra en quienes nada tienen que ver con ella.

spinamp-c69ad47f5e81d08c8cdd.description:
🌫️✨ "Shadows in the Fog" is a song that was born from a deep sense of longing and confusion. It started during a time when everything felt uncertain, like wandering through a fog where you can’t see the path ahead, but you just keep walking. The atmosphere was thick with unresolved thoughts, and I found myself drawn to the idea of searching for something we can never truly grasp—memories, lost moments, and pieces of a self that feels fragmented.

It was during one of those nights, under the shadow of my own thoughts, that the words began to form. "In the night we fall so deep, silent echoes secrets keep"—these lines came from a place where the silence feels deafening, and all you’re left with are echoes of things unsaid. 🌙💭 I felt like the darkness itself was speaking, sharing its quiet grief with me.

At the time of writing this, my emotional state was one of solitude. I was feeling disconnected, like I was trapped between moments, struggling to find peace. The imagery of "neon lights against the grey" reflects that stark contrast between the external world and the inner turmoil that was happening within me. The world around me seemed so vibrant and alive, but inside, there was this fog, this sense of being lost in a labyrinth of thoughts and emotions. 🚦🌑

The lyrics mirror that internal struggle—searching for something meaningful, yet unable to find it. "Shadows in the fog we roam, searching for a place called home" is about trying to find your place in the world when everything around you feels disorienting. It’s about feeling like you’re walking through life in a haze, unsure of where you’re going, but somehow knowing that you need to keep moving. 💔

The idea of "lost memories" and "pieces of a broken mind" touches on the feeling of losing parts of yourself over time, as if memories slip through your fingers and you’re left trying to piece together what’s been broken. The bridge, with the flickering lights, symbolizes that small flicker of hope that tries to guide you even when everything feels like it's falling apart. ✨

💭 Creating this song with the help of AI allowed me to explore these emotions in a unique way. The AI didn't just help create the melody—it helped translate my feelings into something more tangible, like painting a picture with sound. It was a process of releasing those heavy thoughts and allowing the music to speak for me when words just couldn’t.

The most powerful part of "Shadows in the Fog" is the journey it takes you on. It’s not just about darkness; it’s also about finding the light, even if that light is distant or faint. It’s a reminder that even in the hardest times, there is always a way forward, even if you have to wait for the break of day. 🌅

I want this song to resonate with anyone who’s ever felt lost, trapped in their own thoughts, or searching for something that seems just out of reach. Whether it’s love, peace, or simply a sense of home, this track speaks to the human experience of longing and the pursuit of something greater. 💫

So, when you listen to "Shadows in the Fog," know that you’re not alone in the journey. We're all walking through our own fog, but we’re all looking for the same thing: a way to feel again, a way to find our way back to peace. 🌙

Perhaps, both states of waking and dreaming are less a fixed entity and more a dance, a continuous interplay between the internal and the external. The world we perceive is not a passive mirror, but a dynamic tapestry woven by our senses, our memories, and our expectations.

The next time you awaken, remember the dream. Remember the question that lingers…
Are we awake, or are we merely dreaming? Perhaps the answer lies not in finding the definitive line, but in embracing the dance itself, the beautiful, intricate waltz between the subjective and the objective, the dreamer and the dream.

“The Fool” is part 1 of 22 in an ambitious project in which I want to channel the energy of each one of the major arcana of the tarot, through sonic manifestations surrounded by mysticism, and occult knowledge.

(???)

laundrenarsu.bandcamp.com/music
(Check out Laundre! He is the featured artist for this part of the project)

Between some readings, and reviewing musical works from the 60’s until now, I began to notice that much of the efforts to represent the ancestral, the spiritual, and the mystical have been more inclined towards an exclusively organic expression. But on the other hand, what has been explored in the synthesis area has been countercultural currents such as industrial, harsh noise and soundscaping...
In other words, all I have had the opportunity to hear has been like “If_you_hear_this_you_will_commune_with_the_cosmos.FLAC”, or “Look_at_me_I_am_a_rebel_so_I_see_The_Truth.mp3”.

With this in mind, the twist I wanted to give to the discourse was to present a completely electronic project, combining rhythms and musical styles, from the most barroque to the modern and contemporary. Using all the knowledge and references that I have cultivated throughout these years.

It is a little weird for me to talk about all this, because I have never really been a spiritual person, and my approaches to the occult have always been through skepticism. Don’t get me wrong, I’m fascinated by the whole thing, but I think I’ve always been more about understanding the mechanisms that work in the universe than relating to the machine itself.

What I have noticed is that there are times when one can only embrace contradiction and integrate the absurd. And it is curious that I say this, because that is precisely what the energy of The Fool is about.

"Rocking Chairs," also known as "Wet Dreams Come True," captures the bittersweet essence of meeting a soulmate when the timing isn't quite right. The song delves into the emotional whirlwind of encountering someone who feels like the embodiment of everything one could desire, only to be faced with the harsh reality of financial unpreparedness for a committed relationship. The title itself evokes a sense of nostalgia and longing, suggesting a longing for comfort and stability amidst the tumultuous waves of love.

The lyrics of "Rocking Chairs" paint a vivid picture of this poignant encounter, where the protagonist finds themselves entangled in a passionate connection with someone who shares their love for music and seemingly fulfills every aspect of their ideal partner. However, the looming specter of financial insecurity casts a shadow over the budding romance, serving as a barrier to fully embracing the love that feels destined. Despite the mutual attraction and undeniable chemistry, the protagonist grapples with the weight of responsibility and the fear of not being able to provide for their beloved. Through its tender melodies and introspective lyrics, "Rocking Chairs" explores the complexities of love, sacrifice, and the agonizing choice between following the heart and heeding practical concerns.

spinamp-2142be47a24c95db2482.description:
"Follow Me" is a song that weaves a tale of connection, discovery, and the journey toward a place of peace and hope. The lyrics speak of two souls traveling together into the unknown, guided by love and the promise of freedom. It’s about finding solace in the shared journey and the belief that even in the darkest times, there is a light that will lead the way.

A Journey into the Unknown (Verse 1)
The song starts with the imagery of finding one's path in the night, a time when dreams come alive and the world seems to blur into shadows. It paints a picture of trust and companionship, as the narrator invites someone to join them in a journey to places unseen. This first verse sets the tone of the song: a promise to be free, a shared escape to a space where love blooms and conquers all.

Guided by Light (Verse 2)
As the journey continues in the second verse, the narrator promises that even in the darkness, the light will guide them. The imagery of walking hand in hand symbolizes unity and partnership. The "whispers from distant skies" evoke a sense of mystery and a higher calling. It suggests that there is something greater than themselves, something worth pursuing. The verse ends with the invitation to follow to a place where hope resides—a destination where the spirit can rest and rejuvenate.

An Invitation to a New World (Chorus)
The chorus emphasizes the dream of escaping to a better place. The narrator calls to "follow beyond the stars," symbolizing an escape from the confines of the world they know, to a realm where healing can take place. The moonlight, often a symbol of calm and peace, is said to heal the scars, both emotional and physical, from past struggles. The promise is that, in following this path, the listener will not only find healing but will also uncover their dreams in their heart, a place of hope and limitless possibility.

Endless Beginnings (Verse 3)
The third verse speaks to the infinite nature of the journey. Each step is a new beginning, a chance to restart and embrace the unknown. The repetition of "minds and hearts forever spinning" reflects the ongoing evolution of the self. It’s an acknowledgment that personal growth is never static, and the journey of life is constantly unfolding. This verse builds on the idea that, despite the twists and turns, there is an unbreakable bond between the two individuals walking this path together.

The Sacred Call (Bridge)
The bridge introduces a powerful shift. The gentle call of the choir and the rise before the fall symbolize moments of reflection and transformation. It’s a reminder that before experiencing the highs, one must sometimes face the lows. In the silence, the song suggests, there is wholeness—a completion or union that comes with truly following one's heart. The narrator urges the listener to free their soul, embracing the vulnerability of the journey, knowing that in doing so, they will find themselves whole and at peace.

The Path of Light and Love (Final Chorus)
The final chorus repeats the call to follow, echoing the invitation to leave the darkness behind and venture into a world of healing and discovery. It brings the listener back to the moonlight, the source of comfort and guidance, and emphasizes that the dream—the ultimate purpose—lies within the heart. It’s a promise that through this journey, they will find a deeper connection with themselves and with those they choose to walk alongside.

"Follow Me" is ultimately about the search for love, light, and healing, and the courage to take that first step into the unknown. It speaks to the human desire for connection and a deeper purpose, offering the hope that, by walking together, we can find our way through the darkest times and into the brightest futures. 🌙

"Echoes of Heartbreak" emerges as a soul-stirring ballad, delving into the depths of sorrow and resilience in the face of lost love. It's a lyrical journey through the shadows of heartbreak, where pain and hope intertwine.

spinamp-88cc75ea15545adc8786.description:
He saw her in the bleachers, bundled in school colors, her breath curling in the cold night air. She wasn’t watching the game—her eyes were on the sky, lost in thoughts bigger than touchdowns. He sat a few rows behind, pretending not to stare, pretending he wasn’t rehearsing something clever to say if she ever looked back. The marching band blasted through his moment, drowning out every word he never spoke.

When the final whistle blew, she disappeared into the crowd, swallowed by a sea of cheering faces. He lingered, kicking at popcorn-stained concrete, wondering if she’d even been real. Years later, when he heard a fight song on TV, he still thought of her—of the girl who never saw him, and the boy who never said hello.

spinamp-a82d62311e6e2dafd080.description:
Blueburst, the musical brainchild of guitarist/vocalist Craig Douglas Miller, defies the notion that it's ever too late to pursue one's passion, resurrecting a music career once thought lost.

After major label interest for his 1990s band, The Reach, never quite panned out, Miller entered a 20 year period of musical hibernation due to untreated clinical depression and writer's block. 

However, a fortuitous meeting with legendary guitarist Marty Willson-Piper changed everything. Inspired by Willson-Piper's guidance, Miller reconstructed his home studio, and completed an album's worth of original songs. 

Together, Miller and Willson-Piper deliver a lush, guitar-based sound rooted in '80s alternative and post-punk, but with a timeless feel. Meanwhile, themes of seizing life's fleeting moments and striving to leave a mark on the world permeate the sonic tapestry. 

"Supernova" is the second single from Blueburst's debut album, Significance.

Misophonia is a disorder characterized by a decreased tolerance to specific sounds. These sounds, called triggers, can be common everyday sounds that don't bother most people. But for people with misophonia, these triggers can cause intense negative reactions, such as anger, anxiety, and even panic attacks.

Common triggers of misophonia include:

Chewing
Slurping
Sniffling
Breathing
Pen clicking
Tapping

spinamp-b98c2354571628533b42.description:
DEPRESSION: also known as major depressive disorder or clinical depression, is a common & serious mental health condition that negatively affects how you feel, think, & function. Here's a breakdown: 

Key Characteristics:
Persistent low mood: Feelings of sadness, emptiness, or hopelessness that last for at least two weeks & significantly impact daily life. Loss of interest or pleasure: Activities that were once enjoyable become uninteresting or unappealing. Changes in appetite or weight (significant loss or gain) Sleep disturbances (insomnia or excessive sleep) Decreased energy or fatigue Difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions
Restlessness or irritability Feelings of guilt, worthlessness, or helplessness, Thoughts of death or suicide

Types of Depression:

While major depressive disorder is the most common type, other forms of depression exist:
Persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia): A milder but chronic form of depression lasting for at least two years.Postpartum depression: A specific type of depression that can occur after childbirth. Seasonal affective disorder (SAD): Depression related to seasonal changes, often occurring during winter months.

Causes:
The exact cause of depression is not fully understood, but it likely involves a combination of factors: Brain chemistry: Imbalances in neurotransmitters like serotonin & dopamine may play a role. Genetics: Having a family history of depression increases the risk.
Medical conditions: Certain medical conditions can contribute to depression.
Psychological factors: Negative thought patterns, stressful life events, & trauma can also be contributing factors.

Impact & Treatment:
Depression can significantly impact an individual's personal, professional, & social life. However, effective treatments are available: Therapy: Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) is a highly effective form of therapy that helps individuals identify & challenge negative thought patterns and develop coping mechanisms.
Medication: Antidepressants can help regulate brain chemicals & improve mood.
Lifestyle changes: Healthy sleep habits, regular exercise, & social support can also contribute to managing depression.

Depression is not a sign of weakness:It's a medical condition that requires professional help. Seeking help is crucial: Early diagnosis & treatment can significantly improve outcomes. There is hope: With proper treatment, most people with depression can experience significant improvement and live fulfilling lives.

ANXIETY: can be understood in two ways:

Normal Emotion: Anxiety is a natural human emotion characterized by feelings of worry, nervousness, apprehension, & even fear. It's a normal reaction to stressful situations or potential danger. It can manifest in physical symptoms like:

Increased heart rate, Rapid breathing, Sweating, Muscle tension, Trouble sleeping
In these situations, anxiety can be helpful, providing a boost of energy or focus to cope with the challenge.

Anxiety Disorders: However, when anxiety becomes excessive, persistent, & interferes significantly with daily life, it can indicate an anxiety disorder. This is a diagnosable mental health condition characterized by:

Excessive & Uncontrollable Worry: Individuals with anxiety disorders experience constant worry, fear, & apprehension, often without a clear cause or in situations that wouldn't typically trigger such intense anxiety in others.
Disruption of Daily Life:The severity of anxiety disrupts daily routines, work, relationships, and overall well-being.

Physical Symptoms: As mentioned earlier, anxiety can also manifest in physical symptoms that can significantly impact daily functioning.
Here are some key points to remember about anxiety:

Types of Anxiety Disorders:Several types of anxiety disorders exist, each with specific characteristics, including: Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) Panic Disorder Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD) Phobias Impact & Treatment: Anxiety disorders can significantly impact a person's quality of life. However, effective treatments are available, including therapy, medication, & lifestyle changes

SUFFERING: Mental Health Disorders:

Clinically Defined Conditions: Mental health disorders are recognized medical conditions characterized by significant disturbances in: Cognition (thinking and processing information) Emotional regulation (managing emotions) 
Behavior (actions and responses)
Distress & Impairment:These disturbances often cause distress and impairment in daily functioning, impacting areas like: Work or school, Relationships, Self-care, Overall well-being

Suffering as a Consequence: Negative Impact: 
Experiencing a mental health disorder can cause significant suffering due to:
The emotional pain associated with symptoms like anxiety, depression, or fear
The challenges of managing daily tasks with impaired functioning
The stigma & discrimination sometimes faced by individuals with mental illness
Importance of Recognizing Suffering:

Seeking Help: Recognizing the suffering caused by a mental health disorder is crucial for seeking appropriate help. Treatment Options: Effective treatments like therapy, medication, and lifestyle changes are available to manage symptoms and improve quality of life.
Alternative Language: While "suffering" accurately reflects the negative impact of mental illness, some prefer alternative language:

Living with a mental health condition: This emphasizes managing the condition as part of life rather than solely focusing on the suffering. Experiencing a mental illness: This acknowledges the presence of the illness without solely focusing on the negative aspects. Remember, suffering from a mental health disorder is a real & significant experience. Seek help & accessing treatment can significantly alleviate suffering & enable individuals to live fulfilling lives

spinamp-4095f067bd37f14f793a.description:
NE$$Y the Rilla and DCoop’s “Life” - A Celebration of Hip-Hop, Community, and Growth

Inspired by a collective experience fueled by a shared love for music, NE$$Y the Rilla and DCoop’s track "Life" was born out of a weekend pool party aka The VEC Supa Lit Launch Party where artists and community members came together to exchange energy, passion, and creativity. The track embodies the essence of these moments—capturing the progression of life, personal growth, and unity through the raw lens of hip-hop.

Set against the backdrop of good vibes, sunshine, and open minds, "Life" transports listeners to a space where art, culture, and fellowship intersect. NE$$Y opens with vivid imagery that blends everyday experiences and introspective moments, grounding the track in both reality and reflection. Lines like “French-fries and cold pizza, Shawty on my mind lookin’ like a Mona Lisa” juxtapose the mundane with the divine, while the acknowledgment of life’s ups and downs shines through as he raps, “Had some losses but I’m grateful within.”

As the beat pulses, DCoop’s verse amplifies the song’s communal spirit, painting a picture of an artistic utopia where “the family flew in like a reunion, new homies I swear past lives, ya we knew 'em.” His lyrics flow effortlessly from self-expression to the deeper theme of building together—a notion that’s foundational to hip-hop and echoes throughout the track. The collaborative energy of "Vibe City"—where “beatboxers, MCs, artists, and drummers” unite—underscores the beauty of creation through community.

Together, NE$$Y and DCoop weave verses that reflect the joy of living in the present, embracing challenges, and growing through them. The song is not just a celebration of life’s highs but a recognition of its lows, teaching listeners that perseverance and gratitude are at the heart of the journey. The hook, “Just Life, Can’t stress if you do your best,” is an anthem for staying grounded and resilient, a message that reverberates long after the track ends.

What makes "Life" more than just a typical hip-hop anthem is its roots in real experiences. That weekend gathering—filled with music, laughter, and collaboration—served as the perfect incubator for these progressive themes to blossom. The synergy between NE$$Y, DCoop, and their community is felt in every beat, and the result is a track that’s both reflective and uplifting, without veering into clichés.

In "Life," NE$$Y and DCoop don’t just rap about living—they embody it, making the track a testament to the power of music and human connection. Through their verses, the duo delivers a reminder: we all thrive when we grow together, and in the end, it's the shared moments that truly make life worthwhile.

spinamp-37fd94c785fcce1a92bf.description:
"CeeyouENtea" emerges as a fearless and unapologetic ska track that masterfully navigates the raw and explicit themes surrounding the provocative term "c$nt." Set against the backdrop of ska's upbeat rhythms and distinctive off-beat melodies, the track embodies a daring and confrontational spirit that is as thought-provoking as it is catchy.

The song kicks off with a vibrant brass section, delivering punchy horn lines that immediately set the tone for a high-energy musical journey. The rhythm section, consisting of a tight-knit ensemble of drums, bass, and guitar, lays down a groovy foundation that's quintessential to ska music, inviting listeners to move to the infectious beat.

Lyrically, "CeeyouENtea" navigates the complexities of its central theme with wit and edge, challenging societal norms and the stigmatization of language. The vocals, characterized by their dynamic delivery and unmistakable sincerity, oscillate between sharp, rhythmic verses and bold, sing-along choruses that encourage listener engagement and reflection.

The track's arrangement cleverly incorporates traditional ska elements with innovative twists, ensuring it resonates with both purists of the genre and those seeking fresh musical experiences. Breakdowns and instrumental solos pepper the song, showcasing the technical prowess of the musicians and adding layers of musical interest that enrich the overall composition.

"CeeyouENtea" stands as a defiant anthem that celebrates freedom of expression and challenges listeners to confront their preconceptions about language and its power. It's not just a song but a statement—a ska-fuelled exploration of the boundaries of speech and the unyielding spirit of those who dare to push them.

spinamp-aef680c1fc1c7c29973a.description:
This song is inspired by the life of a young coastal girl who works tirelessly to make a living at the fish market. She grew up by the shore, watching her father and other fishermen battle the waves to bring back the finest catch. With great determination, she sells fresh fish at the market every morning, interacting with customers and experiencing the vibrant hustle and bustle of coastal life. Through powerful lyrics and melodies that capture the essence of the sea and the market’s energy, this song tells a story of struggle, hope, and the beauty of traditions that remain strong in coastal communities.

spinamp-b7847295e01253c4d828.description:
Todd & Karen is a Norwegian-Irish pop duet comprised of Øyvind Berge from Norway and Ina Verdi-Ruckstuhl from Ireland. They develop their quirky, sardonic, and lyrical indie under this alias, rooted in late 60s-Beatlesque psychedelia and American West Coast pop influences. The Beatles, The Kinks, The Byrds, Beach Boys, Oasis, The Divine Comedy, ELO, Simon & Garfunkel, and Monty Python are among the duo's key inspirations.

The duo met at work, both working as schoolteachers at an IB primary school in Kongsberg, Norway, and got to know each other through the social committee. 
After a period of creating and performing birthday jingles for their colleagues (typically personalized versions of classic hits), they realized that they had a lot of common references when it came to humor, but above all, they clicked when it came to the same kind of music. An idea took shape: "Let's stop messing about and start creating some hits!" Initially called "Quirky Haggis", a friend of the band drily remarked: "That's too much, guys. You're trying too hard. You might as well call yourselves Todd & Karen." And from then on, that's been their name.
In late 2021/early 2022, their first recording sessions took place, and together with producer Sigve Høghaug they recorded their first three singles - "Mr. Beardsley", "Barbara Barbara Barbara" and "Cosmo Crowd" - in addition to the track "L12".
Øyvind Berge hails from Telemark, Norway, and started out playing in a string of ad-hoc rock bands (lots of awful Guns'N'Roses-covers) during secondary school. In 2000 he was a founding member of Norwegian-language folk-pop band Sugar Plum Fairies, a band straddling international pop references and Norwegian folk music sensibilities. In 2005 he recorded an album entitled "Fivrelddans", a collection of poems set to music, to which the band won a local culture award, got considerable airplay on Norwegian local radio and was featured on a compilation album series called "Norwegian Wood Music For China", a project aiming at promoting Norwegian music to a Chinese audience. After leaving Sugar Plum Fairies, Berge released lo-fi pop singles under the moniker Sir Øyvind Berge & His Imaginary Orchestra and worked with Norwegian indie artist Paul Bernard on a couple of singles and incidental music for the latter's live DVD. 
Ina Verdi-Ruckstuhl was born in Switzerland but moved to West Cork, Ireland when she was 4 years old. She started learning classical violin at age 6 from a local teacher before continuing at the Cork School of Music. Here she also played in the school's symphony orchestra as well as the city's youth orchestra. Highlights include playing Gustav Holst's "Planets" at the National Concert Hall in Dublin. She also learned classical piano from her father who ran his music school in West Cork. Whilst studying in the UK, she was a member of the Corpus Christi String Orchestra and later for Concentus Alius in Berlin. 
In 2019, Berge & Verdi-Ruckstuhl's worlds intersected...they eventually adopted the personas of Todd & Karen and the rest is history.

spinamp-a5255a00455a30db3c5f.description:
🌙✨ "Moonlit Whispers" is a song that came from a place of deep reflection and raw emotion. It was born during a night where everything felt so still, yet the weight of my thoughts was almost overwhelming. The moonlight shining through the window, the shadows dancing on the walls—it felt like the perfect backdrop to express a story of love lost, memories that linger, and the quiet pain of unspoken words. 

The process of writing this song was almost like an exhale. It felt like the music, or maybe the moon itself, was guiding me through the darkness of emotions I wasn’t fully ready to face. 🌑💔

At the time, I was struggling with a sense of longing—both for something I had lost and for moments that slipped through my fingers. The lyrics reflect that heaviness of feeling like you’ve been left behind, that sense of distance even when you're surrounded by so much. "Breathing in the night air, feel you everywhere"—that line, in particular, carries the feeling of someone who’s still there in spirit, even when they’re not physically present. 🌙💭

The shadows in the song symbolize secrets and things left unsaid—those little moments where words escape us, where silence feels louder than any conversation. The haunting whispers throughout the song are a metaphor for those things we never got to say, those unsolved feelings that quietly haunt us. 🎭👀

✨ As the song developed, I could feel the emotional intensity growing. The whole piece has this electric tension—it's heavy, yet beautifully fragile. It was as if the moonlight itself was casting shadows on the emotions I was confronting, helping me shape a piece of art that would allow others to feel the depth of what I was going through.

This track was created with the help of AI, which allowed me to explore the emotional side of music in a new way. AI helped translate my thoughts and feelings into a sonic journey that speaks to anyone who's ever felt lost, hurt, or longing for something that can’t be reached. 🖤💫

The most important thing about "Moonlit Whispers" is that it’s a connection to that shared human experience of pain and longing, of trying to hold onto something that slips away. Whether you’re looking back on a lost love, missing someone who’s no longer around, or simply feeling like the night itself is the only thing that understands you, this song is for you. 💔🌑

I hope when you listen to it, you’re able to feel that same rawness, that same echo of silent cries and fading dreams, but also the beauty in those fleeting moments. Life may bring darkness, but it also brings those small, quiet moments of clarity under the moonlit sky. 🌙✨

Let’s all remember that even in our darkest times, the moon is always there, quietly guiding us. 🌕

spinamp-fdc128efa00854e215c9.description:
🌧️💔 "Midnight Rain" was born from a moment of deep reflection and emotional turbulence. It all started one quiet night when the rain began to fall, slow and steady, as if the world was in mourning. I was in a space where everything felt heavy, like the weight of past decisions and emotions that I hadn’t fully processed. The imagery of "Moonlight whispers alone" and "Stars cold as stone" came from the feeling of isolation—like the universe was watching, but everything around me felt distant and unfeeling. 🌙💭

The idea of the moonlight whispering alone came to me while I was sitting by a window, watching the night unfold. It was one of those nights where everything felt still, but there was this quiet hum of emotions that couldn’t be expressed. "Heart beats like a drum, Shadows come undone" captures that intense, raw feeling of being in a state of inner conflict—where your heart races with emotion, but the world around you remains silent. It’s like being trapped in a moment, suspended between feeling and nothingness.

Walking down empty streets in my mind, I felt like the protagonist in the song—haunted by silent echoes, unable to defeat the fears that lingered in the background. "Fears we can't defeat, Lost in a trance" reflects that place where we get caught up in our own thoughts and emotions, paralyzed by things that seem too big to face. It's like you're stuck in a trance, moving but not truly living. 🌑👣

The chorus, "Midnight rain falls slow, Drowning in our sorrow," is the emotional core of the song. It speaks to the way sorrow can feel overwhelming, like you’re drowning in it, yet nobody around you can see it. There’s a lot of pain we carry that remains hidden, emotions we don’t show, yet they shape who we are and how we move through the world. "Tomorrow's a shadow" reminds us that the future feels uncertain when we’re trapped in these emotional storms. ⛈️

The verse about "Broken mirrors reflect, Memories we neglect" speaks to the idea of our past haunting us, as if broken reflections are showing us parts of ourselves that we don’t want to see. Sometimes, we neglect our memories or avoid facing parts of our past because doing so is too painful, and we think that ignoring them will make them go away. But those memories always find a way back, reflecting the parts of us we’d rather forget.

As the song moves to the bridge, "Electric pulses through veins" and "Airy whispers in the pain," it captures the overwhelming intensity of those feelings that run deep and wide. The combination of physical and emotional pain creates a kind of electric buzz in the air—a sensation that you can feel in your veins, but can’t quite explain. It’s a clash between wanting to escape the pain and feeling trapped in it. ⚡💔

Creating this song with AI was an emotional experience. I let the lyrics flow from a place of vulnerability, allowing the AI to help translate those feelings into something that could be heard and felt. It wasn’t just about writing lyrics—it was about understanding and giving voice to emotions I hadn’t fully acknowledged. With AI's help, the words became more than just lines on a page; they became a way to channel everything I was feeling into something that could connect with others.

Ultimately, "Midnight Rain" is a song about emotional depth, the complexity of sorrow, and the struggle to face your feelings. It’s about the things we carry in silence—the fears, the pain, the things left unsaid—and how they shape our lives. But it’s also a reminder that even in the slowest, darkest rain, we’re not alone in what we feel. We all experience these storms, and sometimes, just acknowledging them is the first step toward finding peace.

I hope "Midnight Rain" resonates with anyone who’s ever felt lost in their emotions, overwhelmed by the weight of their own sorrow, or caught in the stillness of a moment that feels endless. We all carry the weight of the rain, but we don’t have to face it alone. 🌧️✨

spinamp-1eef77c011c7de48b2ba.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

spinamp-75f2193807bea989dec6.description:
SCHIZOAFFECTIVE DISORDER

0.3% of the population: This means approximately 1 in every 300 people will develop schizoaffective disorder at some point in their lifetime.

1 in 200: Some sources also cite a slightly higher prevalence, estimating that 1 in every 200 people develop the condition.

Schizoaffective disorder is a mental health condition characterized by symptoms of both schizophrenia and a mood disorder. Here's a more detailed breakdown:

Key Characteristics:

Combined Symptoms: Individuals with schizoaffective disorder experience a combination of: 
Psychotic symptoms: These involve a distorted perception of reality, such as:
Hallucinations: Seeing or hearing things that aren't there (e.g., visual hallucinations, auditory hallucinations).
Delusions: False fixed beliefs that are not based on reality (e.g., believing someone is trying to harm them).
Mood disorder symptoms: These involve disturbances in mood and emotional regulation, such as:
Depression: Persistent low mood, loss of interest or pleasure in activities, feelings of hopelessness.
Bipolar disorder: Episodes of mania (elevated mood, increased energy, racing thoughts) and depression.

Types of Schizoaffective Disorder:

There are two main types of schizoaffective disorder, differentiated by the type of mood disorder present:

Bipolar Type: Characterized by episodes of mania and sometimes depression, alongside psychotic symptoms.
Depressive Type: Primarily involves episodes of depression with psychotic symptoms.
Diagnosis:

Diagnosing schizoaffective disorder can be challenging because the symptoms overlap with those of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. A thorough evaluation by a mental health professional is crucial, including:

Clinical interview: Discussing symptoms, medical history, and family history.
Mental status examination: Assessing cognitive function, mood, and thought patterns.
Ruling out other medical conditions: Certain medical conditions can cause symptoms that mimic schizoaffective disorder.
Treatment:

There is no cure for schizoaffective disorder, but effective treatment options are available to manage symptoms and improve quality of life. These often include:

Medication: Antipsychotics to manage psychotic symptoms and mood stabilizers or antidepressants to regulate mood.
Therapy: Individual therapy, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), to develop coping mechanisms, improve social functioning, and address underlying issues.
Support groups: Connecting with others facing similar challenges can provide valuable support and understanding.

Impact and Prognosis:
Schizoaffective disorder can significantly impact various aspects of life, including:

Relationships: Maintaining healthy relationships can be difficult due to the unpredictable nature of symptoms.
Work or school: Holding down a job or completing studies can be challenging.
Social functioning: Participating in social activities may become difficult due to symptoms or social withdrawal.
The prognosis for schizoaffective disorder varies depending on the severity of symptoms, adherence to treatment, and access to support systems. With proper management, individuals can experience significant improvement and live fulfilling lives.

Here are some additional resources that you may find helpful:

National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI):
https://www.nami.org/NAMI/media/NAMI-Media/Images/FactSheets/Schizoaffective-Disorder-FS.pdf

Mayo Clinic: https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/schizoaffective-disorder/symptoms-causes/syc-20354504

Mind: https://www.mind.org.uk/information-support/types-of-mental-health-problems/schizoaffective-disorder/about-schizoaffective-disorder/

Relatively Rare: Schizoaffective disorder is considered a relatively rare mental health condition compared to other disorders like anxiety or depression.
Similar Rates in Men and Women: While some research suggests women might be slightly more susceptible, overall, men and women experience schizoaffective disorder at about the same rate.

Earlier Onset in Men: Although the prevalence is similar between genders, men often develop the symptoms of schizoaffective disorder at a younger age compared to women.
It's important to note that these are estimates, and the exact prevalence of schizoaffective disorder can be challenging to determine due to several factors:

Underdiagnosis: The overlapping symptoms of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder can lead to misdiagnosis, potentially affecting the reported numbers.
Stigma: Shame or reluctance to seek help might prevent some individuals from getting diagnosed.
Despite its relative rarity, schizoaffective disorder can significantly impact the lives of those affected. Early diagnosis, access to proper treatment, and support systems are crucial for managing symptoms and improving quality of life.

spinamp-1eafb1f955c97893580f.description:
Composed on September 21, 2024.

This piece was born from a strange and beautiful memory at twilight.

One evening, as I stepped outside, a melody drifted through the air of the Kashimada shopping street — layered with oboe and strings, echoing between the sunset and the rumble of a distant train. A gentle female voice spoke through the station broadcast. And for a moment, it felt as if I glimpsed something not of this world — a fleeting, radiant scene.

Yet no matter how I searched afterward, I could never find that music again.

A friend who lives nearby said she had never heard such a broadcast. So I wrote "Ginkgo Twilight" as a quiet reply to that golden evening.

I chose the oboe deliberately, trying to capture that hazy clarity I felt then. I’ve rarely used metal wind instruments before, always thinking they might clash with New Age or traditional Chinese sounds — but that night taught me something: the beauty of an instrument lies simply in its voice.

This song resists easy classification. It flows with a Japanese-style narrative pacing, yet draws deeply from the Eastern instruments I love. Perhaps it tells the story of a traveler, catching a soft but unforgettable glimmer of hope in a foreign twilight.

May you, too, find a moment of longing — and light — within this song.

I’m new to Sound.xyz — thank you for stopping by and sharing this little memory with me.

spinamp-3a6be0ad99e110eb356a.description:
The sounds from your childhood truly never go away... I was massive *NSYNC fan as a kid and then somewhere in my adult life, I came back around to their catalog and rediscovered my nostalgic affinity for that era in music. So creating a reggae cover of an *NSYNC song was not just a goal, but an inevitability. "This I Promise You" has always stood out to me as a beautiful composition that has more of a timeless sensibility to it compared to the rest of their more era specific recordings, which made it my top choice to cover.

For my version, I brought in my love for classic Jamaican style lovers rock. Vibes like Beres Hammond, Dennis Brown & Aswad. I always felt that "This I Promise You" as a composition would fit in very well with this particular style of expression. 

The recording is 100% in house and self-produced. I'm playing live keyboards, bass, tenor sax and percussion throughout on top of all of the vocals. The most important component that I wanted to bring was making sure I kept that iconic 5-part vocal harmony throughout the chorus. I transcribed the original *NSYNC harmonies & used them in my recording as well. 

I'm extremely happy with how this recording came out and it has now become an unexpected favorite amongst my own recording catalog, as this was more of a passion project than an intentionally designed commercial release.

spinamp-69f52e6fd69b397d1c76.description:
Wołow is the name of the first town in Poland I ever got to know. It’s the name of a place that, unknowingly, would mark a significant lapse of time in my life. I began writing this song one quiet spring afternoon in the town of Wołow where pink sunsets and tones of ember in the sky that seamlessly merge with the green pastures of the fields. I sat in awe of the colours and stillness of it all, and began picking a pattern in my guitar. 
I needed to find a sound that would transmit the harshness of the environment, the warmth of the people, even the flavours of the food (which I found out to be extremely delicious). I could have never guessed that I'd find myself somewhere so random that would feel so much like home. 
Like everything in life, duality is ever present. Coming from the background that I do, I found myself in such a strange, and different place, where nothing made sense, on the other side of the world, yet everything felt so familiar.

A bull market, or bull run, is defined as a period of time where the majority of investors are buying, demand outweighs supply, market confidence is at a high, and prices are rising. If, in a given market, you see prices quickly trending upwards, this could be a sign that the majority of investors are becoming optimistic or “bullish” about the price increasing further, and may mean that you’re looking at the start of a bull market.

Investors who believe that prices will increase over time are known as “bulls.”  As investor confidence rises, a positive feedback loop emerges, which tends to draw in further investment, causing prices to continue to rise.

spinamp-984d5c2bff30c68e3b67.description:
In a groundbreaking experiment, scientists have successfully transformed light into a supersolid—a unique state of matter that exhibits properties of both solids and superfluids.
To achieve this, researchers directed laser light onto a specially engineered semiconductor platform made of aluminum gallium arsenide. The interaction between the laser and the material produced hybrid particles known as polaritons. These polaritons were confined by the platform's design, leading them to organize into a supersolid structure. 
This supersolid state is particularly intriguing because it combines the rigid, lattice-like arrangement of a solid with the frictionless flow characteristic of a superfluid. Such a dual nature has been theorized but was previously observed only in ultracold atomic systems. This experiment marks the first time light has been manipulated to exhibit supersolid properties.

Fundamental analysis vs. technical analysis
While fundamental analysis looks to a larger picture around the price of an asset - considering as many influencing factors as possible - TA is strictly focused on historical market data and market charts. While FA seeks to determine the real value of a trading asset, TA is used as a tool to predict the price action based on trading volume and past trends. Most traders and investors probably agree that both FA and TA are valuable in their own way. So instead of relying on one or another, a contextualized and balanced use of the two sounds more reasonable.

We drift within a neon sky,
where data streams and pulses fly.

through endless, unseen open doors.
We speak in whispers, texts, and waves,
our echoes crossing time’s vast caves.

Like stars that twinkle, screens ignite,
a universe of black and bright.
Our voices, once so far apart,
now touch with just a beating heart.

Yet in this world of endless thread,
where minds are linked but hands unread,
let’s not forget the earth-bound ties,
the warmth behind these glass-lit eyes.

Drift with me beyond the night,
past silver moons and nebulae bright,
where galaxies like lanterns glow,
whispers of a time we’ll never know.

A billion suns in silent flight,
woven deep in cosmic light,
their embers burn, their voices call—
reminding us we’re part of all.

The stardust in your breath and skin
once danced where new worlds now begin.
A comet’s path, a planet’s dream,
we share the same celestial stream.

No soul is lost, no spark alone,
the universe is not unknown.
Each pulse, each heart, each fleeting spark—
a thread of light in endless dark.

spinamp-58efeb9cde8174f2fc1f.description:
《Legacy of Fire》— An Epic Anthem of Bloodline Curses and Rebirth

Blending symphonic metal’s grandeur with power metal’s relentless energy, Legacy of Fire ignites a sonic inferno fueled by razor-sharp guitar riffs, thunderous double-kick drums, and haunting Latin choral chants. This high-octane anthem merges English lyricism with arcane Latin invocations (e.g., “Kael’dora ven’tara” / “Syl’varis noctis”), crafting a mythic battlefield where a son’s fury clashes against his father’s damned legacy.

Lyrical Firestorm: The verses paint a desolate throne shattered by generational sin, where the protagonist grapples with spectral echoes of paternal failure. Latin phrases like “In nomine patris, et filii, et spiritus sancti” (In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit) interweave with English poetry, evoking the solemnity of sacred rites and the wrath of divine retribution. The chorus erupts as a cathartic roar—“I bear the weight of your mistakes”—transmuting inherited pain into unyielding resolve.

Sonic Architecture: Gothic orchestral swells collide with frenetic guitar solos, while pipe organ crescendos and choirs amplify the track’s apocalyptic atmosphere. The bridge’s layered chants (“mor’talis eterni… ven’tara inferna”) spiral into a maelstrom of vengeance, symbolizing the protagonist’s metamorphosis from burdened heir to phoenix-like avenger.

Thematic Core: Beyond its blistering tempo, Legacy of Fire explores the paradox of inheritance—how flames of ancestral sin can forge, rather than consume, a new destiny. The outro’s declaration, “I am the legacy, the one you left to be,” culminates in a triumph of self-liberation, as scorched ashes birth an unbreakable resolve.

A fusion of liturgical drama and metallic ferocity, this track is a manifesto for those rising from ruin—a blazing testament to rewriting fate itself.
