addresses like …7aa3, …3baa, …259A—
all hustlin’ that “Share & Earn” loophole on Sound.xyz
to puff the numbers and stack them royalties.

In the next few minutes you’ll ride shotgun through:
• The Sybil masks he wears to mint his own tracks
• A Python script—python3 abunai_referrals.py—
scrapin’ every drop to expose who really gets paid
• Real fans, clone accounts, and the big question:
is this pure artistic grind or just a clout parade?

So strap on your headphones, let the 808 rumble,
’cause we’re blendin’ West‑Coast swagger with on‑chain journalism.
Now—turn that bass up and let the hunt begin…




Roll up on the drop, see the shares and the earns,
same link, new wallet—watch the table get turned.
From 0xbf20 all the way to 0xd753,
thirteen shiny masks, everybody screams “Look at me!”


On Sound.xyz he sparks it with a Share & Earn routine,
?referral= in the URL, his army hits the scene.
That …7aa3 account’s the beacon takin’ every wave of gold,
but he spawns fresh identities so the payout cap’s on hold.
Marshall — 0xd753 lurks tight in the corner spot,
posting only Abunai tracks, hypin’ up the lot.
Next comes Jhanak — 0xbf23, no ENS, no other stage,
catalog 100 % Abunai—Sybil locked inside the cage.



Self‑promo, self‑promo… wallet clone — Sy‑Sy‑Sybil mode on….


Then 0x7841 drops, Arkham shrieks “Alt confirmed, my dude!”,
two mints on that release, internal transfer seals the proof.
Justbeautyallaround 0xab6d shows the very same design,
Naaate 0xaf39 is marching right behind.
Real fans or tight‑knit homies? The border’s turning grey—
when the music pays your tokens, who won’t sign the payday?
But watch it: curators with ENS, seasoned IDs displayed,
mikaelkukkonen.eth, msergeevich.eth—shared hustle on parade.





Marshall, I clock you—0xd753…3baa glowin’ neon loud,
mirror‑loop hype machine, echo in the crowd.
Alexis Scott in the strobe—0x7841…259A the code,
queen of glitchy ballroom where the royalties reload.
Love for the rhythm or a mask in the maze?
Either way bytes keep dancin’, 808s set ablaze.


Roll up on the drop, see the shares and the earns,

thirteen shiny masks—want some more? here’s ten alive.

BeautifulSoup sniffs the links, tqdm spits the KPI.
Fourteen drops inspected, counters racin’ fast and free,
thirteen wallets in the ledger—from “High chance” down to “Maybe.”
If the hash keeps repeating, Sybil‑core is verified,
if the royalty flows upstream, case is closed, testified.
But Web3’s wild street rewards whoever drums up heat:
more wallets, more referrals, more tokens in the suite.



Flow on‑chain, beats in‑chain,
if art’s just hype, who splits love from gain?


And that’s the forensic rhythm, report stamped on the track,
thirteen shadows dancing to the artist’s click‑clack.
Need more masks unveiled? Just swing the baton my way:
run the script, trace the tx—let the truth groove on all day.

"Falling Apart" – A Melodic Dubstep Journey Through Heartbreak

Born from an unanticipated collaboration, Falling Apart is an emotionally charged melodic dubstep track that captures the raw intensity of heartbreak and inner conflict. The song’s evocative lyrics—ranging from restless dreams and shifting silhouettes to the struggle of sinking despite the desire to swim—reflect the turbulent aftermath of a painful relationship break-up.

The creative spark behind the track came when Tomentam, a 16-year-old producer from Sri Lanka, reached out unexpectedly. His ethereal intro and immersive verses laid the foundation for a collaboration that soon blossomed into a labor of love. Teaming up with fendi mars, who contributed passionate and heartfelt vocals, the duo poured their emotions into every beat and word. Over the course of three months, they meticulously refined the drops and production, ensuring every element resonated with the song’s bittersweet narrative.

spinamp-0c9b0ea4131cb7e1204a.description:
Creating Hero Mode was a nostalgic journey into the golden era of 90s video games. The concept began with the idea of capturing the feeling of being a kid, holding a chunky handheld console and diving into epic pixelated adventures. The hero, depicted in mid-action with a raised sword, represents that inner courage we all summoned when facing final bosses on screen. Every element—from the neon grass to the purple pixel trees—was chosen to mirror the intense yet magical atmosphere of old-school fantasy games.

The artwork was carefully constructed using pixel art techniques to maintain authenticity, with a glowing handheld console as the portal between the real and game worlds. The sunset and flying birds add a cinematic flair, symbolizing hope and freedom. The team focused on blending glitchy digital aesthetics with classic heroic imagery, aiming to evoke not just visual nostalgia, but also the emotional thrill of entering “Hero Mode” both in-game and in life.

spinamp-73d6e04850ea3575ec71.description: The circulating supply refers to the coins that are accessible to the public and should not be confused with the total supply or max supply. The total supply is used to quantify the number of coins in existence, i.e., the number of coins that were already issued minus the coins that were burned. The total supply is basically the sum of the circulating supply and the coins that are locked up in escrow. On the other hand, the max supply quantifies the maximum amount of coins that will ever exist, including the coins that will be mined or made available in the future.

spinamp-0331637a06ae34faee61.description:
In the heart of Carabanchel, a district known for its resilience and heritage, Moskoni stands as a master of sound and a pioneer of the digital age. His creation, "I Kill You BASE," transcends mere music; it serves as a profound exploration of the volatile landscapes of cryptocurrencies and NFTs, each note resonating with the uncertainties of our digital era.

The journey begins with a serene prelude, evoking a sense of anticipation and intrigue for the voyage ahead. At precisely 47 seconds, a resounding call to action, "LFG," signals the commencement of this transformative journey.

As the helmsman of this sonic vessel, Moskoni adeptly navigates through the currents of dubstep and the winds of industrial techno. Around the 1:22 mark, we reach the "Profit Paradise," a melodic oasis where gains in the ever-shifting seas of decentralized finance are celebrated.

Yet, amidst the triumphs lies the inevitability of turbulence. Approaching the 2-minute mark, the music plunges into a tempest of chaos, mirroring the unpredictability of financial markets where fortunes can change in an instant.

"Crazy Meme," introduced around the 4-minute mark, injects a moment of levity into the narrative, reminding listeners of the whimsical nature inherent in our digital discourse.

And as "Kill You" unfolds around the 4:49 mark, we are confronted with the depths of the human psyche, where the pursuit of wealth and glory can lead to darker realms.

However, from the depths emerges a renewed resolve, guiding us back to calmer waters. The composition culminates in a triumphant crescendo, a testament to the resilience of the human spirit in the face of adversity.

In a landscape where music and technology converge to reflect the complexities of our modern world, "I Kill You BASE" stands as a testament to the power of art to illuminate and inspire. Are you prepared to embark on this journey and experience the sonic revolution defining our digital age?

spinamp-0ad0763c9f8aa6bbdc75.description:
The next single from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is here! This time, we’re diving into the synthwave-inspired rock epic, "Doomsday".

I originally wrote and recorded this song back in 2016, during the sessions of my fourth album “IV”. It was based on an acapella by singer-songwriter NewShoes, titled “S T R M”. For this new version, I decided to take a different direction, not only with new lyrics, but also by transforming it from an EDM-style track into a synthwave/metal hybrid.

The lyrics were penned by the Swiss lyricist Elizabeth Auzan, who quickly envisioned the direction for the song. After having heard other songs where she’s provided lyrical work, I was confident her style would be a perfect fit, and I’m glad to say I was right. In fact, I’d go even further to say that it’s probably some of the better lyrical work on the record as a whole.

In terms of the BIONICLE-lore, I’d like to believe the song could fit somewhere prior or during the Great Cataclysm, when the Great Spirit Mata Nui was put into a deep sleep by the Makuta, causing a major earthquake throughout the Matoran Universe. I think that’s what makes “Doomsday” vastly different from other songs on the record, as it’s completely open to interpretation.

Stylistically, I aimed to blend alternative metal and synth-pop, using more synths and electronic percussion instead of acoustic instruments. The Swedish band Smash Into Pieces, as well as the Norwegian hitmakers A-ha specifically come to mind as significant inspirations for this sound.

Aside from my contributions on synths and electronic drums, guitars were done by two fantastic musicians in the own right, Mitch Brody and Jim Lawlor. Both proved to have a very adaptive and versatile way of collaborating, which only proved to be a major asset. Lastly, Mike Ousey’s vocal work on this song are outstanding. He stepped in at a time where I was struggling to find a suitable singer for the song, and I’m so grateful he did. The efforts of these three musicians truly brought the song to life, and I deeply appreciate their time and dedication.

May love and peace be with you all!

ADHD stands for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder. It's a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by:

Executive dysfunction: This means difficulties with managing tasks, planning, and controlling impulses.

Symptoms: These can include:
Inattention: Trouble focusing, easily distracted, forgetting things.
Hyperactivity: Excessive fidgeting, restlessness, difficulty sitting still.
Impulsivity: Acting without thinking, interrupting others, blurting things out.
Here's some additional information about ADHD:

Types: There are three main types of ADHD:

Predominantly Inattentive: Mostly struggles with inattention.
Predominantly Hyperactive-Impulsive: Mostly struggles with hyperactivity and impulsivity.
Combined Type: Has significant symptoms of both inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity.

Impact: ADHD can affect a person's academic performance, relationships, and daily functioning.

Diagnosis: ADHD is diagnosed by a mental health professional using specific criteria and evaluations.

Treatment: While there's no cure, ADHD can be effectively managed through a combination of:

Medication: Stimulants are commonly used to improve focus and attention.
Behavioral therapy: Techniques to learn coping skills, manage impulsivity, and improve organization.

Educational support: Accommodations in school settings to help children with ADHD succeed.

spinamp-54b72910f5b8b4fde8af.description:
"Where Is Your Heart" dives deep into the complexities of loyalty, love, and the unyielding chase for success within the music industry. This song narrates the personal journey of an artist wrestling with the dichotomy between the genuine bonds formed on the path to success and the often superficial relationships that come with fame and fortune. The hook, poignant and questioning, serves as a recurring plea for sincerity amidst the chaos of changing relationships and priorities. It asks, at its core, for the real, unwavering love that was promised, questioning the authenticity of those who claim loyalty but show otherwise through their actions.

The verses paint a vivid picture of the trials and tribulations faced by those striving for greatness in the music world. They touch on themes of brotherhood, betrayal, and the relentless pursuit of wealth, all while seeking to maintain a sense of self and genuine connection. The lyrics encapsulate the artist's internal conflict—navigating the highs and lows of the industry, distinguishing real friends from those merely attracted to success, and ultimately, searching for true love and loyalty in a world that often prioritizes material gain over genuine relationships. "Where Is Your Heart" is not just a song; it's a reflection on the personal cost of success and the quest for authenticity in a world that often feels devoid of it.

spinamp-34a8a7ffd9cd88a386b8.description:
A LONER is someone who prefers spending time by themselves over being with other people. They often feel comfortable and energized being on their own. 
Here's a breakdown of the term:

Social Preference: Loner describes someone who finds solitude preferable to social interaction. They might enjoy activities like reading, spending time in nature, or pursuing hobbies that can be done independently.

Not Necessarily Lonely: It's important to distinguish loners from lonely people. 
Loneliness is a feeling of sadness or isolation that can arise even when someone is surrounded by others. 
Loners, on the other hand, choose to be alone and may not feel lonely at all.

Reasons for Being a Loner: 
There are many reasons why someone might be a loner. Some people are naturally introverted, meaning they gain energy from spending time alone and expend energy in social situations. Others may have had negative social experiences that make them prefer solitude.

Here are some different types of loners:

Intentional Positive Loners: These are people who have chosen a solitary lifestyle because it suits their personality or goals.

Unintentional Loners: These individuals may feel isolated or ostracized and struggle to form social connections.

Short-Term Loners: Everyone needs some alone time to recharge. 
Even the most social people enjoy occasional solitude.

While being a loner itself isn't a mental health issue, there can be a connection between social isolation and mental health. Here's how being a loner can be linked to some mental health struggles:

Loneliness: This is a key one. While loners prefer solitude, prolonged isolation can lead to feelings of loneliness, sadness, and emptiness.

Depression: Loneliness and social withdrawal are common symptoms of depression, and chronic loneliness can increase the risk of developing depression.

Anxiety: Social anxiety can make it difficult to connect with others, which can reinforce loner tendencies and vice versa. Feeling isolated can also increase general anxiety levels.

Low Self-Esteem: Lack of social interaction can sometimes lead to negative self-perceptions and feelings of worthlessness.

Social Skills Difficulties: Limited social interaction can make it harder to develop strong social skills, which can then make future interactions more challenging.

It's important to remember, not all loners will experience these problems. Some people genuinely enjoy their solitude and have healthy social connections when they do choose to interact with others.

Here are some signs that a loner might be struggling:

Feeling constantly empty or sad
Loss of interest in activities they used to enjoy
Difficulty sleeping or changes in appetite
Withdrawing from social interaction even more than usual
Engaging in self-harming behaviors
Suicidal thoughts or ideation

If you're concerned about yourself or someone you know who is a loner, it's important to reach out for help.  A mental health professional can help develop healthy coping mechanisms and strategies for building social connections.

spinamp-a65e8cf1b8a34229e781.description:
"Mirror May" was born on a quiet, rainy night in May—the eve of my 30th birthday. It was the first time I truly felt fear about the future. I had just ended a call with my family, coffee in hand, listening to the rain tap against the window. It wasn’t a moment of crisis—but of quiet confusion, emotional clutter, and subtle anxiety.

In contrast, I imagined a parallel scene: a clear, starry May night in the city, where people sip espresso in luxury cafés, thriving in a post-bubble haze of optimism, wealth, and curated lifestyles. In this mirror world, I was someone who appeared free and radiant, dancing through distractions with ease—but inside, there was an eerie hollowness.

This song explores the tension between these two states—the grounded, anxious "A" and the dreamy, detached "B." Performed in a jazz-soul-blues blend, the track captures the warmth of escape and the cold truth beneath it. B leads most of the vocals, embodying the glossy illusion, while A lingers in silence, watching from the rain.

"Mirror May" is a reflection of the Hanged Man from tarot: suspended between truths, seeing clearly only when everything is upside down. It’s my way of documenting a pivotal emotional moment—messy, honest, and beautifully in between.

spinamp-48b5418b5d33b95addc6.description:
In his latest track "Truffle Tea Talks," Rico P takes us on a lyrical journey that transcends the typical themes of modern hip-hop. This song is a sophisticated narrative about intellectual connection and the shared ambition between Rico P and a beautiful woman striving for greatness together.

"Truffle Tea Talks" is more than just a song; it's a lyrical symposium. The title itself is a metaphor, blending the luxury and rarity of truffles with the intimate, thoughtful setting of a tea conversation. This setting becomes the backdrop for a deep and meaningful dialogue between the protagonist and a captivating woman.

The song opens with a smooth, bouncy house beat that sets a refined tone. Rico P immediately delves into a conversation about life's bigger picture. Through his verses, he articulates the beauty of engaging in an intellectual exchange, where both individuals bring their thoughts and dreams to the table. This isn't just small talk; it's a profound discussion about personal growth, aspirations, and the journey to self-improvement.

The chorus of "Truffle Tea Talks" is an anthem of mutual success. It celebrates the idea that achieving dreams is more fulfilling when done in tandem with someone who shares your vision. The synergy between the two characters is palpable, emphasizing that their combined efforts and shared victories are what truly elevate their lives. They are not just surviving; they are thriving together, pushing each other to be the best versions of themselves.

"Truffle Tea Talks" is a testament to the power of intellectual companionship and shared ambition. Through his eloquent lyrics and sophisticated soundscape, Rico P captures the essence of what it means to build a future with someone who not only understands your dreams but actively participates in achieving them. This track is an ode to the beauty of deep connections and the transformative power of striving for success together.

spinamp-e32b6385ac34cd517dff.description:
Autism, also formally known as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by:
Key Features:

Social Communication Difficulties: Individuals with ASD may struggle with:
Understanding nonverbal cues like facial expressions and body language.
Engaging in back-and-forth conversation.
Developing and maintaining relationships.
Restricted and Repetitive Behaviors or Interests: This can include:
Repetitive behaviors like hand flapping, rocking, or lining up objects.
Intense focus on specific interests or activities, often to the exclusion of others.
Difficulty with change in routine or environment.
Spectrum:

ASD is a "spectrum" disorder because individuals experience these characteristics to varying degrees. This means:
The severity of symptoms can differ significantly from person to person.
Some individuals may require more support than others.
People with ASD can possess a wide range of strengths and weaknesses in areas like learning, sensory processing, and cognitive abilities.
Developmental Disorder:

ASD is considered a developmental disorder because symptoms typically appear in early childhood, often within the first two years.
Causes:

The exact causes of ASD are still under investigation, but it's believed to be a combination of genetic and environmental factors.
No Cure:

There is no cure for ASD, but early intervention and support services can significantly improve an individual's functioning and quality of life.
Here are some additional points to remember:

Every individual with ASD experiences the condition differently. Avoid generalizations and focus on understanding the specific needs and strengths of each person.
Autism is not an illness. It's a different way of thinking and processing information.
People with ASD can live fulfilling lives. With the right support, they can thrive in their communities and reach their full potential.

There was a town where dreams always seemed to hover just out of reach—like fireflies trapped in glass. People lived quietly, their hearts beating to the slow, predictable rhythm of routine. But one night, a sound broke through the silence.

It started as a whisper, a flicker of something electric, running through the veins of a restless soul. A young musician, tired of waiting for the “right time,” picked up their instrument and let out everything they had kept bottled inside—longing, hunger, fire. The melody wasn’t just a song; it was an ignition point, a spark that could set the world ablaze.

As the music pulsed through the town, something shifted. Windows rattled. People felt their own buried passions stir. Some ran toward it, drawn in by the raw, unchained energy. Others feared it, recognizing it as the sound of change, of everything they had been too afraid to chase.

But the musician didn’t care. They had waited long enough. They weren’t asking for permission anymore. They played louder, faster—fervent, eager, unstoppable. The song became a force of nature, lifting the town from its slumber. Dreams that had been caged cracked open. Fireflies escaped.

And in that moment, the world felt alive.

No one knew where the musician would go next, only that they would never stop playing.

Because once a fire is lit, it never burns the same way again.

spinamp-9808909185a793036cad.description: “On The Floor” is about how I felt at home and safe on the dance floor during a tough period of my life. Regular work and life can be too much or too foreign but on the dancefloor, you have this safety in anonymity as well as a strong speechless connection to those around you. This comes from my experiences in the Brooklyn underground electronic music scene. The track itself is meant to provide that sonic space to feel comfortable in a slow but euphoric dance. I personally crave these spaces so I wanted to try to share one of my own.

spinamp-8468ead766d0d84f194d.description:
Episode 004 of Hyper Rave features T5UMUT5UMU, a Tokyo-based producer known for his genre-defying approach to electronic music. His discography includes releases on labels such as Sneaker Social Club, Unizone, FunctionLab, Loveless Records, and Beat Machine Records . Notable works include the EPs Gen, FTL, and Magnetic Field, as well as the single "Bolt" . T5UMUT5UMU's music blends elements of grime, dubstep, techno, and breakbeat, creating a sound that is both experimental and dancefloor-ready. His on-chain art projects further showcase his commitment to pushing the boundaries of digital creativity.

The first 30 minutes of this episode are curated by Sunshine Vendetta, offering a selection that sets the tone for T5UMUT5UMU's immersive mix. Hyper Rave continues to deliver episodes that capture the essence of the underground, providing listeners with a journey through the evolving landscape of electronic music.

Cuando el sol se alza en el horizonte y los rayos dorados iluminan las calles, me dejo llevar por la energía vibrante del Beforeoide. Es un tiempo de preparación y anticipación, donde la mente se afina y el cuerpo se llena de vitalidad para enfrentar lo que el día tiene por delante. Me sumerjo en la atmósfera que me rodea, cargada de la promesa de nuevas oportunidades y desafíos, navegando con la certeza de que cada paso me lleva más cerca de mis metas.
Por la noche, Afteroide:
Cuando la luna toma el relevo del sol y las estrellas titilan en el cielo oscuro, llega el momento del Afteroide. Es la hora de la reflexión, de dejar que la serenidad de la noche me envuelva. Aquí, en la tranquilidad de la oscuridad, encuentro un espacio para recapitular el día, digerir las experiencias vividas y preparar el espíritu para el descanso merecido. Las tensiones se disipan mientras la mente se aquieta, cerrando el ciclo que comenzó con el amanecer.

Bass Poetry Atlas, dropped like a meteor in August 2024 by Seva M., is a wild, heart-thumping Drum’n’Bass frenzy! SEVEN tracks, SEVEN cultures—each one an explosion of beats smashing into the poetry of 19th and early 20th-century legends. The drops? They’ll slap you sideways, and those vocals? OH, they’ll make your bones rattle!

Next up is A Song From the Player Queen—a roaring mix of Drum’n’Bass pounding against the rich, intricate sounds of Indian music! William Butler Yeats’ 1897 poem has been reborn into a vibrant clash of tabla rhythms and relentless basslines, creating an intoxicating blend of ancient and modern. It’s a wild ride that will make you feel like you’re dancing on a storm cloud above a raga!

The music carries a dark, futuristic vibe, with sharp electronic beats that build an atmosphere of tension and mystery. Glitch elements are woven into the sound, as if the music itself is breaking apart, reinforcing the theme of a world controlled by technology.

At its core, the song poses a powerful question: Is the world we see truly real, or just a carefully crafted simulation? Yet, beyond the layers of doubt and control, there’s a spark of hope. It’s not just about escaping the illusion — it’s about having the courage to resist and uncover the truth.

"Matrix" is more than just a song — it’s an emotional journey of breaking free, driven by bold digital sounds and thought-provoking lyrics.

spinamp-9f5994b0dffc3fce64fe.description:
The Circulator is the lifeblood of the decentralized world, the unseen force that ensures value flows freely across the blockchain. Neither a ruler nor a subject, the Circulator exists beyond control, moving seamlessly between nodes, embodying the essence of trustless exchange. In a system without borders, without masters, they are the pulse that keeps the network alive—bridging peers, transferring energy, and ensuring equilibrium in a digital realm built on unbreakable code. Every transaction, every shift of value, is a silent affirmation of the Circulator’s path, where freedom is not granted but inherently woven into the system itself.

This track captures the constant, rhythmic movement of value—from whispers of small exchanges to roaring tides of liquidity. Tribal beats, metallic pulses, and harmonic chants evoke the mysticism of an unseen force, while layered melodies reflect the ebb and flow of a network in motion. The Circulator does not dictate; it listens, adapts, and moves where the system requires. The song’s energy is both fluid and unyielding, an anthem to the decentralized spirit that ensures the blockchain breathes, thrives, and remains forever in motion.

"Forget You!" isn't just a track; it's a release, a bold declaration of breaking free from the chains of past pain and toxicity. Just Atone bares his soul, inviting listeners to join him on his journey of healing and self-discovery.

As he walks the path toward healing, Just Atone shares his story with the hope that it resonates with others grappling with similar struggles. Through his music, he sends a message of resilience, empowerment, and the enduring strength found in embracing vulnerability.

Join Just Atone as he puts his demons to rest and embraces a brighter future in "Forget You!", available now on sound.xyz.

spinamp-f3b3af37ddcb07af84d5.description:
Genesis Edition 1 for Each Bitcoin of the Genesis Block. 

At the dawn of a new digital age, Genesis of the Coin stands as the anthem of decentralization, a mythic retelling of the first block—the birth of a revolution. Inspired by blockchain’s origins and the ghostly presence of its creator, the track weaves cyberpunk mysticism with ancient prophecy, merging futuristic soundscapes with ritualistic chants. This isn’t just a song; it’s an invocation of a new order, where no rulers govern and no kings dictate the ledger of truth. Every beat pulses like a block being mined, every voice echoes the forces that sustain the chain—The Miner, The Validator, The Lightning, The Circulator, The Protector, and The Oracle. Together, they chant the genesis into existence, forging the eternal link between past and future, code and consciousness.

The sonic architecture of Genesis of the Coin is as layered as the blockchain itself. Tribal drums beat like the heart of the network, metallic echoes represent the forging of transactions, and ethereal whispers embody the unseen architects of this digital frontier. The spoken-word intro calls forth the mystery of creation, setting the stage for a powerful, anthemic chorus that binds the voices into a singular force. Inspired by the myth of Satoshi Nakamoto, the song channels the ghost in the machine, a rebellion coded in numbers, a ledger that defies manipulation. As the final words fade into the hum of a block being mined, the listener is left with the lingering realization: this is more than music—it’s a movement, an eternal chain set in motion.

spinamp-4471774b4a7fe3c30274.description:
Blueburst, the musical brainchild of guitarist/vocalist Craig Douglas Miller, defies the notion that it's ever too late to pursue one's passion, resurrecting a music career once thought lost.

After major label interest for his 1990s band, The Reach, never quite panned out, Miller entered a 20 year period of musical hibernation due to untreated clinical depression and writer's block. 

However, a fortuitous meeting with legendary guitarist Marty Willson-Piper changed everything. Inspired by Willson-Piper's guidance, Miller reconstructed his home studio, and completed an album's worth of original songs. 

Together, Miller and Willson-Piper deliver a lush, guitar-based sound rooted in '80s alternative and post-punk, but with a timeless feel. Meanwhile, themes of seizing life's fleeting moments and striving to leave a mark on the world permeate the sonic tapestry. 

"Amplify Me" comes from Blueburst's debut album, Significance, which dropped in October 2023. A new album is in the works for 2025.

With each note, “Singing of Soul” unfolds like a dream—soft, melancholic, yet deeply soothing. The subtle rhythms provide a heartbeat beneath the floating melodies, creating a meditative atmosphere that resonates with the soul.

For collectors who seek music that calms, heals, and inspires, this piece is a rare gem—a moment of stillness in a restless world.

spinamp-06f6215536e379951867.description:
**"Homeward to Forever"**  

A haunting ballad wrapped in melancholy and hope, *Homeward to Forever* tells the story of a young woman who has wandered through life’s trials, carrying the weight of loss and the echoes of love now beyond reach. With each step, she has braved the world, endured the sorrow of empty chairs and silent rooms, yet the longing never fades—the longing for home, for the embrace of those who once made the world warm and whole.  

As the music swells, her voice soars with aching beauty, confessing the loneliness of the years, the bittersweet victories, the nights spent whispering to ghosts. But now, she is weary of the endless road, the struggle of the living. The chorus is a plea, a promise: she will return, not just in memory, but in spirit, to the place where love never fades.  

With each verse, the melody weaves a tale of surrender—not to despair, but to the quiet calling of eternity. The final refrain is neither sorrowful nor afraid; it is the sound of a soul finding its way home, where the hands that once held her still wait, where the voices she lost now call her name.

spinamp-c0d96bd014a1dd312353.description:
🌌✨ "Wishing Stars" is more than just a song; it's a journey into the heart and soul of the creator, born from the quiet moments of reflection under a starry sky. The idea came to me in a peaceful state, where thoughts and emotions seemed to blend with the gentle whisper of the wind. 

As the moonlight bathed everything in soft, silver hues, I found myself drawn to the simple yet profound idea of wishing upon stars—something so universal, yet so deeply personal. 🌙💫 The lyrics are like a whisper in the night, a gentle reminder that despite everything, hope is always there, shining brightly in the darkness. 

The process of creating this piece was incredibly emotional and meditative. I wrote the words in a flow, almost as if the night itself was speaking to me, sharing its wisdom and dreams. The peaceful atmosphere, the rustling of leaves, the cool breeze—it all became part of the story I wanted to tell. 

💭 At the time of creating this track, I was in a reflective mood—thinking about the future, the things I've hoped for, and the deep connection we all share with the universe. There’s something magical about the idea that, no matter where we are, we’re all under the same sky, wishing for the same things. 

✨ The song is a symbol of connection, of shared dreams, and the kind of hope that doesn't fade away. I wanted to capture that fleeting feeling you get when you look up at the stars and feel like you can touch them, that sense of wonder and possibility. 🌠 

As always, this track was made with the help of AI, allowing me to explore new creative paths and give life to a song that reflects these very thoughts and emotions. It's not just music—it's a piece of a dream, a whisper to the stars. 🌟

I hope it resonates with you the way it did with me when I first wrote it. When you listen to "Wishing Stars," I want you to feel that same sense of calm and possibility. Whether you're chasing your own dreams or simply finding comfort in the quiet beauty of the night, this song is for you. 💖 

Let's keep wishing, keep dreaming, and keep believing. 🌙✨

spinamp-653b7a236963932bad0e.description:
“Bliss” 
Is more than a song—it’s a state of mind. Born from pain, forged in growth, it reflects the journey from darkness to light. If you’ve ever fought your own demons and found peace on the other side, this is for you.

To reach a state of happiness, oblivious of everything else that is not dependent upon anything but of your own nature. “Sad Guru”.
Blissfulness is not something that you earn from outside, it is something that you dig deep down into yourself and find it. Once you are in touched with it, you are in it, you become that state of mind.
When you become blissful you are more free, Less burdened by individuality. This is how I felt after digging deep down into finding myself. 
I’ve been walking on a tightrope string trying to keep my balance, A lot of dark days fighting my own demons, muddy roads, depression, sometimes things gets so difficult all I could think of is just give up, you can’t anymore, you are done but that’s the negative voice and life continues. Sometimes you’re either the hammer or You're The Nail. 
And this time I chose to tap away every form of negativity and welcome change with open arms. Being in the present and letting go of the past, Being aware and conscious of what i was holding onto and what i must let go of. 
Uncover the humor in life, once i started doing those things i experienced a whole different energy. “BLISS” 
This EP is more of an escape a form of joy and happiness a diamond made from the rough, to any one out there going through hardships any kind of struggle. This EP tells a story of a person that went through similar obstacles like you but found a way to manoeuvre through them.
When you become blissful you are more free
Less burden and now more ready than ever for your new journey. So
“Don’t Chase Just Replace”.

spinamp-9bf276ffc98a0da7ecea.description:
In a world where music has become an integral part of daily life, remarkable devices known as musical spheres have emerged. These spheres are crafted from a rare metal capable of capturing and preserving sound vibrations in their purest form.

It all begins in a workshop where a group of talented musicians and engineers are working on a new musical instrument project. They aim to create something that can convey the energy of creativity and allow each sound to penetrate the listener's soul deeply.

The foundation of their invention is the handpan — a remarkable instrument that produces melodies through light touches. But they go further: each handpan they create is surrounded by a sphere filled with unique vibrations. When a musician touches the handpan, the sphere begins to glow, and sparks fly from the touches like magical fireflies. These sparks are the visible manifestation of the sound's depth, its emotional richness, and its energetic power.

Each sound extracted from the sphere has its own depth of immersion. Low tones penetrate the very core of the soul, evoking a sense of tranquility and peace. High notes, on the contrary, lift the mood, filling the listener with energy and joy. Middle tones create a feeling of harmony, as if the world around is filled with a perfect symphony.

Over time, these musical spheres start to be used not only for music. They become tools for meditation, healing, and even communication. People learn to express their feelings and thoughts through sound vibrations, creating new, unprecedented forms of art.

The creation of musical spheres is a tale of how the energy of creativity can transform into something more than just sound. It is a story of magic that arises when a person and music become one, creating a world where each sound has its own unique depth of immersion.

Santiago Martínez, known as "The UFO Hunter of Casares," is an intriguing figure in the field of ufology, especially in Cantabria, Spain. For over fifteen years, Santiago has dedicated his life to observing and documenting unexplained luminous phenomena, particularly in the Alsa Reservoir area. This location has become his personal sanctuary, where he regularly visits, often accompanied by scientists, specialists, and curious individuals from around the world, to witness these phenomena.

Since childhood, Santiago has experienced encounters with the unknown. Mysterious lights and sensations of invisible presences surrounded him from a young age, causing him fear and confusion in his early years. However, over time, he began seeking answers in literature and research on the UFO phenomenon, leading him to accept his role as an observer and communicator of the inexplicable.

Santiago's sightings are not just ordinary observations; they are deeply personal and emotional. Throughout his life, he has witnessed UFOs during crucial moments, such as the deaths of loved ones, deepening his belief that these entities have a special interest in his life. Despite the personal tragedies that have coincided with these encounters, Santiago has not stopped searching or documenting these experiences.

His dedication is such that he has tattooed the different types of crafts he has seen on his body, including a crossed-out cross, symbolizing his disdain for the Church, which he blames for keeping humanity ignorant of the true nature of the universe and the beings that inhabit it.

Now living a life away from public exposure, Santiago is reluctant to give interviews, though he continues to receive visits from those interested in his work. He spends his days reviewing and organizing the vast archive of material he has collected over the years, while at night, when conditions allow, he continues his watch at the reservoir.

His relationship with these phenomena is ambivalent; he feels that the beings piloting these crafts are intelligent and play with humans, but he does not perceive them to have harmful intentions. Despite his fragile health, which has led him to suffer a heart attack, Santiago cannot resist returning to the reservoir, driven by an internal force that constantly calls him to remain in contact with the unknown. Although he does not understand why these beings approach him, Santiago resigns himself to his role as a witness and messenger of what he has seen, maintaining a mix of curiosity, resignation, and a certain sadness in his endless quest for understanding.

spinamp-e5aa96579abbf6278379.description:
"Where to Go" is a deeply introspective track that delves into the internal struggles and uncertainties faced by an individual on their journey through personal growth and self-discovery. At its heart, this song captures the essence of feeling lost and seeking direction, a universal experience that resonates deeply with listeners navigating their own paths in life. The hook encapsulates this quest for purpose and identity, oscillating between moments of doubt and clarity, reflecting the inner dialogue of someone wrestling with their place in the world and their ability to make an impact.

Throughout the verses, the narrative unfolds, revealing the challenges of overcoming external skepticism and internal insecurities. The lyrics poignantly address the feelings of isolation and betrayal that can accompany personal evolution, particularly when one's ambitions or successes seem to alienate them from their peers. The artist articulates a profound sense of loneliness and misunderstanding, yet there's a persistent undertone of resilience and determination. This determination is a testament to the belief in one's potential and the conviction that despite the hardships, there is a path forward—a way to break free from the constraints of doubt and negativity.

"Where to Go" is not just a song about the struggles of growth and the search for direction; it's an anthem for perseverance and self-belief. It acknowledges the darkness that can cloud our journey but ultimately shines a light on the strength and grit required to push through. This track serves as a reminder that while the road may be fraught with uncertainty, the power to navigate it lies within us, fueled by the knowledge of our own worth and the unyielding desire to find our place in the world.

A Hymn to the Evening
By Phillis Wheatley Peters

Soon as the sun forsook the eastern main
The pealing thunder shook the heav'nly plain;
Majestic grandeur! From the zephyr's wing,
Exhales the incense of the blooming spring.
Soft purl the streams, the birds renew their notes,
And through the air their mingled music floats.
Through all the heav'ns what beauteous dies are spread!
But the west glories in the deepest red:
So may our breasts with ev'ry virtue glow,
The living temples of our God below!
Fill'd with the praise of him who gives the light,
And draws the sable curtains of the night,
Let placid slumbers sooth each weary mind,
At morn to wake more heav'nly, more refin'd;
So shall the labours of the day begin
More pure, more guarded from the snares of sin.
Night's leaden sceptre seals my drowsy eyes,
Then cease, my song, till fair Aurora rise.

spinamp-68c6d8771c7f3c1bc504.description:
Lost in Myself" is a deeply introspective song that explores the emotions of confusion, loss, and the search for inner peace. The lyrics delve into a state of being lost, both physically and mentally, and the struggle to reconnect with one's self. It’s a journey through uncertainty, with the desire to break free from the haze and find clarity. This song takes listeners through a process of self-discovery, battling through the noise of the past, and ultimately, finding a way back to who we truly are.

The Fog of Uncertainty (Verse 1)
The song opens with a scene of waking up in the mist, a metaphor for a state of mind clouded by confusion. The feelings are distant and hard to grasp, as if they exist far away, out of reach. The shadows dancing and swaying in the light of the grey create a haunting atmosphere, reflecting the ambiguity and uncertainty of the moment. This verse sets the tone of emotional disconnection, where the world feels distant, and clarity is elusive.

The Struggle Within (Verse 2)
As the journey continues, the lyrics speak of heartbeats in the dark and the lack of spark within the soul. This verse represents the emotional emptiness felt when we are disconnected from our true selves. The search for meaning seems futile, with no remark or indication of where to go. The stark environment mirrors the isolation and internal struggle that the narrator is facing. It’s a moment of vulnerability, where every step forward feels uncertain.

Losing Touch with Courage (Chorus)
The chorus encapsulates the theme of the song: the feeling of being lost and drifting, without a clear direction. The narrator speaks of forgetting what it means to be brave, perhaps having lost their courage in the face of overwhelming challenges. The endless haze symbolizes a mental fog, where clarity is obscured, and the maze represents the complicated path that lies ahead. It’s a moment of surrender, where the narrator is caught between finding a way out and being consumed by their own confusion.

Haunting Echoes of the Past (Verse 3)
In this verse, whispers of the past resurface, and echoes that don’t last remind the narrator of what’s been left behind. These fading memories are holding them back from moving forward. It speaks to the difficulty of letting go of the past, and how the past can continue to haunt us if we allow it. The verse highlights the fleeting nature of time and how the weight of unaddressed memories can distort our present reality.

The Call for Healing (Bridge)
The bridge brings a glimmer of hope. Voices in the choir lift the narrator from the mire, offering a sense of support and comfort. The songs carry them higher, suggesting that music and connection with others can help heal the wounds that have held them down. The fire represents the pain and struggles the narrator has faced, and the desire to burn it away symbolizes the wish to move beyond the pain and start anew. This part of the song suggests that healing is possible, but it requires the strength to rise above the fire.

Returning to Courage (Final Chorus)
The final chorus repeats the theme of loss and searching, but it is clear that the journey is ongoing. The narrator is still drifting in the haze, but the cycle of reflection, struggle, and hope suggests that the path to self-discovery is far from over. There’s a sense that the narrator is working toward finding their way through the maze, reclaiming their bravery, and regaining their sense of self. It’s a reminder that even in the darkest moments, the search for meaning continues.

"Lost in Myself" is an emotional journey about finding oneself amid confusion and loss. The song speaks to the process of confronting internal battles, struggling to break free from the haze, and ultimately finding hope through music, memories, and the strength to move forward. It’s a story of rediscovery, of seeking clarity in the chaos, and of learning to embrace courage once again.

spinamp-29849fc8157015a625d2.description:
Imposter Syndrome is a psychological phenomenon where people doubt their accomplishments and skills, despite evidence of their competence. It can feel like a constant fear of being exposed as a fraud or phony.

Here's how it can impact mental health:

Self-doubt and anxiety: People with imposter syndrome constantly question their abilities, leading to anxiety and insecurity.

Difficulty accepting praise: They may downplay compliments or attribute success to luck rather than their own skill.

Discouragement and fear of failure: The fear of being exposed as a fraud can be paralyzing, leading to procrastination and avoidance of challenges.

Perfectionism: They may set unrealistically high standards for themselves, leading to frustration and burnout.

Overall, imposter syndrome can significantly impact self-esteem and well-being. It can hold people back from taking on new opportunities and reaching their full potential.

Welcome, traveler, to a place where time bends and the echoes of the past resonate through every note.

Imagine a cold, dark night in the far north, where the gods of old still walk the earth, their stories carried on the wind. 

This is where MØRK was born, in the shadow of myths, under the watchful eye of ancient spirits. But tonight, those myths have been given new life, wrapped in the deep, resonant tones of an album that defies the boundaries of time and genre.

HELLIG isn’t just a collection of songs - it’s a passage through the realms of the forgotten and the future. It’s where the ferocity of death metal collides with the introspection of alternative sounds, creating something that’s both familiar and strange, like a dream half-remembered. 

The rhythms here are more than beats - they’re heartbeats of a world long past, echoing in the modern age.

Close your eyes. Let the music pull you in, like the undertow of a deep, dark sea. Picture the great halls of Valhalla, where the gods feast and warriors sing, but hear it now through the filter of the present, where every growl and every whisper tells a story. 

This is HELLIG, a sacred space where the old meets the new, where shadows dance with light.

In the world of MØRK, nothing is as it seems. The heavy, relentless force of death metal is softened by the intricate melodies that weave through each track, like threads of light in a tapestry of darkness. 

This album, HELLIG, is a testament to the power of myth, to the stories that refuse to fade, and to the music that keeps them alive.

So as you stand here tonight, know that you’re not just listening - you’re part of a journey, a saga that spans generations. HELLIG is your guide, your map to the world of MØRK, where every sound is a step deeper into the unknown, where every silence is a breath held in anticipation.

Welcome to HELLIG, where the old gods still speak, where the shadows come to life, and where the music is more than just sound—it’s a passage through time itself. Let the album wash over you, let it guide you through the darkness and into the light. 

This is MØRK. This is HELLIG.

SRA stands for “Source Recordings Augmentations”, product of the experimentation with audio that has been reshaped many times. It embraces Blockchain technology in the form of NFTs, setting a new standard in the way G89 Records releases music. By leveraging this approach, we can offer true digital ownership, ensure fair compensation for our artists, and streamline revenue distribution through smart contracts. NFTs also provide a unique way for fans to support our art, while reducing reliance on middlemen, increasing transparency. We believe this shift marks the next logical step in the evolution of the music and arts ecosystem, benefiting considerably all parties involved.

--

Recorded and mixed by William Jourdain (Quebec, Canada)
Mastered by J. David Lucio S. at G89 Records Studios (Santiago, Chile)
Cover artwork by William Jourdain (Quebec, Canada)
Released by G89 Records (Santiago, Chile)
Cat# G89R016

--

About:

William Jourdain, also known under the moniker of Automatisme, began his music project in 2011 and since then has been publishing on various labels, such as Constellation, Mille Plateaux, and Outlines, while simultaneously being active as an art historian and curator. His generative ambient dub techno music is continually reshaped in the studio. This album is a compilation of post-produced sound archives, including stems, presets, and templates dating from 2011 to the present day.

Over 20 nationalities, 60 artists, and one city that brought them together: ISTANBUL.

This project is a gift to every refugee musician across the world. We live with the same feelings, united by the power of music and shared experiences.

“Longa Samai” is not just a piece of music, it is a meeting of cultures, blending of "Longa" music style and "Samai Saqeel" 10/8 rhythm to tell stories of struggle, survival, and hope. The video features moments with the musicians who brought this piece to life, intertwined with glimpses of many other artists who have been part of the Refugee Guitars Orchestra - a project born from shared dreams and the power of art to connect and heal.

Refugee Guitars Orchestra, envisioned and directed by Omar Alkilani, serves as a vibrant project where a diverse group of refugee musicians come together to create a fusion of traditional and modern music. Each project becomes a dynamic collaboration, with different refugee musicians participating. Since its inception in 2019 this artistic initiative has already produced an E.P that showcase the blending of different cultures from all, over the world. Looking ahead the project aims to transform these creations into events and music videos envisioning a journey that celebrates the universal language of music, A journey through sound, stories, and the soul of a city became both a home and a challenge! #istanbul

"Harmonic Universal Resonator"
The Golden Tuning Technology of 432 Hertz


I’ve been experimenting with 432 Hz since 2019, ever since I came across this information, I became very passionate about the power and the sacred nature of sound. Music and everything in this universe , at its core, is a frequency. Everything is alive, everything is vibrating.

In my personal quest, for self-discovery, sound always played an important role. I began using sound to meditate, making much easier to concentrate and achieve profound meditational states. The use of binaural beats, isochronic tones, solfeggio frequencies and other sacred frequencies proved me over time the its immense power. Sound has deep connections into our emotions, thoughts, and even physiological responses.

Throughout history for thousands of years human beings have been using sound to access deeper states of consciousness, expand awareness and heal the body. Chanting, singing bowls, meditation gongs, and mantras are some ways we've used sound for these benefits.

The Impact on Human Consciousness

Our brain processes information electrically, communicating with cellular structures within specific frequency bands. This understanding forms the basis of how external frequencies can influence our perceptions and states of mind.

Every emotional state generates its own frequency. Hate resonates differently from love, just as conflict-filled environments emit distinct frequencies. These frequencies can alter the electromagnetic fields around us, influencing how we perceive and interact with our surroundings. Even every organ of our body has a specific resonating frequency.

Sound also has the ability to embed messages below the threshold of conscious perception. These messages can directly target the subconscious, shaping beliefs, emotions, and actions. Such subtle influence can lead to collective responses, triggering mass emotions like rage or unrest.

The Power of Frequencies

As a producer, I started experimenting with 432 Hertz tuning in all of my music, noticing significant changes. Music felt more easy to hear, I didn’t get tired as fast working and composing, I could last longer working without ear fatigue. I also noticed the emotion in my songs where not as overwhelming. Compared to 440 Hertz where I found them exaggerated. In traditional tuning sad songs felt even more intense, happy songs felt more euphoric. I would definitely encourage you to experiment this on your own, look for a 432 Hertz version of your favorite song and compare in this particular aspect.

The Golden Tuning Technology of 432 Hertz amplifies the foundational coherence of the body, harmonically aligning our nervous system, health, well-being, and increased creative cognition-inspiration. The potential healing properties of 432 Hz music, citing studies that suggest it can reduce anxiety, improve sleep and immune response, lower blood pressure, and have positive effects on overall well-being.  Research shows that music affects digestion, internal secretion, blood circulation, nutrition, breathing, etc.

It affects the body in two ways:

-With a direct effect, i.e. influence of sound on cells and organs

-Indirectly - through the impact on emotions and our subconscious mind, which in turn influence many processes in the human body.

“There's no organ system in the body that's not affected by sound, music, and vibration. You can look at disease as a form of disharmony.” — Mitchell Gaynor.

This is where the language of the universe, biology, the intelligence of compassionate love, consciousness, genetics, and sacred geometry dance together in synergy. This frequency is obtained in an interesting way: 24 hours x 60 minutes x 60 seconds = 86400/2 = 43200. Historically, many ancient cultures, from the Egyptians to the Greeks, understood and utilized the power of sound. Pythagoras, for instance, spoke of the 'music of the spheres,' which is intrinsically linked to the harmonic principles of 432 Hz.

spinamp-59e0e3aedb98f8997feb.description:
As we continue our countdown to the streaming release of “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II,” it’s time to focus on the album’s longest track, "Shape in the Shadows".

Initially conceived of as a drone piece a couple of years ago, I later decided to expand the track, transforming it into an ambient dub instrumental. There wasn’t much done in terms of arrangement, as I wanted the recording of this track to have a more organic flow, relying heavily on improvisation. But there was no question of what the theme of it would be…

From the very beginning of the BIONICLE-saga, Makuta Teridax (or simply Makuta) was portrayed as a dark, menacing, and epic force to be reckoned with. The way he would always plan and calculate his way towards his goal of taking over the Matoran Universe made him both a fascinating and terrifying villain. This track was designed to capture that very essence.

I chose the ambient dub style for this piece because I felt it would best convey the mystique and darkness that defines Makuta. The track also draws inspiration from IDM acts like The Orb and The Fireman.

While I did most of the studio work, guitarist Jim Lawlor is also given a moment to shine, contributing some exceptional guitar work, adding a layer of depth to the track. Nigel Robinson also joined in, adding extra percussion and a spoken word sample, featuring one of Makuta’s most iconic quotes from the early years of BIONICLE. I’m grateful to both of them for helping to elevate this track..

You might also notice an extra credit on this track: “Special thanks to Leyland Kirby.” There’s a meaningful reason behind that.

In 2018, Kirby performed in Paris under his well-known moniker, “The Caretaker.” During the performance, he took a recording of Tino Rossi’s “Ce Soir” and distorted it to the point of being nearly unrecognizable. It was a haunting and chilling performance, one I highly recommend checking out if you’re curious.

This track samples that very performance as an audible representation of the shadowy void that Makuta embodies. It was a bold move, but I’m pleased to say it paid off.

And with that, there is only one track left, which should be available next week, as “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” will finally be released on streaming services.

Until then, may love and peace be with you all!

spinamp-6aa9eb5149da2dfa19c8.description:
Once a dreamer in the shadows, Alex faced life's battles with grit and determination. Growing up in a neighborhood where opportunities were scarce, he knew that success wasn't just handed out it had to be earned. From working late shifts at a rundown diner to juggling multiple side hustles, Alex hustled day and night. Every setback fueled his fire, every closed door made him more resolute. He faced ridicule, disbelief, and countless obstacles, but he never lost sight of his dreams.

"Boss Now!" isn't just a song it's the anthem of Alex's journey from the bottom to the top. It's a raw, unfiltered look at the grind and the glory, the pain and the triumph. With every beat, you feel the sweat and tears that paved his path. This track is a celebration of resilience and a testament to what it means to rise against the odds. Listen to "Boss Now!" and get inspired to chase your dreams relentlessly, just like Alex.

spinamp-00925aa1c129ccbca679.description:
“Back It Up Gyal” is pure energy, an anthem of vibrant and sensual dancehall that celebrates movement and the confident attitude of women on the dance floor. This track embodies the atmosphere of Jamaican parties, where heavy bass and percussive rhythms dictate every move.

With repetitive and catchy lyrics, the song relies on a call-and-response dynamic, encouraging dancers to “fling it pon mi” and “back it up” while playing with the musicality of Jamaican patois. The choppy flow and the beat’s rising intensity create an irresistible vibe that makes you want to move, capturing the very essence of dancehall: a mix of seduction, freedom, and pure rhythmic pleasure.

This track is designed to set the dance floor on fire, with a captivating hook and a contagious energy that echoes the genre’s classics while adding a fresh, electrifying touch.

spinamp-55bdd2fb054cf4c25cbf.description: "Chaos" is a beat brimming with vibrant energy, an electrifying fusion of instruments and synthesizers that pulsates with life. This dynamic composition weaves a tapestry of sound, where pounding drums and relentless bass lines create a powerful foundation. Layered atop this are intricate melodies from a diverse array of instruments, each contributing its own unique flavor to the mix. The synthesizers, with their otherworldly tones and textures, bring an edge of unpredictability, ensuring that the beat remains fresh and exciting from start to finish. "Chaos" isn't just a beat; it's an aural journey that captures the raw essence of untamed energy, propelling listeners into a state of exhilaration.

spinamp-15dba59542c1d74fff69.description:
"Demergat – Original Soundtrack" - A high-energy techno banger with a twist. 💣🎛️

What makes this one stand out? I sampled “Oi ya nestchastay”, a haunting Ukrainian folk song from 1922 (fully in the public domain), weaving a timeless cultural echo into the heart of modern rave energy. The sample adds a deeply human, historical contrast to the mechanical aggression of the track making the result dark, powerful, and emotionally layered.

I produced this track as the official original soundtrack for the experimental short film “Demergat.” Musically, it's rooted in acid techno, with distorted TB-303 lines, glitchy textures, and a relentless, euphoric drive. I wanted it to feel intense, edgy by design.

This is for anyone who loves underground sounds, cinematic textures, and techno that doesn’t just make you move but makes you feel.

spinamp-2d265c94b002c37d3216.description:
Behind the Music: Black Zone

In a world consumed by neon lights and digital illusions, Black Zone was born from the vision of a future where humanity is trapped inside an artificial system, unable to distinguish reality from simulation. Inspired by cyberpunk aesthetics and the idea of digital consciousness, the song explores themes of control, rebellion, and self-discovery in a dystopian society.

The Black Zone itself symbolizes the unknown—the dark side of technology where data is manipulated, memories are erased, and souls are reduced to mere codes in an endless stream. The lyrics paint a picture of lost identities, where people are nothing more than echoes within the system, struggling to break free from the invisible chains that bind them. But beneath the darkness, there is a spark—a rebellion that refuses to be silenced.

Through pulsating beats, futuristic synths, and heavy bass drops, the music captures the tension between submission and resistance. Each chorus builds upon the desire to escape, pushing toward an ultimate revelation: the power to rewrite fate lies within. The final verses shift the narrative from despair to hope, as the protagonist realizes that the system can be broken, and a new future can be forged.

At its core, Black Zone is more than just a song—it’s a battle cry for those who seek truth beyond the illusion. It serves as a reminder that even in a world dominated by technology, the human spirit remains unbreakable.

Writer's Note: Presenting "Shattered Dreams"

Inspiration

"Shattered Dreams" emerges as a poignant exploration of heartbreak and resilience, capturing the tumultuous journey from the heights of love to the depths of despair. Through evocative imagery and emotive lyrics, the song invites listeners to navigate the shattered fragments of a broken heart and find the strength to rebuild amidst the ruins.

Sensory Journey

In the verses, I immerse the audience in the raw emotions of shattered dreams and silent tears, painting a vivid portrait of loss and longing. Each line carries the weight of unfulfilled promises and faded hopes, echoing the profound sense of emptiness that accompanies heartbreak.

Empowering Refrain

With a chorus that reverberates with defiance and determination, "Shattered Dreams" becomes an anthem of resilience and renewal. It's a rallying cry for those who refuse to be defined by their past pain, urging them to rise above the wreckage and forge a new path forward.

"Shattered Dreams" invites listeners to embrace the transformative power of resilience and self-discovery, reminding them that even amidst the ruins of shattered dreams, there is always the possibility of a brighter tomorrow. My hope is that the song serves as a source of solace and inspiration for anyone navigating the tumultuous terrain of heartbreak and renewal.

I have dreamt of love since I was 6 years old.. Whether or not this was authentic expression or preconceived notions from society, I could write pages of what I have learned thanks to love. I started writing these one liners in the spring of 2020. When the world had stopped just as I started gaining consciousness as a young adult. These pieces have been my life over many moons, across miles, and from the moments that hit most home. & this year 2024, on a leap day spoke to me as a call to finish out 2 more bass songs to make 7. Each a vulnerable living for self & all of the experience arrived to be you. 

Love has taught me to be patient, as a lesson to learn everyday. I pray for my love & the peace of the lives within mine. This light has shown me merciless grace, continued forgiveness, and joyous company -even for someone who might be one in 7.8 billion. 
One liners for the lonely, broken, tired, faithful, 

one liners for the heavy hearted.

spinamp-22c40f6d4d579c5644ba.description:
My admiration for Kurt Rambis, the legendary NBA player, is profound and has significantly influenced my journey as a rapper. Rambis, known for his tenacity and hustle on the court, resonated with me, and I found parallels in our styles. Just as Rambis was relentless in his pursuit of rebounds and defense, I too, am relentless in my lyrical pursuits, always striving to improve and perfect my craft. His style of play, characterized by grit and determination, became a metaphor for my style of rapping - raw, real, and always pushing the boundaries.

Rambis' heart and hustle were not just inspiring but transformative for me. They helped me channel my energy and passion into creating an audio masterpiece. His never-give-up attitude, mirrored in my lyrics, became the backbone of my music. Every beat, every rhyme, and every verse I create is imbued with the same hustle and heart that Rambis displayed on the court. This connection between Rambis' style of play and my style of rapping has not only shaped my music but also allowed me to create a unique sound that stands as a testament to the enduring influence of Kurt Rambis on my life and art.

Join us as we unravel the ethereal beauty and introspective depth of "Shades of Solitude," a haunting melody that delves into the intricate layers of loneliness and introspection. From its inception to its final production, journey through the shadows of solitude and discover the essence of this captivating composition.

Inception

"Shades of Solitude" emerges from the depths of introspection, a melodic exploration of the solitary journey of the soul. Inspired by moments of quiet reflection and inner contemplation, the songwriter channels their emotions into a lyrical tapestry that resonates with listeners on a profound level. With each verse and chorus, they invite us to navigate the labyrinth of solitude, where echoes of the past mingle with dreams of the future.

Lyricism

The lyrics of "Shades of Solitude" paint a portrait of inner turmoil and introspective longing. From the evocative verses to the haunting chorus, every word is imbued with a sense of melancholy and yearning. The imagery of wandering through shadows and seeking solace in the depths of solitude evokes a palpable sense of emotional resonance, while the recurring motif of echoes symbolizes the enduring reverberations of a soul in search of connection. Through poetic introspection, the songwriter invites us to explore the nuances of solitude and find solace in the beauty of self-discovery.

Melodic Alchemy

The melody of "Shades of Solitude" is a symphony of emotion and introspection, crafted with precision to mirror the ebb and flow of the human experience. The haunting piano melodies and ethereal synths create a mesmerizing soundscape that transports listeners to the depths of the songwriter's psyche. With each crescendo and refrain, the music builds to a cathartic release, offering solace and redemption in the face of inner turmoil and existential uncertainty.

Production

In the studio, "Shades of Solitude" undergoes a transformation, evolving from a mere concept into a fully-realized sonic masterpiece. Collaborating with musicians and producers, the songwriter meticulously crafts each layer of instrumentation, infusing the music with depth and texture. From the melancholic strings to the atmospheric ambient sounds, every element is carefully orchestrated to enhance the song's thematic resonance and evoke an immersive listening experience.

Conclusion

"Shades of Solitude" stands as a testament to the power of music to transcend the boundaries of the human experience and touch the depths of the soul. Through its evocative lyricism, haunting melody, and meticulous production, it invites listeners to embark on a journey of self-discovery and introspection. As the final notes fade into the ether, the echoes of this poignant anthem linger, a reminder that even in the solitude of the soul, there is beauty to be found in the music of the heart.

With "Shades of Solitude," the songwriter has crafted a captivating piece of music that resonates with listeners on a deeply emotional level. May this exploration enrich your appreciation of the song and inspire you to embrace the nuances of solitude in your own journey through life's labyrinth.

spinamp-a14e7c6bdccd2f4001de.description:
Step into the gritty realm of “Bad Boys,” a hardcore boom bap beat that harks back to the golden era of hip-hop. With its roots firmly planted in the streets, this track delivers a raw, unadulterated sound that’s all about the rhythm and the rhyme.

The beat kicks off with a heavy, resonant bass drum and a sharp snare that hits hard on the two and four, embodying the classic boom bap signature. The hi-hats tick with a street-smart swagger, while the occasional vinyl scratch adds a layer of old-school authenticity.

spinamp-f8d8a3810af17a25e056.description:
Phobias are a type of anxiety disorder characterized by an intense and irrational fear of a specific object or situation. While everyone experiences fear from time to time, phobias are different because they are persistent and can significantly interfere with a person's daily life.

Here are some of the mental health issues that can be associated with phobias:

Anxiety: This is the main symptom of phobias. People with phobias experience intense anxiety when they are exposed to their phobic object or situation. This anxiety can manifest in a variety of physical symptoms, such as a racing heart, shortness of breath, dizziness, and sweating.

Panic attacks: In some cases, phobias can trigger panic attacks. Panic attacks are sudden episodes of intense fear that can be very debilitating.

Avoidance: People with phobias often go to great lengths to avoid their phobic object or situation. This avoidance can significantly restrict their lives and make it difficult to participate in activities that they enjoy.

Depression: The limitations caused by a phobia can lead to feelings of isolation, loneliness, and depression.

Social anxiety: Some phobias, such as social phobia, can also lead to social anxiety. Social anxiety is the fear of being scrutinized or judged by others in social situations.
If you think you or someone you know may have a phobia, it is important to seek professional help. Phobias are treatable conditions, and with treatment, most people can learn to manage their fear and live a normal life.

Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is a mental health condition that traps people in a cycle of unwanted thoughts and repetitive behaviors.  Here's a breakdown of the key features of OCD:

Obsessions: These are intrusive and persistent thoughts, images, or urges that cause anxiety or distress. Common obsessions include fear of germs, contamination, unwanted aggressive thoughts, or a need for things to be perfectly symmetrical.
Compulsions: Repetitive behaviors or mental acts that a person feels driven to perform in response to obsessions. These behaviors are meant to reduce anxiety or prevent something bad from happening. Examples include washing hands excessively, checking things repeatedly, or arranging objects in a specific order.
It's important to note that:

While obsessions and compulsions are common in OCD, not everyone who experiences these things has OCD. For OCD to be diagnosed, the obsessions and compulsions must be time-consuming (taking up more than an hour a day) and cause significant distress or interfere with daily life.

OCD can manifest in different ways, so the obsessions and compulsions a person experiences can vary greatly.

Here are some resources for learning more about OCD:

National Institute of Mental Health: OCD National Institute of Mental Health

"Burn It All for You" is a powerful pop anthem that channels the raw emotion of revenge and unyielding love. Conceived during a period of intense reflection and emotional turbulence, the song captures the essence of heartache and the lengths one would go to reclaim lost love.

The inspiration for the song came from a blend of personal experiences and stories shared by friends and collaborators in the industry. I wanted to create a track that not only resonated with those who have experienced betrayal and loss but also empowered them to rise from the ashes stronger than ever. The haunting melodies and evocative lyrics were crafted to evoke a sense of catharsis and liberation, making "Burn It All for You" a relatable anthem for anyone who has endured the pain of love and emerged victorious.

Lyrics Breakdown:

Verses:
The verses paint a vivid picture of desolation and yearning, with shadows on the walls and ashes in the air symbolizing the remnants of a love that once was. The imagery of flames and burning reflects the intense emotions and the internal struggle of moving on from a painful past.

Chorus:
The chorus is a declaration of unwavering devotion and the extremes one would go to for love. The promise to "burn it all" and "light the sky in blue" conveys a sense of ultimate sacrifice and the hope of rekindling a lost connection, despite the inherent pain.

Bridge:
In the bridge, the sense of despair reaches its peak with smoke filling the air and love burnt everywhere, yet a glimmer of hope remains as the protagonist admits to still caring despite the unfairness of the situation.

Conclusion:
"Burn It All for You" is a deeply emotional and powerful song that speaks to the resilience of the human spirit. It's a narrative of love, loss, and the relentless pursuit of what truly matters, making it a poignant addition to the pop music landscape.

Time to Rupture is a Dubstep / EDM / Brostep / Experimental Electronic track that doesn’t explain much... because it doesn’t need to. It doesn’t say what’s breaking, or how — but the tension is there, held back, until it explodes with aggressive drops, distorted bass, and vocal fragments that sound like digital signals on the edge of failure.

It’s inspired by the rawest side of dubstep and brostep —like the early work of Skrillex— but pushes that energy into a more abstract, emotional, and unpredictable space. Each listener might feel that something different is breaking —an idea, a phase, a system, a relationship, or a part of themselves— and that’s what makes it unique.

[Alternative Hiphop / Lofi Rap]

Behind the Music: “Try It Again” by URSTRULYXYZ 

In a vault of unheard demos, one track stands apart: “Try It Again.” Conceived in the chaotic swirl of urstrulyxyz’s ADHD-driven perfectionism, the song was almost lost to his endless quest for flawless production. But in a rare moment of creative surrender, he stripped away all drums and rigid structure—letting only ethereal synth keys and his unfiltered vocals carry the piece into unexplored sonic realms.

“This was me deciding: enough second-guessing,” he says. “I wanted the voice to breathe without any rules.” The result is a whimsical, boundary-defying journey, where fractured melodies tumble like stardust and each off-kilter pause feels like an invitation to simply exist in sound. His trademark wordplay remains intact—subtle internal rhymes and evocative turns of phrase that reward close listening.

Although still unreleased to the public, “Try It Again” debuts exclusively here on the
sound.xyz platform for a handful of early adopters. It’s the first glimpse of urstrulyxyz’s emergence from behind the scenes, a testament to his refusal to conform—and proof that sometimes perfection lies in embracing imperfection.
