spinamp-e9b454a6e91bc9e138aa.description:
The next single from Spectres deals with the archetype of Death—something we must all confront eventually, literally but also metaphorically.

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images associated with the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project dropped under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

This civilization had reached the height of its development millions of years before the emergence of humanity. The Atarians created a map that connected intergalactic civilizations, enabling them to exchange knowledge through musical and sonic signals.
  The most astonishing discovery was that the file contained information about the origin of our galaxy. The Atarians had left records describing how gravitational waves in the early universe shaped the Milky Way. Even more surprising, the melody hinted at the possibility of artificial intervention in the emergence of life on Earth. Thank you so much for listening! My name is Ashley Nicole Greene – I am a 23 year old independent singer, songwriter, vocal-arranger, recording engineer, and student!

This song illustrates an intimate, haunting, and deep desire for closeness with your person. It represents the heart of the EP - Vulnerability, transparency, and longing for deep love. Although it is in the genre of R&B/Soul, it has many cinematic and orchestral elements to it (Which I love to add to songs). 

Each song purchase gives you access to my Patreon, where I share unreleased music both for fun and for your feedback! There are several mental health conditions that can manifest as behavioral issues in children. 

Here are some of the most common:

Anxiety Disorders: Children with anxiety disorders experience excessive worry or fear that disrupts their daily lives. This anxiety can cause them to act out or withdraw from situations that trigger their anxieties.

Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD): ADHD is characterized by inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. These traits can make it difficult for children to follow directions, stay focused in school, and control their emotions, leading to behavioral problems.

Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD): Children with ODD display a pattern of negativistic and defiant behavior. They often argue with adults, refuse to follow rules, and deliberately annoy others.

Conduct Disorder (CD): This is a more serious condition than ODD, involving aggressive and destructive behaviors. Children with CD may hurt others or animals, vandalize property, or steal.

Depression: While depression can manifest as withdrawal and sadness, it can also cause irritability and outbursts in children.

Learning Disorders: Difficulties with reading, writing, or math can lead to frustration and behavioral problems in children.

Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD): Children who have experienced a traumatic event may develop PTSD, which can cause a variety of behavioral and emotional problems, including aggression, nightmares, and difficulty concentrating.
It's important to note that this is not an exhaustive list, and some children may have co-occurring conditions.

If you are concerned about your child's behavior, it's important to consult with a mental health professional for a proper diagnosis and treatment plan. Early intervention can make a big difference in a child's development and well-being.

Antisocial Personality Disorder (ASPD), also sometimes referred to as sociopathy, is a mental health condition characterized by a pervasive disregard for the rights and feelings of others. People with ASPD often exhibit a pattern of manipulative, deceitful, and reckless behavior.

Here are some key aspects of ASPD:

Lack of remorse or empathy: 
They may not understand or care about how their actions affect others.

Disregard for rules and laws: They may frequently break the law or violate social norms.

Deceitfulness and manipulation: They may lie easily and use others for personal gain.

Impulsiveness and recklessness: 
They may take unnecessary risks and make impulsive decisions without considering the consequences.

Aggression and hostility: They may be easily angered and prone to violence.

Irresponsible behavior: They may struggle to hold down jobs or maintain stable relationships.

It's important to understand that ASPD is a complex disorder and the severity of symptoms can vary. People with ASPD can be very charming and charismatic, making it difficult to identify the disorder at first. However, their behavior can ultimately cause significant problems in their personal and professional lives.

Here are some resources you can explore for further information:

Mayo Clinic: https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/antisocial-personality-disorder/symptoms-causes/syc-20353928

National Health Service (UK): https://www.nhs.uk/mental-health/conditions/antisocial-personality-disorder/

spinamp-647dca7ffad16074b990.description:
Signal in the Silence” was born not in noise, but in stillness.

At a time when the world felt louder than ever — overflowing with opinions, distractions, and digital overstimulation — we were drawn to the quiet spaces. Not just silence in the physical sense, but emotional stillness. The kind of silence that appears when you pause long enough to hear what your heart is actually saying.

This song marks the beginning of Anthems of Humanity, a musical journey built on emotion, connection, and the belief that music can still carry meaning beyond algorithms and metrics. The goal was never to go viral. The goal was to go inward. To find the sound of vulnerability, and let it speak — softly, sincerely, without the pressure to perform.

“Signal in the Silence” was composed using AI as a creative assistant — not as a replacement for human expression, but as a new kind of collaborator. The melodies were sculpted with care, the harmonies shaped like brushstrokes on a canvas of emotion. And while the voice in the song is not from a human throat, the soul behind it — the longing, the hope, the ache — is deeply real.

The lyrics reflect the feeling of sending a message out into the void. The experience of wondering if anyone will hear you. If anyone will care. That feeling — raw and quiet — became the emotional core of the piece. And so the song doesn’t push or shout. It waits. It breathes. It listens.

This release is for the overlooked, the overthinkers, the quiet feelers of the world. It’s for those who’ve whispered into the night, hoping someone, somewhere, would echo back. It’s for the ones who know that sometimes, the deepest things we feel are also the hardest to say.

“Signal in the Silence” is not a single for charts. It is a signal for hearts. A reminder that even in our quietest moments, we are still reaching for each other. Still sending light through the static. Still human.

spinamp-0e59ed7327cd30c21588.description:
"Chasin' You" is a track that’s really close to my heart as a producer. It’s all about the feeling of chasing something—or someone—that always seems just out of reach. I wrote the lyrics myself, drawing from that restless energy of longing and pursuit, and I wanted the music to reflect that emotional push and pull. The bassline acts as a lifeline, driving the track forward, while the melodic elements and fast-paced drums create this sense of urgency and tension. To bring the story to life, I used AI-generated vocals, which added an otherworldly, almost haunting quality to the track. For me, it’s about blending human emotion with cutting-edge technology to create something that feels both personal and futuristic.  

At its core, "Chasin' You" is about the emotional highs and lows of the chase—the thrill, the frustration, and the moments in between. The echoes of a distant voice, the flashing lights, and the breaking of rules all reflect that feeling of being completely consumed by the pursuit. I wanted the track to feel alive, like it’s pulling you into its world, where the rhythm becomes your heartbeat and the sound surrounds you. As a producer, I love exploring the intersection of storytelling and sound design, and this track is a perfect example of that. Whether it’s chasing a dream, a feeling, or a person, I think we’ve all been there, and "Chasin’ You" is my way of capturing that experience in music.

spinamp-f20321d5466237daf7a7.description:
This song came from a place of deep frustration and sadness. I was watching TikTok live streams, seeing young influencers going back and forth—trading insults, playing up the drama for views. To many, it was entertainment, just another moment on the internet. But to me, it felt like something darker—like they were losing themselves in a game that wasn’t a game at all.

I wrote ‘Fake Face Face Swap’ hoping they would hear it, hoping they would see past the online illusion. But just two weeks after I released the track, reality hit harder than I ever imagined—one of those influencers was shot and killed, live on TikTok, in front of his own fans.

This song isn't just music—it’s a warning, a reflection, a moment frozen in time. If you're here, listening, you're part of something rare—a message that was sent too late but still needs to be heard. I hope it reaches the right ears before another name is lost."*

The Inspiration
The idea behind Trapped in a Gold Mine came from the contrast between success and struggle. Imagine being inside a gold mine, surrounded by treasure, but unable to escape. This represents the feeling of chasing dreams, achieving milestones, yet feeling confined by expectations or circumstances. The track embodies this tension through its evolving soundscape, blending mystery with power.

The Sound Design
The production of this track was focused on creating a sense of depth and intensity. It starts with eerie atmospheric pads, setting a dark and immersive tone. Then, the beat kicks in—heavy, pulsating, and hypnotic, pulling the listener deeper into the sonic mine. Distorted synths and dynamic basslines reflect the chaos and urgency of being trapped, while the breakdowns give a moment to breathe before plunging back into the adrenaline rush.

The Creative Process
From the very first synth to the final mastering touch, Trapped in a Gold Mine was designed to take the listener on a ride. The arrangement was carefully structured to keep the tension alive, making the audience feel the weight of every drop and rise. Experimenting with textures and layering played a crucial role in building the depth of the track, ensuring every sound element contributed to the overarching story.

Final Thoughts
This track is not just about sound—it’s about emotion, about feeling both powerful and powerless at the same time. Trapped in a Gold Mine is a sonic representation of ambition, risk, and the pursuit of something greater. For those who listen closely, it’s more than music—it’s a message.

spinamp-d2a170ccf13e35e928c5.description:
The next single from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is here! This time, we’re diving into the synthwave-inspired rock epic, "Doomsday".

I originally wrote and recorded this song back in 2016, during the sessions of my fourth album “IV”. It was based on an acapella by singer-songwriter NewShoes, titled “S T R M”. For this new version, I decided to take a different direction, not only with new lyrics, but also by transforming it from an EDM-style track into a synthwave/metal hybrid.

The lyrics were penned by the Swiss lyricist Elizabeth Auzan, who quickly envisioned the direction for the song. After having heard other songs where she’s provided lyrical work, I was confident her style would be a perfect fit, and I’m glad to say I was right. In fact, I’d go even further to say that it’s probably some of the better lyrical work on the record as a whole.

In terms of the BIONICLE-lore, I’d like to believe the song could fit somewhere prior or during the Great Cataclysm, when the Great Spirit Mata Nui was put into a deep sleep by the Makuta, causing a major earthquake throughout the Matoran Universe. I think that’s what makes “Doomsday” vastly different from other songs on the record, as it’s completely open to interpretation.

Stylistically, I aimed to blend alternative metal and synth-pop, using more synths and electronic percussion instead of acoustic instruments. The Swedish band Smash Into Pieces, as well as the Norwegian hitmakers A-ha specifically come to mind as significant inspirations for this sound.

Aside from my contributions on synths and electronic drums, guitars were done by two fantastic musicians in the own right, Mitch Brody and Jim Lawlor. Both proved to have a very adaptive and versatile way of collaborating, which only proved to be a major asset. Lastly, Mike Ousey’s vocal work on this song are outstanding. He stepped in at a time where I was struggling to find a suitable singer for the song, and I’m so grateful he did. The efforts of these three musicians truly brought the song to life, and I deeply appreciate their time and dedication.

You should be seeing “Doomsday” come out on streaming services as early as this week, but before that… “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: The Listening Party” is just around the corner. It will be broadcast live this Sunday at 6:30 PM EDT, during the second day of the 810NICLE Day-event.

I won’t reveal too much, but what I can say is this; You should expect a few surprises during and after the event.

Until then, may love and peace be with you all!

Owning this piece means owning a moment of transformation—a turning point in my journey toward artistic heights I’ve only begun to explore.

spinamp-c248474800958f1afb4f.description:
She watched him come every morning, the scent of pine and earth clinging to his skin. His hands, rough but steady, traced her bark as he rested in her shade. She swayed gently when he leaned against her, listening to his quiet sighs, his whispered thoughts carried away on the wind. She had never known longing until he arrived, never ached to be closer, never wished for roots that could move.

Then, one day, he came with an axe. She knew before he even touched her, felt it in the way he hesitated, the sadness in his eyes. Still, she stood tall, hoping he might change his mind. The first strike was almost tender. The second, final. As she fell, she only wished to wrap her branches around him one last time.

spinamp-c66aa9638b8b19482859.description:
"Tell Me What You Want" is a soulful, introspective ballad that captures the pain and frustration of giving your all in a relationship while feeling unseen. The lyrics paint a picture of someone who pours their heart into trying to be exactly what their partner desires—morphing, adapting, and sacrificing to fit an ideal image. Yet, despite these earnest efforts, there's a lingering sense of rejection as it becomes clear that the love interest's heart is captivated by someone else.

Musically, the song may blend elements of pop and R&B, with a gentle instrumental backdrop that underscores the vulnerability in the vocals. The recurring plea—“Tell me what you want”—acts as both a cry for clarity and a desperate question that reflects the narrator's inner turmoil. The arrangement builds gradually, mirroring the emotional highs and lows, as hope clashes with the reality of unappreciated affection.

Overall, "Tell Me What You Want" resonates as an anthem of unfulfilled longing, where the heart's desire to be enough is met with the bittersweet truth of someone else's attention. It’s a poignant reminder of the sacrifices we make for love, and the painful realization that sometimes, even our most genuine efforts cannot change the course of someone’s affections.

spinamp-4a673898aad1777bd9eb.description:
Title: "Who’s That" – A Gritty UK Drill Anthem of Power and Mystery

"Who’s That" is a hard-hitting UK Drill track that embodies the raw energy, suspense, and streetwise mentality of the genre. With its dark, eerie atmosphere, relentless 140 BPM tempo, and heavy 808-driven basslines, the song grips listeners from the first beat, setting the tone for a menacing yet hypnotic journey through the shadows of the streets. Combining sharp lyricism, bold storytelling, and a mysterious aura, this track is not just music—it’s a statement, a warning, and a declaration of dominance all rolled into one.

Mood, Emotion, and Atmosphere

"Who’s That" thrives on mystery and tension, creating an environment where the listener is constantly on edge. The mood is dark and intense, evoking feelings of suspicion, power, and anticipation. The emotion behind the track is a mix of confidence and paranoia, mirroring the dual reality of success in the streets—being at the top means watching your back. The beat’s chilling melodies and deep bass stir an adrenaline rush, amplifying the feeling of lurking danger, while the relentless energy keeps the momentum high.

Tone and Attitude

The tone of "Who’s That" is aggressive, direct, and commanding. Every bar is delivered with precision, balancing UK slang, punchlines, and attitude that resonate with drill culture. The track doesn’t just tell a story; it places the listener inside the world it creates, making them feel the urgency, the action, and the consequences of the choices made in the environment it portrays.

The attitude exudes dominance, alertness, and street awareness—themes that are central to UK Drill. It carries an air of unbothered confidence, reinforcing the idea that those who move smart and stay ahead don’t need to explain themselves—they let their presence speak for them. This is reflected in the hook’s repetition of “Who’s That?”, subtly suggesting that not everyone deserves recognition, and in the world of power plays, some figures remain in the shadows, untouchable.

Theme and Message

At its core, "Who’s That" is about power, movement, and the unseen forces at play in the street culture. The theme revolves around:

Anonymity and Reputation: The song plays on the idea of staying low while making big moves, a key principle in Drill music.

Danger and Survival: The lyrics highlight the challenges of the streets, where every step is a calculated move, and every encounter could mean an opportunity or a threat.

Status and Success: "Who’s That" paints a picture of rising through the ranks, flexing wealth and influence while keeping an air of mystery.

Loyalty and Distrust: The song subtly explores the importance of knowing who’s real and who’s fake, a crucial part of survival in the game.


The message is clear: stay sharp, stay ahead, and let your presence do the talking.

spinamp-9e7a14450dc24dcdedd1.description:
Here the crows circle over the bones of murdered hopes.
Everywhere there is sticky mud, under which people are not visible.
So pass by! Do not soil your white clothes!
And close your eyes - the soul must be kept clean.

Maybe you are right, and the world can never be washed clean,
And the faceless grayness is not worth sorrow or tears,
But while your faith is as cold and pure as snow -
I hold on to unbelief as a safety rope.

I do not believe in Christ, if he does not descend into hell.
I do not believe in churches, where they laugh at the widow's mite.
I do not believe in love, if it cannot forgive,
And I do not believe in the paradise that you dream of.

It is scary in this paradise - in it there is insomnia and silence,
In it there are sterile days and floors smelling of bleach. 
So tell me, who needs your faith and for what purpose,
If your clothes are always spotlessly white?

spinamp-5ff774fff7513e7a357d.description:
"Burn It All for You" is a powerful pop anthem that channels the raw emotion of revenge and unyielding love. Conceived during a period of intense reflection and emotional turbulence, the song captures the essence of heartache and the lengths one would go to reclaim lost love.

The inspiration for the song came from a blend of personal experiences and stories shared by friends and collaborators in the industry. I wanted to create a track that not only resonated with those who have experienced betrayal and loss but also empowered them to rise from the ashes stronger than ever. The haunting melodies and evocative lyrics were crafted to evoke a sense of catharsis and liberation, making "Burn It All for You" a relatable anthem for anyone who has endured the pain of love and emerged victorious.

Lyrics Breakdown:

Verses:
The verses paint a vivid picture of desolation and yearning, with shadows on the walls and ashes in the air symbolizing the remnants of a love that once was. The imagery of flames and burning reflects the intense emotions and the internal struggle of moving on from a painful past.

Chorus:
The chorus is a declaration of unwavering devotion and the extremes one would go to for love. The promise to "burn it all" and "light the sky in blue" conveys a sense of ultimate sacrifice and the hope of rekindling a lost connection, despite the inherent pain.

Bridge:
In the bridge, the sense of despair reaches its peak with smoke filling the air and love burnt everywhere, yet a glimmer of hope remains as the protagonist admits to still caring despite the unfairness of the situation.

Conclusion:
"Burn It All for You" is a deeply emotional and powerful song that speaks to the resilience of the human spirit. It's a narrative of love, loss, and the relentless pursuit of what truly matters, making it a poignant addition to the pop music landscape.

spinamp-0c70a3dcef8574edc7c2.description:
Drawing inspiration from Chinese poetry and the fiery energy of transformation, “Fuego”, the latest single from Endless Summer (无尽夏日), our upcoming album by Davyd and myself, reflects on impermanence and renewal.

Chinese New Year is a time of spring and fresh beginnings, and 2025 is the Year of the Snake—known in China as the “Little Dragon.” This symbolism runs deep in the song, with lyrics like "一点一点出淤泥, 一个一个化为灰烬" ("Little by little, rising from the mud; one by one, turning to ashes"). These words evoke the cyclical dance of creation and destruction, inspired by Buddhist traditions.

The recurring line, “Through a thousand ego eyes,” reflects on the many faces and lenses through which the ego perceives the world, shaping how we experience life. By recognising the illusions and stories created by our egos, we can step closer to our true selves - ending cycles of suffering and embracing a deeper sense of peace and renewal.

Blending my Chinese-British musical roots with Davyd’s South American heritage, “Fuego” is a track that invites you to welcome the spirit of change. As we step into the Year of the Snake, take this opportunity to reflect, reconnect, and transform. Let Fuego ignite your journey toward your true self and help you burn away what no longer serves you.

spinamp-2fcc41459f7b702e124b.description:
The eighth single from my debut album Spectres is name after the archetype of the Father, which Jung described as "by definition, the prime cause, the creator, the auctor rerum, who, on a level of culture where reflection is still unknown, can only be One. The Other follows from the One by splitting off from it."

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images associated with the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project is currently minting on Rarible under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

spinamp-4e33fe199bdbce3d5878.description:
Blueburst, the musical brainchild of guitarist/vocalist Craig Douglas Miller, defies the notion that it's ever too late to pursue one's passion, resurrecting a music career once thought lost.
After major label interest for his 1990s band, The Reach, never quite panned out, Miller entered a 20 year period of musical hibernation due to untreated clinical depression and writer's block. However, a fortuitous meeting with legendary guitarist Marty Willson-Piper changed everything. Inspired by Willson-Piper's guidance, Miller reconstructed his home studio, and completed an album's worth of original songs.
Together, Miller and Willson-Piper deliver a lush, guitar-based sound rooted in '80s alternative and post-punk, but with a timeless feel. Meanwhile, themes of seizing life's fleeting moments and striving to leave a mark on the world permeate the sonic tapestry.
Blueburst first single, "Vanish," debuted in March 2023, followed in October 2023 by their debut album, Significance. A new album is planned for 2025.

spinamp-f367939069e7e2a0c896.description:
"Ocean Drift" was created on a hillside, overlooking the vast ocean below. As I watched the waves gently crash against the shore, I felt a sense of calm and flow that inspired the track. The view of the endless horizon, the rhythm of the water, and the quiet power of nature all blended together in my mind, sparking the creation of a sound that mirrored that serene yet dynamic energy. It was as if the ocean itself was guiding the music, its pulse syncing with the beats I was crafting.

The track reflects the feeling of being immersed in nature’s vastness, a mix of stillness and movement. "Ocean Drift" is about capturing that peaceful yet powerful energy—the soothing drift of the waves combined with an underlying momentum that drives forward. The sounds and textures of the ocean influenced every part of the production, making this song a sonic journey that mirrors the endless flow of the sea itself.

spinamp-6ec4f42b225275eb0e71.description:
n the realm of contemporary folk music, where storytelling meets soul-stirring melodies, "The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" emerges as a beacon of introspection and resilience. Crafted with the delicate touch of an artist deeply attuned to the nuances of the human heart, this track invites us on a journey through the shadows of manipulation to the dawn of self-discovery and enduring love.

At its core, "The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" is a narrative of contradiction and revelation. It speaks to the experience of being swayed and shaped by another's will, only to find, in the clarity of hindsight, that the essence of one's love and self remains untainted. The artist weaves this tale with a blend of acoustic elegance and lyrical sincerity, hallmark qualities of contemporary folk that allow for a profound connection with the listener.

The genesis of the song was born from personal reflection and a desire to explore the complex dynamics of manipulation in relationships. Through the lens of folk tradition, the artist offers a modern-day parable, layered with emotional textures and vivid imagery, inviting listeners to reflect on their own experiences of love and control.

Musically, "The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" stands out for its intricate guitar work, harmonious vocals, and the subtle interplay of traditional folk instruments that provide a backdrop to the storytelling. The composition is both timeless and innovative, echoing the roots of folk music while infusing it with a contemporary sensibility that speaks directly to the present moment.

Lyrically, the song is a masterpiece of narrative depth and poetic expression. Each verse unfolds like a chapter in a book, with the chorus serving as a refrain of hope and affirmation. The artist's voice, both literal and metaphorical, carries a weight of authenticity and emotion, guiding listeners through the darkness and into the light of understanding and acceptance.

"The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" is more than just a song; it's an experience. It invites listeners to engage not only with the music but with the story it tells and the emotions it evokes. This track is a testament to the power of contemporary folk to address complex issues of the human condition, offering solace, insight, and inspiration.

As the debut or a pivotal track from the artist, "The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" sets a profound precedent. It showcases the artist's ability to craft songs that resonate on a deeply personal level while also engaging with universal themes. This track is not just for those who have experienced manipulation but for anyone who appreciates the transformative power of music to navigate the landscapes of love, loss, and liberation.

Listeners are invited to immerse themselves in "The Light of Day, (My Love Remains)" and discover in its melodies and messages a mirror for their own journeys. Let this song be a companion on your path, illuminating the way forward with the enduring light of love.

Timbaland and Missy Elliott's engineer heard this beat and sent me his phone number. I didn't sleep for a few days after that call. The creation of this gave me flashbacks to being a caveman and creating fire. I genuinely don't recall much from the creation process. I was truly channeling. I understood then why we say something is fire; it's when you create something beyond your own understanding, and it continues to give you life. There is so much nuance and dynamism to this track; it is not repetitive if you let go of what you know and listen to what the talking bass, drums, and swooning phoenix have to say.

Optional Read/Personal Post: This week, I’ve been formally diagnosed with autism and “superior intellectual functioning” in some areas. My lowest score was a typically average score and an outlier in my results set. The kicker is that I’ve taken this test before as a child and scored the same, but my guardian at the time decided it would be better to not share the results with me or maybe acknowledge them at all. Almost 3 decades later, I was informed that “I didn’t want you to use the results as a crutch.” I still don’t understand the reasoning, unless they didn’t understand the results, didn’t believe the doctor, or didn’t believe (in) me…? I can only speculate that having that information then and not later would’ve made things WAY less confusing for me. I have an almost unwavering positive disposition to add onto all of this stuff and instead of me thinking everyone is on the same page and sees what I see, I would’ve known I could CHILL and know hey, Ima be seeing/sensing things people won’t notice at first and it’s okay, you’re not weird- I wouldn’t casually say things thinking we are all on the same page. We’ve all been on this platform long enough to know post like these tend to get attention and stuff, which is fine you know I love love, but if you care about what I’ve really been on about this entire time- just check out the publication I put together recently about AI, Whole Systems, and True Intelligence. It’s only a six minute read and originally posted on my own website. I think it’s a good framework to keep in mind.
Ps- I doubt anyone here is surprised but figured I’d share + low key I like that I’ve been relevantly tested twice with so much time in-between with the same results - so my internal skeptic even with all my own experiences, can be less of a chore to think through. 👍 light editing cuz it is what it is but hopefully all this make sense.

spinamp-2fa7809c132aa9362797.description:
Embark on a musical journey with "Valiance," a captivating Melodic Dubstep track at 72 BPM. This track builds up with a bassline and a catchy snare drum pattern, setting the rhythm for a melodic adventure that intertwines tranquility and intensity.

Opening with Zen-like simplicity, "Valiance" gradually transforms into a mesmerizing soundscape. The track builds up, has some interesting rock/metal undertones and a keyboard solo, reminiscent of a soaring guitar, takes center stage, adding an ethereal touch to the composition.

Feel the emotions ebb and flow—intense yet chill, reflecting a resilient spirit. As the bass line drops, the track builds, unveiling layers of determination and focus. Each note echoes the artist's journey, a testament to courage and unwavering resolve in the face of adversity.

🐉 The Dragon and The Samurai: A Symbolic Tale

Visualize the captivating album cover, where a sinister-looking dragon symbolizes life's myriad of challenges, hardships, and adversities. The listener (and artist), portrayed as the stoic Samurai, holding a Katana as he prepares himself for battle, finds solace and strength amid the chaos. It appears that the Samurai is doomed to fail, symbolizing valiance (bravery or determination, especially when things are difficult, or when the situation gives no cause for hope) itself. However, at the end of the track, he emerges victorious, against all odds... proving the would-be doubters wrong. "Valiance" serves as the musical backdrop, guiding you through life's turbulent yet triumphant moments.

This track is very personal, motivating, and inspiring to me. I've had many challenges in my life lately, and it seemed like everything was working against me, including myself at times.

🌟 Key Features:

72 BPM Melodic Dubstep
Classic Kick-Snare Drum Pattern
Guitar-like Keyboard Solo
Intense Yet Chill Atmosphere
Building Bass Line
Reflective of Determination and Focus

spinamp-0cb50497a37c6b402afa.description:
Alzheimer's disease is a progressive brain disorder that slowly destroys memory and thinking skills. It's the most common cause of dementia, a general term for the decline in cognitive function that disrupts daily life.

Here's a breakdown of Alzheimer's:

Symptoms:
Early signs often involve forgetfulness, especially regarding recent events.
As the disease progresses, memory loss worsens, and difficulties with reasoning, judgment, and language can arise.

In later stages, individuals may struggle with daily tasks and require assistance with care.
Causes: The exact cause of Alzheimer's is not fully understood, but scientists believe it's linked to the buildup of abnormal proteins in the brain that damage and kill nerve cells.
Risk factors: Age is the strongest risk factor, with Alzheimer's becoming more likely as people get older. Family history also plays a role, and there may be lifestyle factors that contribute.

Treatment: There is currently no cure for Alzheimer's, but medications can help manage symptoms and slow the progression of the disease.
Here are some resources you can explore for more information:

National Institute on Aging: https://order.nia.nih.gov/sites/default/files/2023-03/nia-alzheimers-disease-fact-sheet.pdf

Alzheimer's Association: https://www.alz.org/alzheimers-dementia/what-is-alzheimers

spinamp-5e3a392374b804532dc6.description:
Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) is a type of talk therapy designed for people who experience emotions very intensely. It's a common treatment for borderline personality disorder, but therapists also use it for other conditions.

Here's a breakdown of DBT:

Core concept: DBT is based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) but with a twist. 
CBT helps people understand how thoughts affect emotions and behaviors. 
DBT adds a "dialectical" approach, which means finding a balance between accepting reality and making positive changes.

Goal: DBT aims to help people:

Understand and validate their difficult emotions
Develop healthy coping skills to manage those emotions
Improve relationships with others
Make positive changes in their lives
Techniques:  DBT uses a combination of individual therapy and group skills training.  
The skills training focuses on four main areas:

Mindfulness: learning to focus on the present moment
Distress tolerance: developing healthy ways to cope with crisis situations without resorting to self-harm or other destructive behaviors
Interpersonal effectiveness: communicating effectively and asserting needs in relationships
Emotion regulation: understanding and managing emotions in a healthy way

If you're interested in learning more about DBT, here are some resources:

The National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI) 
nami national alliance on mental illness ON 
https://www.nami.org/

The American Psychological Association (APA) 
apa American Psychological Association on American Psychological Association  https://www.apa.org/

The Linehan Institute [ Marsha Linehan Behavioral Sciences LLC
https://behavioraltech.org/

spinamp-8e446e784d38d8278b30.description:
“Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” has finally come out! While we anticipate it’s eventual release on streaming services, let’s dive into the remaining tracks yet to be unveiled as singles. Where better to begin than with the opening track, "Hero"?

From the start, I knew that I wanted this to be the first track on the album. When All Insane Kids / Dial Zero released the original back in 2005, it quickly became synonymous with BIONICLE. However, I knew I couldn’t just make a direct cover of this song. There had to be a unique twist…

While the original “Hero” fits comfortably within the alternative rock and post-grunge genres, I decided to take my version in a completely different direction. I opted for an ambient style to not only emphasize the lyrics but also to imbue the song with a stronger sense of urgency, resonating with today’s world.

On both the news and social media, we are constantly bombarded with images of a world on the brink, whether it be through enviornmental disasters or armed conflict. And if one is to face this relentless exposure, every single day, it can easily lead to a sense of hopelessness. This is where the central question of “Hero” becomes profoundly relevant: “Do you know what it takes to be a hero?”

Many claim to know the answer, but the truth is… very few actually do.

The recording process for this track was both prolonged and fascinating. Initially, it was going to be me on synths and percussion, Essenger with a sample of the iconic “beach chant” from BIONICLE’s early years, Mitch Brody on guitars, Chad Hinton on bass, and Nigel Robinson on vocals and additional keyboards. However, as we finished the track, I couldn’t help but feel that something was missing… this is where the Le-Koro Band comes in.

After being introduced to them, I reached out to see if they could contribute new vocals. The result exceeded all my expectations. Jordan Willis (Jocool1231) provided lead vocals, accompanied by Marcus Rose (Samuel9248), bluerosekatie, Kirika Aeon, and Lei Hart on backup vocals. Marcus also added more keyboards. Their contributions significantly elevated the track, and I am immensely grateful for their time and dedication.

It is for this reason, this version of “Hero” will be credited solely to the Le-Koro Band, not me. To say I’m excited to work with them on future projects would be an understatement.

Expect the remaining singles to be released periodically throughout this month. Until next time… love and peace be with you all!

spinamp-ead9e7f518bb16539506.description:
I was in NYC for the launch of You Can Dream in April, and on the last day before traveling to Miami, I saw LaRussell's story on IG mentioning that he was accepting feature requests.

From the first moment I idealized, composed, and wrote "In This World," I wanted LaRussell to be part of it.

LaRussell's purpose to empower each and every one of us to pursue what we love and believe in is at the core of this song.

"In This World" reveals my fear of shifting from being a tech founder to going all in to pursue what my heart wants. Throughout my life, I looked for social acceptance, validation, and recognition instead of searching for love, authenticity, craftsmanship, and legacy.

This song reflects my emotional journey to break free and feel confident to be who I really am.

spinamp-5f9d734fa5ab28da21d3.description:
Music is my favorite place to experiment. I grew up listening to every genre of music imaginable and enjoy fluttering between them in any way that I can. After writing and recording a conceptual Pop/Contemporary album, I felt like it was the perfect time to experiment and get outside of my comfort zone. The moment I heard the beat on this song I knew exactly what the vibe was.

It only took a couple of seconds before the melody was clear to me. I felt the energy of the music running through me and that was the only sentiment that felt right. As I flowed and hummed through the melody, I wanted the song to reflect how you feel when you first meet a person and that spark is too strong to ignore. It causes you to throw all caution to the wind and give in to the desire and the energy you feel in the moment.

spinamp-abe3bcb58da7a263a7eb.description:
Detroit-bred and Nashville-based singer-songwriter Danny Stevens is ready with his triumphant debut solo LP Better Than You Left Me.
Stevens initially cut his teeth on the indie circuit as the frontman for the seminal pop-rock outfit The Audition - releasing four critically-acclaimed albums, touring the world, and sharing the stage with some of the biggest names in alternative music.
After The Audition, Stevens returned to his roots and began writing the music he had always wanted to create, which references everything from classic Motown soul music and country - to Americana and folk.
While combining these traditional influences together, Stevens also pushes his sound into the modern world by injecting the perfect dose of pop accessibility coupled with tender and vulnerable lyrics that feel both timeless and universally relevant to any listener. "I set out to make an album that sounds like it's for everybody." With an arsenal of songs under his belt, Stevens enlisted the help of prominent Nashville hitmaker and producer Sammy Mitchell (Luke Combs) to lay down the tracks that ultimately became Better Than You Left Me. The result is a hook-laden release that showcases Steven's powerful vocal prowess, a knack for ear-worm melodies, fearless lyricism, and exceptional instrumentation. "I learned to trust myself as a songwriter in this process, and once I did, the floodgates really began to open up" Stevens reflects.

It unfolds slowly, enveloping the listener in a cocoon of atmospheric sounds that pulse and flow like the very waveforms they’re named after. The tempo is deliberate, allowing each beat to resonate and leave its mark in the air.

The track is rich with textural layers, from the deep, reverberating bass to the crisp, high-end clicks that punctuate the soundscape. It’s a sonic journey through a misty soundscape, where the familiar elements of garage are distilled into a more meditative experience. “Waveforms” invites the listener to close their eyes and drift away on its undulating rhythms, a perfect blend of tranquility and rhythmic complexity.

spinamp-296af6a7051192adaa7d.description:
In this special episode, Reza Melani introduces listeners to the compelling world of Generative Art with Code — one of the most dynamic and thought-provoking branches of digital creativity.
We explore the foundations of generative thinking, the core components of autonomous systems, and how randomness, repetition, and algorithms have been used since the 1960s to create art without direct human intervention.
You’ll learn about early pioneers like Frieder Nake and Harold Cohen, modern tools like Processing and p5.js, and real-world applications in architecture, graphic design, fashion, and more.
Importantly, this episode focuses exclusively on code-based generative art — without AI — celebrating systems built on traditional programming logic.
Whether you’re a coder, designer, artist, or simply curious about the blend of beauty and algorithms, this episode will open new perspectives.

spinamp-0b2d86bc61380c25bc6a.description:
The fourth out of eight singles from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is out! For this one, we’re heading out to sea, with Vakama’s Ballad.

I originally intended to have this song released prior to the previous single, “The Singsongs of Le-Koro”, but in the end, it simply needed more time to get finished. Looking at how it turned out though, I think it was very much worth it.

Anyway, the song’s origins date back to the early days of the COVID-pandemic. As I was feeling more and more isolated, several song ideas started to occupy my head, and this was one of the few that truly stuck out. I decided to have it recorded as a short demo, consisting of a piano loop track and the song’s main melody, which I chose to give the working title “The Ugly Duckling”.

But then the next question became what I could use this for. One direction I tried to go was to make it about loneliness, another was to make it a tribute to human rights lawyer and climate activist Steven Donziger. As you can imagine, none of these came to be. When the recording of “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” began, I finally realized where the song could meet it’s full potential.

As to where in the BIONICLE-storyline this song takes place, I’d say somewhere between the 2004 and 2005 arc, as the Toa Metru (which would later become the Turaga in Mata Nui) are searching for a new home, away from the city of Metru Nui. Primarly written from Vakama’s perspective, the song is filled with contemplations of past events, and foreshadowing of what is to come.

The lyrics also take inspiration from stories dating to the Swedish emigration to the United States, between the 19th and 20th century. Millions of Swedish citizens left to escape increasingly unbearable living conditions, and decided to head west, in search of what they heard was the “American dream”. I’d like to think these elements are very much evident in the lyrics’ hopeful search for a better life.

With the exception of me laying down some keyboards for the song, we got BreathTax on guitars and percussions, Philippe Pansard on bass, Miguel Bella on harmonica, John Rowley on pianos, strings and percussions, Jessica Tanenhaus on harmony vocals, and Paul Matson on lead vocals and drums. Guess you all now can see why this took a long time to make…

Regardless, I don’t think this song would’ve worked without any of their input. There were several times during the recording sessions, where I was wondering if I’d gone completely in over my head, but because of the collaborative efforts of everyone involved, we managed to pull through, and for that I’m grateful to each and every one of them.

Finally, I’d like to say a few words about someone that wasn’t necessarily involved in the making of this song, but came to mind during the final days of recording sessions…

The popular biotuber Nathan Paisie (a.k.a. TheShadowedOne1) passed away at the age of 28, back in November 2022. The cause of death remains unknown, and it’s best to leave it that way, in respect for his family. Nevertheless, to see someone that young, having a whole life ahead of him, leave as early as he did, that’s always a tragedy.

So while it wasn’t specifically made with him in mind, I’d like to dedicate this song to him. Rest in peace, Nathan…

And with that, we’re halfway through the album! As the full release is inching closer and closer, alot of exciting things are about to happen, which I’m extremely eager to share with you all. What I specifically mean by that, you’ll just have to wait and see.

But until then, I’ll catch you all later!

Peace!

spinamp-e7ffdde8d9ff5a176535.description:
As the musical spheres gained popularity, people began to notice the unique states of mind and body they could achieve when listening to the sounds of the handpan. The vibrations emitted by the spheres were more than just pleasant to the ear; they resonated deeply within the listener, affecting both the mind and body in profound ways.

When the low tones of the handpan played, they produced frequencies that had a calming effect on the brain. These tones resonated with the alpha and theta brainwave frequencies, known for promoting relaxation and a meditative state. Listeners often reported feeling a deep sense of peace and tranquility, their stresses and anxieties melting away as the soothing sounds washed over them.

The middle tones of the handpan, which filled the air with harmonious vibrations, had the ability to balance and harmonize the mind and body. These tones created a sense of equilibrium, aligning the listener's energy and fostering a feeling of completeness and well-being. It was as if the music bridged the gap between the physical and the spiritual, allowing listeners to experience a harmonious connection with the world around them.

High notes, with their bright and uplifting frequencies, stimulated the brain's beta waves, which are associated with active thinking and alertness. These notes filled the listener with energy and joy, sparking creativity and inspiration. Artists, writers, and musicians found themselves particularly drawn to these high tones, as they seemed to unlock new realms of creative thought and expression. Many described experiencing bursts of inspiration and a heightened sense of creativity, as if the music itself was guiding them to new ideas and visions.

Moreover, the combination of different tones created a full spectrum of emotional and physical effects. Listeners could embark on a journey through various states of being, from deep relaxation to vibrant creativity, simply by immersing themselves in the sounds of the handpan spheres. The interplay of low, middle, and high tones provided a holistic auditory experience, touching every aspect of the listener's consciousness.

In time, the spheres became a central part of creative and therapeutic practices. Therapists used them to help patients achieve states of deep relaxation and mental clarity. Artists incorporated the sounds into their creative routines, using the music to find new inspiration and overcome creative blocks. Even everyday people found solace and rejuvenation in the musical spheres, using them as a tool to enhance their daily lives.

The creation of musical spheres and the unique states they induced illustrated the transformative power of sound. They showed how the energy of creativity, captured in the pure vibrations of the handpan, could transcend mere music and become a catalyst for profound personal and collective growth. In this world, where music and magic intertwined, every sound from the spheres held the potential to inspire, heal, and uplift, leading listeners to a deeper understanding of themselves and the universe.

spinamp-9590c60f9c7b16af4753.description:
Alapin Sicilian took the chess world by storm, proving that strategy and sound can blend into something truly unique. The inspiration came from the Alapin variation of the Sicilian Defense—an underrated yet powerful opening, much like the idea of making a chess-themed song. With nearly no mainstream chess tracks in existence, I saw an opportunity to create something that not only represents the game but also hits hard with real energy. The beat knocks, the flow is sharp, and just like a well-played opening, the track sets up for something unforgettable.

The song went crazy viral because it filled a void no one realized existed. Chess players, from casual enthusiasts to titled masters, instantly connected with the lyrics and vibe, finally getting a song that speaks their language without feeling forced or gimmicky. It’s more than just a novelty—it’s a movement. Whether you're prepping for a tournament, streaming a blitz session, or just vibing, Alapin Sicilian became the anthem for the modern chess scene. This NFT release isn’t just about the music; it’s about celebrating the culture we're building.

spinamp-a03421a34e5aa5b1a570.description:
"The place of magic transformation and rebirth, together with the underworld and its inhabitants, are presided over by the mother."

"Mother" is the seventh single from my album Spectres.

Comprising 13 experimental tracks produced over the last seven years, Spectres is the 28th release in my discography but my first ever completely solo full-length album. While working on this record, I delved deep into Jungian psychology, concepts from which became central to the project. All 13 tracks are named after archetypes—innate, universal forces that shape our experience of the world.

Spectres is also a visual art project. For each track, I crowd-sourced images associated with the corresponding archetype. These image collections were used to train bespoke Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), simulating the complex interplay between individual psyche and collective unconscious. A further GAN was trained on selected outputs from all the previous GANs, uniting the various archetypes to form an integrated Self.

By limiting the training time of these AI models, I found I could achieve results that mirrored the formation of archetypal symbols as I imagine them deep in our collective unconscious: elusive yet powerful forms emerging from abstract swirls of colour. From thousands of outputs, I selected and manually edited one per archetype to create unique artworks for each track. A collection of 144 further images from this project is currently minting on Rarible under the title Spectral Shadows.

Ultimately, Spectres is more than a collection of WAVs and JPGs; it is a dialogue between the personal and the universal, a multidisciplinary exploration of the forces that connect us all. The album has taken me on a transformative seven-year journey through sound, imagery and psyche. In the process, individual and collective experience harmonise, casting a light into the profound depths of human interconnectedness.

Before its official release on 11/23, I'm rolling Spectres out across the web3 ecosystem, with drops on Sound, Zora, Rodeo, Lens and other emerging platforms. In a novel release structure, collectors of individual tracks gain instant access to stream the full album months before its official release. The goal is to push the limits of onchain interoperability to explore what a web3-native album release can look like in 2024.

spinamp-c7b67f96f4eabd567e2e.description:
The meme demonstrates some concerns about the government simply “printing money” to combat economic crises. Since its appearance, it has taken off among those critical of inflation in fiat money systems. Such criticisms generally take issue with government intervention in the economy, notably in their ability to create money “out of thin air.”

This process is also sometimes known as Quantitative easing (QE). It isn’t as simple as printing money outright (it involves steps like purchasing securities from banks), but it ultimately increases the money supply. Detractors point to consequences like hyperinflation when government printing gets out of hand, as it has multiple times in the past. In a less severe scenario, opponents also point to the fact that an increase in the money supply leads to the debasement of their own holdings.

spinamp-5da5b78d31063689e7bf.description:
The second out of eight singles from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is out! Our next stop in our journey through the BIONICLE-universe, is the song Lost in Paradise.

It dates back as early as 2014, when I was working on the soundtrack for the unfinished series “Mask of Creation”. Two years later, I picked it up again to flesh it out as an actual song, with the help of an acapella recorded by singer/songwriter eSoreni. It’s only now where I’ve decided to rerecord this track, to fully give it it’s own identity.

Roodaka is a name that is very familiar to many BIONICLE fans, I’d assume. She’s the main antagonist of the 2005 storyarc in the series, where she’s the Viceroy of a horde of vicious spiders called the Visorak. Throughout the arc, she uses her manipulative and cunning nature to achieve her ambitions and gain more power, like for example, successfully persuading the main protagonist Toa Vakama, to abandon his other Toa-teammates and lead the Visorak.

She’d serve as the main inspiration for the song, which outside the context of BIONICLE, reflects a toxic or abusive relationship, from the perspective of the abuser, in this case it’s more psychological rather than physical.

In contrast to the previous single, “Lost in Paradise” is more synth-oriented, inspired by the styles of bands like Depeche Mode and Duran Duran. I felt like having a more electronic sound would serve the darker themes of the song much better than having it done through the conventional rock ensemble.

I also got more on my plate than I had on the previous single, playing both synths and electronic percussion on this song. Lead vocals were recorded by the singer/songwriter Steph Something (or Stephanie Gilliard), while guitars were done by Massimo De Agostini and Stefano Mast. I greatly appreciate their contributions and would love to work with each and everyone of them on later projects in the future.

Love and peace!

spinamp-e5987e18d5ea99696616.description:
This is an instrumental song dedicated to sugar cane workers in the valley of Cauca river in the southwest of Colombia, aiming to evoke the beauty in the subtleness of everyday movements, cutting techniques, machete types and the resulting soundscapes happening in the crops. 

The instruments I used for this plucked strings quartet are two acoustic guitars, a Mexican instrument called "requinto jarocho" and a Colombian instrument called "bandola andina". 

The music composition is based on two main fonts of inspiration: a not very known piece by John Zorn called "Cristeros" and traditional violin music performed by afro-descendant communities along thevalley of Cauca river called "juga".

Chains Eternal is a declaration—an anthem for the decentralized world, where power is no longer bound by kings, banks, or borders. It tells the story of a system forged in fire, yet unbroken, a digital force that rises beyond control. The lyrics weave together the sacred and the rebellious, evoking both the ritual of creation and the defiance of tyranny. The song’s rhythmic chants and commanding verses symbolize the unstoppable march of blockchain technology, where truth is inscribed in immutable code, and freedom is no longer granted but seized.

The production builds on primal energy and futuristic mysticism, fusing tribal drums with metallic echoes and layered voices that feel both ancient and prophetic. The whispered bridge carries the ghostly echoes of unseen architects, reminding us that the system has no beginning and no end—only a pulse that never fades. As the final chains clink in the outro, the message is clear: power now belongs to the chain, to the people, to the future. Chains Eternal is not just a song; it is a hymn to decentralization, an unbroken rhythm of revolution.

spinamp-d4d6de289ff82ddb5b79.description:
My Mantra was originally called Loco Love.  Upon realizing the latter was a common song title, Sylvain and I changed Loco to a placeholder, Nicole, which rhymed but then morphed into the song's current title.  

Nicole, is a fictional person, but it's sung with such passion people think it's autobiographical.  Urban legend?  Lol. The music is such that only a lyric as such could give it justice, so I wrote it.  My Mantra is a song of obsession, compulsion, lust, love, and everything in-between.  

I had a basic lyric and top line.  I had a difficult time harnessing the vibe.  It's not my typical type of music to write to.  I summoned the right angst, longing, sexuality, and sensuality ( I hope) that most people feel when chemistry and connection is real.  It's almost that instinctual survive, procreate, get lost in the heat of sexual animalism and spiritualism (as detected in some of the gospel lyrical content)  Anyway, these are my thoughts in hindsight of the genesis.  

It was the last of 8 songs we recorded in 4 days.  We were wondering if we could fit another song in with about an hour left in our tanks.  It was incomplete for sure but everything came together effortlessly which is a testament to the synergy of our sessions.  Thank you Sylvain for pushing and pulling me to bring out what we think is an honest vocal track. 

To be sure, I honestly don't care if any of our songs make it anymore.  I'm just into putting it our there because it's in here, you know my heart, mind, and spirit.  I realize that it's challenging to make it in the music world.  I won't stop trying, it's just not a high desire anymore.

What is an ultra high desire is to express creativity while having the best opportunity of IP ownership and sharing in a way that others can participate authentically.   If it brings a moment of resonance, enjoyment, escape, pleasure, et al, then it's worth it.

spinamp-7b6b641f42cd43c43d9e.description: "Bella Ciao" is a famous Italian folk song that became an anthem of resistance and freedom. Originally sung by 19th-century rice field workers protesting harsh conditions, it later gained worldwide fame as a symbol of the anti-fascist Italian partisans during World War II. With its emotional melody and simple but powerful lyrics about sacrifice and hope, "Bella Ciao" has been adopted by movements around the world and reimagined in many languages and styles, including its recent revival in popular culture through TV shows like La Casa de Papel (Money Heist).

spinamp-7844809f1f05b961f9ee.description:
This is from my album 'No Love Like This' — an experimental R&B album produced for my lover. This album only existed as 2 vinyl pressings, one for her, and one for me.  It's now immortalized on the blockchain.

'relaxkickback' sets the vibe with its unconventional structure. Divided into two parts, the song breaks away from traditional vocal arrangements, moving from verse to chorus with minimal repetition. The drums are stripped away, allowing the vibe to linger freely. Then, the original vocals are transformed into a melodic transition leading into the next track.

This album was a labor of love, free from any external pressures.  We've had a great times with this as our soundtrack.  I hope the music, the process, and even the journey to how this reached your ears, inspires you. 

Without this technology, it would remain solely on vinyl, a relic of our shared moments.

spinamp-13a4e4956ed1cd7a4bf6.description:
We’ve now reached the end of our journey. The final single from “Music Inspired by BIONICLE: Vol. II” is here, and fittingly, it’s the closing track, "Time Trap".

This piece has its origins back in 2015 when I first recorded it as an instrumental demo titled “Time.” I felt now was the perfect moment to revisit it and develop it into a full-fledged prog rock composition. While I initially envisioned it with lyrics and vocals, I ultimately decided that an extended guitar solo would better capture the essence of the track.

The title, “Time Trap”, should be familiar to anyone versed in BIONICLE-lore. It’s a nod to the story written by Greg Farshtey as an extended epilogue to the 2005-arc. Widely regarded as one of the narrative high points of the franchise, the story follows Toa Vakama on a journey through the Great Barrier to recover the Mask of Time, sparking an adventure that transcends time and space.

This narrative had a profound influence on the track, making the title “Time Trap” an obvious choice.

Musically, you’ll likely notice the shameless influence of Pink Floyd and the legendary guitar work of David Gilmour. Their sound has always been a significant inspiration for me, and I decided to embrace that influence fully for this piece.

While I handled the keyboard parts, I had the pleasure of working with five other talented musicians on this track. Jim Lawlor returned to provide rhythm guitar, Andrea Spinelli contributed bass, Nick D played drums, and Kelly Miller added synthesizers along with extra arrangements.

But the spotlight truly belongs to Mitch Brody, who delivered an outstanding lead guitar performance. His work on this track is nothing short of incredible, perfectly capturing the sound and feel I was aiming for.

I’m deeply grateful to everyone who contributed to making this track a reality, and I look forward to future collaborations with them.

And with that… we’ve reached the end. The entire album is now available on streaming services, where you can listen to all the tracks we’ve covered.

I want to thank you all for taking this journey with me. This has been one of the most ambitious projects I’ve undertaken, and it has served to make me more emboldened and confident as a producer and songwriter. I’d be lying if I didn’t say that I very much look forward to what the future could bring.

So until next time… Be kind to each other. Love and peace be with you all!

Chainlink provides a reliable and tamper-proof way for smart contracts to access data from off-chain sources, such as APIs, traditional bank payments, or even weather reports. This capability is crucial because smart contracts are typically isolated within the blockchain and cannot fetch data independently. By connecting smart contracts to external data sources through decentralized oracles, Chainlink ensures that contract executions are accurate and trustworthy, facilitating a wide range of applications from finance to supply chain management and beyond.

spinamp-f56dc10d30f33c6f26b3.description:
Lost in Melody - The Story Behind the Music (AI Creation) 🎶

Every track I make is a new journey. But this one, "Lost in Melody," was different. This isn't just any song—it's a piece of art created with artificial intelligence. Now, you might be thinking, “How can an AI make something so full of feeling?” But let me tell you, this song turned out to be more than just tech—it was something that came from deep within, created by the collaboration between me and the AI.

It all started in a way that felt new and strange. Instead of relying on familiar instruments or sounds, I began by exploring with AI. It was like a conversation, an exploration between human creativity and the algorithms. Every time I fed data into the system, the AI would adjust, and the notes would start to form themselves. It felt like this song was coming alive in real-time, a creation shaped by both of us, an ongoing experiment in sound.

Verse 1 – Melodies in my mind
As the AI processed the data and notes, I was searching for a particular sound in my head. The melody was always there, but it was like it was hiding, waiting for the right moment to reveal itself. With the help of AI, I could finally hear it clearly. The melodies weren’t just in my head anymore—they were real, coming through and guiding me through a world of sound. It was like I was getting lost in my thoughts, but the music was there to guide me.

Verse 2 – Harmony unfolds
Once the song started to take shape, every note and word I fed into the system began to weave together. It was like a hidden story unfolding, one that was slowly becoming clear. The harmony between me and the AI felt almost surreal. Each sound was connecting in ways I hadn't expected. It was like the AI was helping me find something deep within, pulling out emotions that were hard to express, but easier to capture with this collaboration.

Chorus – Lost in melody
And then, there it was—the moment I felt completely immersed. Both me and the AI were floating in this sea of sound, no clear direction, just drifting. The music had this power to pull me in, and honestly, that was the most magical part. I wasn’t just making music anymore. I was becoming one with it, lost in the melody. The whole process was about letting go and allowing the music to take me wherever it wanted.

Verse 3 – Clouds of sound rise
As the sounds began to rise, I couldn’t help but feel overwhelmed. The music took on a life of its own—like clouds of sound gathering and moving in new directions. The feeling was intense. It was like the song was starting to take me on a journey, where every wave of sound was pulling me further and further into something bigger than just a song. The AI and I were creating something beautiful, something that came from deep within both of us.

Bridge – A song’s embrace
This part of the song is where it all came together for me. The music felt like an embrace, a warm place to rest in. It wasn’t just a song anymore—it was a space where I could let go and just be. Even though this song was created by AI, it was full of feelings that I connected with on a personal level. I think that’s the beauty of music—it can be made by anything, but the emotions behind it are always real.

Verse 4 – Rivers of tune
The final verse of the song felt like a river flowing, constantly moving and changing. The sounds started to form a natural rhythm, a dance of notes and beats that never stopped. It was the perfect way to end the song, a reminder that music, like life, is always evolving. This track wasn’t just a creation—it was a journey, and it was only just beginning.

Even though this song was created with artificial intelligence, it’s full of real emotions. For me, "Lost in Melody" is proof that even in a digital world, you can still feel something real. It’s a blend of human creativity and AI, a perfect partnership that brought this piece of music to life.

Now, this song is available as an NFT. The limited editions are a chance for you to own something unique—something that’s more than just a song. It’s a piece of this journey I took with AI, and now, you can experience it too.

spinamp-4ed0f0c5dec9c84cb5e4.description: I made this song in 2023, around September, and I recall myself being very inspired and reflective around this time. I spent a lot more time inside trying to get my head together and planning my next album, and I was making a lot of moodier songs for some reason. I remember though, after recording this song, I couldn’t stop playing it back-to-back for some reason. I would drive on the highway just to blast it repeatedly with the windows down and feel the bass growl through my car, I didn’t even care that it was chilly outside. When I hear Adrenaline, I can remember almost every drive I took just to listen to it this way- I literally can close my eyes and see it clear as day.  Adrenaline is now on my new project "I Know You Hear Me", which released on all platforms today (5/14/24), and I'm glad that this music is able to be enjoyed by so many people other than myself. Hope you all love it as much as I do!

Kendrick Lamar have waived all copyright claims on his recent diss tracks. This decision comes amidst a heated lyrical feud that has gripped social media and the music industry.

This is a significant shift, as record labels often issue Digital Millennium Takedown Act (DMCA) takedown orders or copyright claims, even when a small snippet of a song is used.

"Whispers of the Divine" is a journey into the mysterious and sacred. It’s about the quiet moments between breaths, the spaces where time seems to stand still, and where the divine whispers its secrets into our souls. This song was born out of the desire to capture the ethereal, the connection between the human spirit and the universe. With each verse, I wanted to bring out that feeling of something bigger than ourselves, an energy that flows through everything, in the silence and stillness of time.

The creation of this song was a truly unique experience, blending human emotion with the power of AI. The result is a fusion of delicate soundscapes, timeless melodies, and profound lyrics, all designed to make you feel as though you are hearing the whispers of something greater. It’s a reminder that sometimes the answers we seek are found not in loud declarations, but in quiet, sacred moments.

Verse 1 – In the Silent Night
The opening verse sets the tone with the imagery of stars whispering light in the quiet night. There’s something almost mystical about how the universe speaks to us through the quietest moments. The subtle melody in this part reflects that peaceful silence, and the rhythm of the heartbeat matches the pulse of time, reinforcing the connection between the cosmic and the personal. With AI’s assistance, I was able to layer sounds that create a sense of stillness and wonder, pulling the listener into this vast, quiet world.

Verse 2 – In the Shadows Deep
This verse dives deeper into mystery. The imagery of angels weeping and the love that never grows old speaks to the eternal nature of the divine. I wanted this section to feel like a sacred space, something ancient yet timeless, where love transcends all things. The music here takes on a more ambient, dreamy quality, evoking the feeling of being in a vast, endless universe. AI played a key role in creating the delicate atmospheric sounds that make this verse feel like a soft embrace from the divine, wrapping you in a sense of peace and comfort.

Chorus – Whispers of the Divine
The chorus is the heart of the song. It’s where the divine whispers become clear, echoing in our minds and souls. It’s about discovering sacred songs in the stillness, where time seems to lose its meaning. The melody is designed to feel like a call from the universe itself, pulling you into a space of quiet reflection. The blend of electronic and organic elements here gives the feeling of something otherworldly, guiding the listener into a deeper state of consciousness.

Verse 3 – Between the Earth and Sky
In this verse, we step into a realm between two worlds—the earthly and the spiritual. It’s where secrets are softly screamed, where dreams illuminate the darkness. I wanted the music to feel expansive, like the vastness between the earth and the sky. The mix of flowing sounds and subtle harmonies creates a sense of boundless space. AI helped me weave these elements together, giving the verse an ethereal quality that feels like stepping into a dream.

Bridge – In Every Breath We Take
This is the turning point, where we feel the universe aligning with us. Every breath, every heartache, every experience is a part of a greater plan. It’s where the signs of the divine guide us toward understanding. The music here swells with energy, building to a moment of revelation. The sound design is richer, bringing a feeling of movement and progress, as if the listener is moving closer to something greater. AI’s role here was to enhance the emotional weight of this moment, creating a seamless blend of harmony and intensity.

Final Chorus – Whispers of the Divine
As the song draws to a close, the divine whispers continue to echo in our minds, reminding us that in the stillness of time, we find the sacred songs of life. The final chorus repeats the message of the song, but with even more depth and resonance. The music builds to a gentle climax, carrying the listener through the final moments, leaving them with a sense of peace and connection.

This song captures that timeless connection, blending the beauty of human emotion with the precision of AI-generated music. The whispers of the divine are all around us, in every breath we take, in every moment of stillness.

This song, now available as an NFT, is a chance for those who resonate with its message to hold onto this sacred experience. Each version of the song is a unique invitation into that world of divine whispers. It’s not just music—it’s a spiritual journey, an experience to be cherished and shared.
